AI.method: 构建 MCBench 基准，包含1196个场景，覆盖四个安全类别；每个不安全场景搭配一个仅有细微差异的安全对照场景，用于评估模型对安全风险的敏感度。通过对最先进模型的评估及推理轨迹分析，考察模型提取模态特定信息及跨模态整合能力。
AI.result: 全模态大模型在包含显著视觉或声学线索的场景中表现较好，但在面对微妙或非物理性风险时表现困难；推理分析显示模型能提取各模态信息，但无法有效整合这些线索做出准确安全判断。
AI.conclusion: 当前全模态大模型在安全关键场景中缺乏鲁棒的跨模态推理能力，亟需改进模型架构和训练策略以提升多模态安全性。

title: State commitment learning: training language models to distinguish computation from memory
summary: Reasoning language models do not distinguish tokens used for computation from tokens that constitute persistent state: once generated, all hidden thoughts remain in context and influence future predictions. As a result, downstream reasoning may depend on failed attempts, dead ends, and private scratch work that should not be safely relied on later. We recast this phenomenon as a new training objective, state commitment learning: training models to explicitly distinguish information that should be committed as persistent state from temporary computation that can be discarded. We define a counterfactual criterion, persistent-state sufficiency, which makes it trainable and measurable whether an answer remains usable after hidden thoughts are erased. We then propose Counterfactual Erasure RL (CERL), which evaluates, under the same prefix, both a path that keeps hidden thoughts and a path that erases them, and gives reward only when the erasure path remains correct. We also introduce the Erasure Dependence Protocol and show across mathematics, long-chain logic, scientific QA, and multi-turn tool-use evaluation that CERL substantially reduces answer dependence on hidden thoughts without sacrificing accuracy, consistently outperforming correctness-only RL and long-answer SFT baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“状态承诺学习”（State Commitment Learning）这一新训练目标，旨在让推理语言模型学会区分应保留的持久状态与可丢弃的临时计算。通过定义“持久状态充分性”的反事实准则，并设计反事实擦除强化学习（CERL），模型在数学、逻辑、科学问答等任务上显著降低了对隐藏思考的依赖，且不牺牲准确率。
AI.motivation: 当前推理语言模型将所有生成的token（包括失败的尝试、死胡同、私密草稿等隐藏思考）均保留在上下文中，导致下游推理可能依赖于这些不应被信赖的临时计算。这带来了推理脆弱性和安全性问题——模型可能基于不可靠的中间过程做出最终判断。
AI.method: 首先定义反事实准则“持久状态充分性”（persistent-state sufficiency）：在擦除隐藏思考后，答案仍保持正确的程度。基于此提出反事实擦除强化学习（CERL）：对同一前缀同时评估保留隐藏思考和擦除隐藏思考两条路径，仅当擦除路径仍正确时给予奖励。同时引入“擦除依赖性协议”（Erasure Dependence Protocol）作为测量工具。
AI.result: 在数学推理、长链逻辑、科学问答和多轮工具使用等评估中，CERL显著降低了模型答案对隐藏思考的依赖性，同时保持了与仅正确性RL和长答案SFT基线相当甚至更好的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 通过状态承诺学习和CERL，可以训练模型将推理过程中的临时计算与持久状态解耦，使模型在保持推理能力的同时，不再依赖不可靠的中间思考过程，提升了推理的鲁棒性和可信赖性。

title: SentinelBench: A Benchmark for Long-Running Monitoring Agents
summary:
AI agents are increasingly asked to carry out work that spans minutes, hours, or longer. Yet the default model of agent behavior is continuous action: issuing tool calls, refreshing pages, searching for alternatives, or otherwise trying to force progress. This is the wrong approach for many long-running tasks, which are better served by a strategy of sustained attention. Instead, agents should monitor an environment, notice when an external event makes progress possible, then respond promptly without wasting resources while waiting. To measure progress on this class of tasks, we introduce SentinelBench, an open-source benchmark for time-evolving monitoring tasks.
  SentinelBench contains 100 tasks across 10 synthetic web environments, including email, calendars, finance, professional networking, and entertainment. Each environment exposes a live web interface and replays a scripted sequence of events, requiring agents to navigate and reason about web pages whose state shifts underfoot. SentinelBench measures task completion, reaction time, and resource use, exposing the tradeoff between responsiveness and cost. We report results across three models and two browser-agent harnesses, establishing performance baselines for future comparison and demonstrating how agent design choices can dramatically impact key metrics. Together, these results show that SentinelBench distinguishes meaningful differences in agent behavior.

AI.tldr: SentinelBench 是一个面向长时间监控任务的基准测试，包含10个合成Web环境中的100个任务，用于评估AI智能体在持续关注策略下的任务完成度、反应时间和资源消耗，揭示了响应性与成本之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 当前AI智能体默认采用连续行动策略（不断调用工具、刷新页面等），但这对许多长周期任务并不合适。这类任务更适合"持续关注"策略：智能体应监控环境，仅在外部事件使进展成为可能时才及时响应，避免等待期间浪费资源。现有基准测试缺乏对此类时间演化监控任务的评估。
AI.method: 作者构建了SentinelBench，一个开源基准测试，包含10个合成Web环境（邮件、日历、金融、职业社交、娱乐等）中的100个任务。每个环境提供实时Web界面，并回放脚本化的事件序列，要求智能体在页面状态动态变化的情况下进行导航和推理。基准测试衡量三个指标：任务完成度、反应时间和资源使用量。在三类模型和两种浏览器智能体框架上进行了实验。
AI.result: 实验建立了性能基线，表明SentinelBench能够有效区分智能体行为的显著差异。智能体设计选择（如模型类型、浏览器框架）会显著影响反应时间与资源消耗等关键指标，揭示了响应性与成本之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: SentinelBench填补了长时间监控任务评估的空白，证明了持续关注策略在此类任务中的重要性。该基准为未来智能体在时间演化环境中的行为优化提供了标准化比较平台。

title: Sparse Functional Singular Value Decomposition for Biclustering and Triclustering Longitudinal Data
summary: Identifying subtypes of complex conditions, such as Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD), often requires capturing latent patterns in longitudinal omics data. However, these data are typically high-dimensional, sparsely sampled, and irregularly observed over time, posing substantial challenges for conventional (bi)clustering and functional data analysis methods. We propose Tri-SfSVD, a unified sparse functional Singular Value Decomposition framework for discovering biclusters and triclusters in longitudinal data. Unlike existing functional biclustering methods that rely on ad hoc imputation or enforce restrictive shape-homogeneity assumptions, Tri-SfSVD integrates continuous trajectory estimation with simultaneous subject, feature, and temporal selection within a single optimization framework. By imposing sparse penalties across subjects, variables, and temporal subregions, the proposed method works directly on observed data to uncover localized structures at the subject, subject-feature, and subject-feature-time levels. Extensive simulations demonstrate that Tri-SfSVD outperforms existing approaches in high-dimensional settings. Applied to IBD multi-omics data, the method identified three biclusters linking sample clusters with distinct IBD-related clinical characteristics to microbial pathway groups associated with specific bacterial taxa, providing interpretable subject-pathway associations for characterizing disease heterogeneity. Applied to multi-channel EEG data, the method identified three triclusters linking sample clusters with distinct alcohol-related phenotypes to localized brain activity patterns, including subgroup differences separated by temporal subregions within the same spatial region.

AI.tldr: Tri-SfSVD 提出了一种统一的稀疏函数奇异值分解框架，能够在纵向数据中同时发现双聚类和三聚类结构，无需插补或形状同质性假设，直接处理不规则观测的高维数据，在IBD多组学和脑电数据中均取得有意义的发现。
AI.motivation: 复杂疾病（如炎症性肠病IBD）的亚型识别需要捕捉纵向多组学数据中的潜在模式，但这类数据通常具有高维度、稀疏采样、观测时间不规则等特点，传统（双）聚类和函数数据分析方法难以有效应对。现有函数双聚类方法要么依赖临时插补，要么施加严格的形状同质性约束，缺乏一个统一框架来同时进行连续轨迹估计和主体、特征、时间的选择。
AI.method: 提出Tri-SfSVD，一个统一的稀疏函数奇异值分解框架。该方法在一个优化框架内整合了：（1）连续轨迹估计；（2）通过在主体、变量和时间子区间上施加稀疏惩罚，实现对主体、特征和时间维度的同步选择。该方法直接在观测数据上工作，无需插补，能够在主体层面、主体-特征层面和主体-特征-时间层面发现局部化结构（即双聚类和三聚类）。
AI.result: 模拟实验表明，Tri-SfSVD在高维场景下优于现有方法。在IBD多组学数据中，识别出三个双聚类，将具有不同IBD临床特征的样本簇与特定细菌类群的微生物通路组联系起来。在多通道EEG数据中，识别出三个三聚类，将不同酒精相关表型的样本簇与局部脑活动模式联系起来，包括同一空间区域内按时间子区间分离的亚组差异。
AI.conclusion: Tri-SfSVD为纵向高维数据中的结构化模式发现提供了一个灵活统一的分析框架，能够在不依赖插补或严格形状假设的前提下，同时揭示不同粒度的聚类结构，在生物医学领域具有广泛的应用前景。

title: Recovering Physically Plausible Human-Object Interactions from Monocular Videos
summary: In this paper, we propose RePHO, a method to reconstruct physically plausible human-object interactions (HOI) from monocular videos. While existing kinematic-based approaches produce visually plausible motion, they often result in physically implausible artifacts such as interpenetration and object floating. To overcome these issues, we introduce a physics-guided reconstruction framework. We begin with a kinematic estimate and then refine it by training a policy with reinforcement learning (RL). This policy is optimized to reproduce the interaction in a physics simulator. Because kinematic estimates are typically noisy, naive RL training can fail. Therefore, we propose an adaptive sampling strategy with a dual self-updating mechanism that can identify the frames with the most informative and reliable kinematic reconstruction. Our process progressively improves reconstruction quality and yields physically consistent HOI sequences. We demonstrate our approach on two standard HOI benchmarks and achieve clear improvements in physical plausibility metrics over state-of-the-art methods. Project Page: https://dingbang777.github.io/RePHO/

AI.tldr: RePHO 是一种从单目视频重建物理合理的人-物交互（HOI）方法，通过强化学习在物理仿真器中优化初始运动学估计，并引入自适应采样策略筛选可靠帧，显著提升物理合理性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于运动学的方法虽能生成视觉上合理的运动，但存在穿透、物体漂浮等物理不合理伪影。需一种能将物理约束融入重建的框架，以消除这些伪影。
AI.method: 以初始运动学估计为起点，在物理仿真器中用强化学习训练策略来复现交互；提出带双重自更新机制的自适应采样策略，识别信息量最大且运动学重建最可靠的帧，逐步提升重建质量。
AI.result: 在两个标准 HOI 基准上验证，在物理合理性指标上相较现有最先进方法取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: RePHO 成功将物理仿真与运动学重建结合，有效消除物理伪影，生成物理一致的 HOI 序列，为单目视频 HOI 重建提供了新的技术路线。

title: Efficient Punctuation Restoration via Weighted Lookahead Scoring Method for Streaming ASR Systems
comment: Accepted for presentation at The International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN) 2026
summary: Punctuation restoration improves ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) readability. However streaming ASR requires online decisions with limited future context. In streaming ASR, the system predicts punctuation incrementally, which makes generation-based approaches prone to latency and alignment failures under boundary-wise evaluation. This paper proposes a non-autoregressive scoring method (no free-form generation) that preserves the input transcript and makes a decision at each word boundary. Our method compares punctuation insertion hypotheses against a no-insertion baseline under a bounded K-subword-token lookahead, and calibrates decisions using a weight α and a validation-calibrated threshold τ (no parameter updates during inference). On IWSLT 2017, our scoring method achieves a 4-class macro F1 of 0.893 in the no fine-tuning setting (validation-calibrated, K=2) and 0.937 after fine-tuning (K=2), outperforming the prompt-based baseline (0.566) and a fine-tuned ELECTRA baseline (0.913) under the same lookahead budget. We analyze the impact of the lookahead budget through ablation studies on K.

AI.tldr: 提出一种非自回归的标点恢复评分方法，在流式ASR中通过K子词前瞻窗口比较标点插入假设与不插入基线，利用权重α和阈值τ校准决策，在IWSLT 2017上取得优异性能。
AI.motivation: 流式ASR需要在线决策且未来上下文有限，传统生成式方法在边界评估下易出现延迟和对齐失败问题，需要一种保留输入转录、逐词边界决策的非生成式方法。
AI.method: 提出一种非自回归评分方法：不进行自由形式生成，保留原始转录，在每个词边界比较标点插入假设与不插入基线，使用有界的K子词token前瞻窗口（K-subword-token lookahead），并通过权重α和验证集校准的阈值τ进行决策校准（推理阶段无需参数更新）。
AI.result: 在IWSLT 2017数据集上，无微调设置下（验证校准，K=2）4类宏F1达0.893，微调后（K=2）达0.937，显著优于基于提示的基线（0.566）和同等前瞻预算下微调的ELECTRA基线（0.913）。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在流式ASR标点恢复任务中，以非自回归评分策略有效利用有限前瞻信息，兼顾低延迟与高精度，且通过消融实验验证了前瞻预算K对性能的影响。

title: Gradient Descent with Large Step Size Restores Symmetry in Deep Linear Networks with Multi-Pathway
summary: Recent analyses of multi-pathway Deep Linear Networks use Gradient Flow to predict a "winner-takes-all" specialization in which path symmetry breaks and each feature concentrates in a single pathway. In this work, we show that discrete Gradient Descent (GD) with a large step size tells a different story. We prove that single-path solutions are sharp minima, whereas distributing signals across pathways reduces sharpness by a factor that decreases with both the number of pathways and depth. Consequently, while early training reproduces the depth-driven symmetry breaking predicted by GF, oscillations at the Edge of Stability subsequently override this tendency and drive the network into a re-balancing phase, where signals redistribute across pathways. Together, these results clarify how depth shapes pathway competition and explain why large-step GD favors shared representations rather than persistent single-pathway dominance.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了离散梯度下降（大学习率）与梯度流在深层线性网络多路径特化行为上的根本分歧：大学习率GD在稳定边缘的振荡会覆盖早期的"赢者通吃"特化，将网络推向信号跨路径重新分配的共享表征状态。
AI.motivation: 此前基于梯度流（GF）的分析预测深层线性网络会呈现"赢者通吃"的路径特化，即每个特征最终集中于单一通路。然而实际训练中常用离散梯度下降（GD）且学习率较大，作者旨在探究GD动态是否以及如何偏离GF的预测。
AI.method: 作者对多通路深层线性网络分别推导了梯度流和离散梯度下降（大学习率）下的动态，通过分析单路径解的锐度（sharpness）以及稳定边缘（Edge of Stability）处的振荡行为，证明了锐度随通路数和深度的增加而降低的关系，并追踪训练的阶段性演化。
AI.result: 证明了单路径解是尖锐极小值，而跨路径分布信号可将锐度降低一个随通路数和深度增加而减小的因子。训练早期确实重现了GF预测的深度驱动的对称性破缺，但稳定边缘处的振荡随后覆盖了这一趋势，将网络驱入重平衡阶段，信号重新跨通路分布。
AI.conclusion: 深度塑造了通路竞争，但大学习率GD最终倾向共享表征而非持久的单通路主导。这澄清了优化算法选择对深层网络表征学习结构的根本性影响。

title: An interpretable and trustworthy AI framework for large-scale longitudinal structure-pain association studies using data from the Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI)
summary: Purpose: To develop an interpretable and trustworthy AI framework that combines deep learning based MRI Osteoarthritis Knee Score (MOAKS) prediction with interpretable statistical modeling to study structure-pain relationships at scale using data from the Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI). Materials and Methods: We first developed a deep learning framework to predict MOAKS features directly from knee MRIs and incorporated conformal prediction to provide prediction uncertainty quantification. This uncertainty-aware strategy enables explicit filtering of model outputs, retaining only high-confidence MOAKS predictions at the knee level. Second, we applied a longitudinal latent class mixed model (LCMM) to examine associations between key structural abnormalities and four complementary knee pain measurements. Results: Among the three MRI-defined abnormalities (i.e., bone marrow lesions (BML), cartilage loss (CART), and meniscal extrusion (ME)), our framework substantially improved the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) and some other metrics. For example, MCC increased from 0.69 to 0.91 for BML, from 0.45 to 0.80 for CART, and from 0.59 to 0.89 for ME. Using these high-confidence predictions, we expanded the sample size to 2,175 knees for the LCMM analysis. Two distinct pain trajectories were identified (rapid and stable pain progression). The estimated odds ratios (95% CI) for the rapid progression group were 1.62 (1.12-2.35) for BML, 1.83 (1.24-2.70) for CART loss, and 2.50 (1.75-3.57) for ME. Conclusion: These results highlight the importance of these structural abnormalities as risk factors for pain and functional progression in osteoarthritis.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个可解释、可信赖的AI框架，将深度学习驱动的MOAKS评分预测与纵向潜在类别混合模型相结合，在大规模OAI数据上研究膝关节骨关节炎的结构-疼痛关系。通过引入共形预测进行不确定性量化，仅保留高置信度预测结果，最终揭示了BML、软骨丢失和半月板挤压是疼痛快速进展的重要风险因素。
AI.motivation: 骨关节炎研究中，膝关节MRI结构异常与疼痛之间的关系尚不完全明确，且手动MOAKS评分耗时耗力、难以大规模开展。作者旨在利用AI自动化MOAKS评分，并通过不确定性量化确保预测可靠性，从而在更大样本上以统计建模揭示结构-疼痛的纵向关联。
AI.method: （1）开发一个深度学习框架，直接从膝关节MRI预测MOAKS特征，并集成共形预测（conformal prediction）以量化预测不确定性，仅保留高置信度的预测结果；（2）使用纵向潜在类别混合模型（LCMM）分析三种关键结构异常（骨髓病变BML、软骨丢失CART、半月板挤压ME）与四种互补性膝关节疼痛测量指标之间的纵向关联。
AI.result: 不确定性过滤显著提升了MOAKS预测性能：BML的MCC从0.69提升至0.91，CART从0.45提升至0.80，ME从0.59提升至0.89。利用高置信度预测将LCMM分析样本扩大至2175例膝关节，识别出两条不同的疼痛轨迹（快速进展组和稳定进展组）。快速进展组的估计比值比（95%CI）分别为：BML 1.62（1.12-2.35）、CART丢失 1.83（1.24-2.70）、ME 2.50（1.75-3.57）。
AI.conclusion: 三种MRI结构异常（BML、软骨丢失、半月板挤压）被证实是骨关节炎疼痛和功能进展的重要风险因素，其中半月板挤压的关联最强。该AI框架通过不确定性感知策略实现了可靠的大规模自动化评分，为骨关节炎结构-疼痛关系研究提供了可推广的方法学范式。

title: Mitigating the Curse of Dimensionality in Uniform Convergence of Deep Neural Networks via Smooth Activations
summary: This paper establishes a theoretical framework for the uniform convergence of smoothly activated deep neural network (DNN) estimators. While standard ReLU networks achieve minimax-optimal rates in the $L^2(P)$ norm for various nonparametric regression tasks, we establish a theoretical lower bound demonstrating that least-squares ReLU estimators can suffer from the curse of dimensionality in their uniform convergence behavior. Motivated by the need for reliable uniform guarantees in downstream tasks requiring worst-case reliability, we address this limitation by analyzing smoothly activated DNNs (smooth DNNs), encompassing both feedforward and residual structures. We establish novel pseudo-dimension bounds, non-asymptotic approximation guarantees, and Hölder-norm bounds for the approximators of these models. Leveraging these results, we derive non-asymptotic uniform convergence rates for smooth DNN estimators across multiple statistical contexts, including Huber, least-squares, quantile, and logistic regression. We prove that smooth DNNs can mitigate the {curse of dimensionality} in uniform convergence by adaptively exploiting the low-dimensional hierarchical composition structure of the target function. Supported by both simulation studies and a real-world application, our results position smooth DNNs as a theoretically grounded and practically viable alternative to ReLU networks for statistical learning tasks requiring uniform guarantees.

AI.tldr: 本文为平滑激活深度神经网络估计量建立了一致收敛的理论框架，证明平滑DNN能够通过自适应利用目标函数的低维层次结构来规避一致收敛中的维度灾难，而标准ReLU网络在一致收敛下会遭受维度灾难。
AI.motivation: 标准ReLU网络虽在$L^2(P)$范数下对非参数回归任务能达到极小极大最优速率，但在需要最坏情况可靠性保障的下游任务中，其最小二乘估计量在一致收敛意义下会遭受维度灾难。这促使作者分析平滑激活DNN，以获取可靠的一致收敛保证。
AI.method: 作者为平滑DNN（含前馈和残差结构）建立了新颖的伪维度界、非渐近逼近保证以及逼近算子的Hölder范数界；基于这些结果，在Huber回归、最小二乘回归、分位数回归和Logistic回归等多种统计背景下，推导出平滑DNN估计量的非渐近一致收敛速率。
AI.result: 理论证明平滑DNN可通过自适应利用目标函数的低维层次组合结构来缓解一致收敛中的维度灾难；仿真研究与实际应用验证了平滑DNN作为ReLU网络替代方案的理论合理性与实际可行性。
AI.conclusion: 平滑DNN在需要一致收敛保证的统计学习任务中，是理论上严谨且实际可行的ReLU网络替代方案，为下游任务中可靠的不确定性量化和最坏情况性能保障奠定了基础。

title: Biomazon: A Multimodal Dataset for 3D Forest Structure and Biomass Modeling in the Amazon Basin
summary: Accurate, spatially explicit characterization of tropical forest structure is essential for carbon accounting and ecosystem monitoring, yet most ML pipelines predict canopy-top height proxies (e.g., RH95/RH98) or AGBD as separate scalar targets, rather than learning the forest vertical structure as an ordered profile. The community lacks a ML-ready multimodal benchmark for predicting the entire GEDI RH profile jointly with AGBD, or for evaluating methods that enforce physically consistent ordering across RH percentiles. We address this with Biomazon, a 20 m multimodal benchmark dataset over the Amazon Basin that pairs GEDI RH and AGBD targets with multi-sensor predictors (Sentinel-1/2, ALOS-2 PALSAR-2, Copernicus DEM, Dynamic World LULC, and AlphaEarth embeddings) under standardized spatial splits and evaluation protocols. Using a shared encoder-decoder with task-specific heads as a baseline framework, we conduct a comprehensive ablation study of (i) backbone/model scale, (ii) modality contributions, and (iii) the use of auxiliary embeddings under standalone and fusion settings, and we report both single-target and joint-target results to quantify tradeoffs under a unified training protocol. Finally, we contextualize baseline performance through regionally aligned comparisons against existing gridded products, including GEDI L4D RH10-RH98 and AGBD, at matching temporal scale. Biomazon, together with the accompanying protocols and baseline results, establishes a reference benchmark for future work on structurally consistent RH-profile prediction and structure-biomass modeling in tropical forests.

AI.tldr: 提出了 Biomazon，一个覆盖亚马逊流域的 20 米分辨率多模态基准数据集，用于联合预测 GEDI RH 垂直剖面和地上生物量密度 (AGBD)，并提供了基线框架和全面的消融实验结果。
AI.motivation: 当前大多数 ML 流程将森林冠层高度代理变量（如 RH95/RH98）或 AGBD 作为单独的标量目标进行预测，而非将森林垂直结构作为有序剖面进行学习。社区缺乏一个 ML 就绪的多模态基准，用于联合预测完整 GEDI RH 剖面与 AGBD，并评估保持 RH 百分位数物理一致排序的方法。
AI.method: 构建 Biomazon 基准数据集：将 GEDI RH 和 AGBD 目标与多传感器预测因子（Sentinel-1/2、ALOS-2 PALSAR-2、Copernicus DEM、Dynamic World LULC、AlphaEarth 嵌入）配对，采用标准化空间划分与评估协议。使用共享编码器-解码器架构加任务特定头作为基线框架，进行消融研究，考察 (i) 骨干网络/模型规模、(ii) 模态贡献、(iii) 辅助嵌入在独立与融合设置下的作用；报告单目标和联合目标结果，并与现有网格化产品（GEDI L4D RH10-RH98 和 AGBD）进行区域对齐比较。
AI.result: 在统一训练协议下量化了单目标与联合目标预测之间的权衡，并通过区域对齐比较将基线性能与现有网格化产品进行了对照，为后续研究建立了参考基准。
AI.conclusion: Biomazon 及其配套协议和基线结果为热带森林中结构一致的 RH 剖面预测和结构-生物量建模提供了标准化的参考基准。

title: Conformal Risk-Averse Decision Making with Action Conditional Guarantee
summary: Reliable decision making pipelines powered by machine learning models require uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods that come with explicit safety guarantees. Conformal prediction provides such UQ by wrapping ML predictions into prediction sets, and recent work by Kiyani et al. (2025b) established that these sets can be translated into optimal risk-averse decision policies -- yet only inheriting marginal safety guarantees. We generalize and strengthen their results by (i) introducing action-conditional conformal prediction, which yields safety guarantees conditioned explicitly on each action taken by the decision maker, (ii) showing that action-conditional prediction sets serve as a proxy for the feasible decision space for risk-averse decision makers aiming to optimize action-conditional value-at-risk, and (iii) proposing a principled finite-sample algorithm based on pinball-loss minimization, connecting the framework of Gibbs et al. (2025) to action-conditional guarantees. Experiments on two real-world datasets confirm that our approach significantly improves action-conditional performance over conformal baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出动作条件共形预测（action-conditional conformal prediction），将标准边际覆盖保证强化为显式以决策动作为条件的覆盖保证，并证明这种动作条件预测集可作为风险厌恶决策者优化动作条件VaR的可行决策空间代理，同时给出基于分位数损失的有限样本算法。
AI.motivation: 现有共形预测为决策策略提供的安全保证仅为边际保证（marginal guarantee），即覆盖概率在总体样本上平均成立，但无法保证对每个具体动作的条件覆盖。对于风险厌恶的决策者而言，需要在每个动作条件下都获得可靠的不确定性量化，因此需要将边际保证提升为动作条件保证。
AI.method: (i) 引入动作条件共形预测，使安全保证显式地以决策者采取的每个动作为条件；(ii) 证明动作条件预测集可作为风险厌恶决策者优化动作条件在险价值（action-conditional VaR）的可行决策空间代理；(iii) 基于分位数损失（pinball loss）最小化，提出一种有限样本算法，将Gibbs et al. (2025)的框架与动作条件保证相连接。
AI.result: 在两个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，所提方法在动作条件性能上显著优于共形预测基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过动作条件共形预测，成功将共形预测的边际保证推广为动作条件保证，为风险厌恶决策提供了更精细化的安全不确定性量化，且算法在有限样本下具有理论保障和良好的实证表现。

title: From Scoring to Explanations: Evaluating SHAP and LLM Rationales for Rubric-based Teaching Quality Assessment
summary: Automated scoring models are increasingly used to assign rubric-based quality ratings to complex language performances, including classroom transcripts, yet they typically provide little insight into why a particular score is produced. We propose a general framework for sentence-level interpretability of rubric-based scoring that combines model-agnostic Shapley-value attributions with rationales generated by large language models (LLMs). Instantiated on the Quality of Feedback dimension of the CLASS framework using the NCTE corpus, the framework enables systematic comparison of fine-tuned pretrained language models (PLMs) and prompted LLMs on both scoring performance and explanation faithfulness. Across 6k annotated transcript segments, fine-tuned PLMs outperform LLMs in prediction accuracy but exhibit label compression toward mid-scale scores. Deletion-based tests show that SHAP identifies sentences that reliably drive model predictions, producing typically larger and more coherent prediction shifts than LLM-generated rationales. Cross-model analyses further reveal that SHAP attributions transfer robustly across architectures, whereas LLM rationales exert limited and inconsistent influence. Overall, the findings demonstrate that SHAP provides more faithful and transferable explanations for rubric-based scoring, and that the proposed framework offers a principled basis for evaluating both scoring models and their explanations in high-stakes educational settings and other rubric-based language assessment tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个结合Shapley值归因与大语言模型（LLM）理由生成的框架，用于对基于评分标准的自动评分模型进行句子级可解释性分析。在CLASS评分框架下的课堂转录数据上，实验表明微调PLM预测更准确但存在标签压缩现象；SHAP归因比LLM理由更忠实、可迁移，且能更可靠地驱动模型预测变化。
AI.motivation: 自动评分模型在教育评估中日益普及，但缺乏透明性——它们无法解释为何给出某个分数。现有解释方法（如LLM生成理由）的可信度和忠实性未经系统检验，因此需要一套统一的框架来评估不同解释方法的忠实性和可迁移性。
AI.method: 提出一个句子级可解释性通用框架：首先利用模型无关的Shapley值计算每个句子对预测的归因分数；同时利用LLM为预测生成自然语言理由。框架实例化在CLASS评分框架的"反馈质量"维度上，使用NCTE语料库（约6k标注片段），系统比较微调PLM与提示LLM在评分性能和解释忠实性上的差异。忠实性采用删除测试（deletion-based tests）评估，即移除高归因句子观察预测偏移。
AI.result: （1）微调PLM在预测准确率上优于LLM，但存在向中间分数压缩的标签偏差；（2）SHAP识别的句子能可靠驱动模型预测，移除后产生比LLM理由更大、更连贯的预测偏移；（3）跨模型分析表明SHAP归因在不同架构间可稳健迁移，而LLM理由的跨模型影响有限且不一致。
AI.conclusion: SHAP为基于评分标准的自动评分提供了比LLM生成理由更忠实、更可迁移的解释。该框架为高利害教育评估及其他基于评分标准的语言评估任务中评分模型及其解释的评估提供了原则性基础。

title: Differentiable Efficient Operator Search
summary: Efficient multimodal foundation models often rely on manually designed token-reduction operators, such as pruning, merging, pooling, and adaptive reweighting. Although these operators appear different, we show that they can be interpreted as distinct regimes of a shared operator space. Based on this view, we introduce Efficient Operator Search, a differentiable framework that jointly searches where to reduce tokens, how many tokens to retain, and how reduced token information should be processed. The proposed search space parameterizes layer activation, retention budget, and operator behavior, while the search policy optimizes task performance under one-sided budget and cost constraints. This formulation recovers representative hand-designed baselines as special cases and further discovers hybrid operators beyond isolated manual designs. Experiments on multimodal benchmarks show that the searched operators achieve competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-offs, especially under aggressive visual-token reduction. These results suggest that efficient multimodal inference can be reframed from manual operator design to differentiable operator search.

AI.tldr: 本文提出高效算子搜索（Efficient Operator Search），将多模态基础模型中手工设计的令牌缩减算子统一到可微搜索框架中，联合搜索缩减位置、保留数量和融合方式，在激进视觉令牌压缩下取得有竞争力的精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态基础模型依赖人工设计的令牌缩减算子（剪枝、合并、池化、自适应加权），这些算子看似各异但本质共享一个算子空间。手工设计难以穷尽所有组合，且缺乏系统性地联合优化缩减位置、保留数量和融合策略。
AI.method: 提出可微算子搜索框架，将层激活状态、令牌保留预算和算子行为参数化到一个统一的搜索空间中，搜索策略在单边预算和成本约束下优化任务性能。该框架将手工设计的基线方法恢复为特例，并能发现混合算子。
AI.result: 在多模态基准实验中，搜索出的算子实现了有竞争力的精度-效率权衡，尤其在激进的视觉令牌缩减下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 高效多模态推理可从手工算子设计转向可微算子搜索范式，为该领域提供了新的研究思路。

title: Synthetic Contrastive Reasoning for Multi-Table Q&A
summary: Multi-table question answering requires models to retrieve relevant evidence, link schemas, and perform compositional reasoning across relational tables. Existing multi-table Q&A resources typically provide questions and final answers but lack reasoning supervision that explains how answers are derived. To address this gap, we construct a synthetic contrastive reasoning-trace dataset for MMQA by generating validated positive traces and plausible negative traces with heterogeneous LLMs. We then use the resulting preference pairs to fine-tune open-weight LLMs with Contrastive Preference Optimization (CPO). Across Qwen3-14B, Mistral-8B, and Llama-3.1-8B, CPO achieves absolute average improvements over Q&A supervised fine-tuning ranging from 9.7%-16.3%, with gains up to 21 percentage points on MMQA. Ablations show that heterogeneous positive and negative trace generators strengthen the contrastive signal, and automated as well as human evaluations indicate that the generated pairs are largely faithful, coherent, and meaningfully contrastive.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个合成的对比推理轨迹数据集用于多表问答（MMQA），通过异构LLM生成经过验证的正例轨迹和合理的负例轨迹，然后使用对比偏好优化（CPO）微调开源LLM，在多个模型上取得了9.7%-16.3%的平均绝对提升，MMQA上最高提升21个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有多表问答资源通常只提供问题和最终答案，缺乏解释答案推导过程的推理监督信号。这限制了对模型进行更精细推理能力训练的可能性。
AI.method: 使用异构LLM生成经过验证的正确推理轨迹（正例）和看似合理但存在错误的推理轨迹（负例），构建偏好对数据集；然后利用这些偏好对，通过对比偏好优化（CPO）对开源权重LLM进行微调，强化对比信号。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-14B、Mistral-8B和Llama-3.1-8B上，CPO相比标准监督微调（SFT）实现了9.7%-16.3%的绝对平均提升，在MMQA数据集上最高提升达21个百分点。消融实验表明异构的正例和负例轨迹生成器能增强对比信号，自动评估和人工评估均显示生成的偏好对具有较高的忠实性、连贯性和有意义的对比性。
AI.conclusion: 通过构建对比推理轨迹数据集并结合CPO微调，可以显著提升多表问答中的推理能力。异构生成器产生的正负例轨迹是强化对比信号的关键，生成的偏好对质量可靠。

title: Anchor PCA
summary: Principal component analysis (PCA) is one of the most widely used unsupervised dimension reduction techniques. We study PCA for data from multiple related domains. Since principal components generally differ across domains, one way to obtain a shared low-rank embedding is to perform PCA on the pooled data. However, this approach can focus on spurious directions that exhibit high variation in only a few domains. To find a robust embedding that still explains most variance in unseen but similar domains, we propose instead to focus on shared directions of variation. To this end, we introduce Anchor PCA which trades off overall explained variance with agreement between the shared and domain-specific low-rank embeddings. Anchor PCA amounts to PCA on a modified target matrix and thus can be solved efficiently. Moreover, we show that Anchor PCA recovers a maximal invariant subspace and admits a minimax reconstruction interpretation under bounded domain-specific covariance inflations. On simulated and real-world gas sensor data with temporal drift, we demonstrate, respectively, that Anchor PCA recovers the maximally invariant subspace and yields embeddings that explain more variance on unseen domains than the pooling baseline and a worst-case alternative. Taken together, these findings establish Anchor PCA as a promising approach to robust unsupervised dimension reduction from multi-domain data.

AI.tldr: Anchor PCA 是一种面向多域数据的鲁棒无监督降维方法，通过在整体解释方差与共享/域特定低秩嵌入之间权衡，寻找共享的变异方向。它等价于对修正目标矩阵做 PCA，可高效求解，能恢复最大不变子空间，并在未见域上优于池化 PCA 和最坏情况替代方案。
AI.motivation: 传统池化 PCA 在多域数据上可能捕捉仅在少数域中变异大的虚假方向，导致在未见域上泛化差。需要一个能发现跨域共享变异方向、在未见但相似域上仍能解释大部分方差的鲁棒嵌入方法。
AI.method: 提出 Anchor PCA，通过优化目标在整体解释方差与共享嵌入和域特定嵌入之间的一致性之间进行权衡。该方法等价于对修正后的目标矩阵执行 PCA，计算高效；理论上可恢复最大不变子空间，并在有界域特定协方差膨胀下具有极小极大重构解释。
AI.result: 在模拟数据和带有时间漂移的 real-world 气体传感器数据上，Anchor PCA 恢复了最大不变子空间，且在未见域上解释的方差超过池化基线方法和最坏情况替代方案。
AI.conclusion: Anchor PCA 是一种有前景的多域数据鲁棒无监督降维方法，兼具理论保证和实证有效性。

title: Three-Dimensional Retinal Microvasculature Restoration in OCT Angiography
summary: Optical coherence tomographic angiography (OCTA) is a powerful technique for imaging retinal microvasculature. However, acquiring reliable quantification of retinal blood flow and areas of retinal nonperfusion is challenging because of imaging artifacts. Existing methods primarily focus on noise suppression, projection artifact removal, or signal enhancement to improve the image quality of OCTA in cross-sectional or two-dimensional (2D) en face projections, while neglecting the intrinsic three-dimensional vascular architecture. In this study, we propose a deep learning-based algorithm for restoring capillary anatomical vasculature from a single OCTA volume. The network consists of an EfficientNet-B5 encoder and a decoder incorporating concurrent spatial and channel squeeze-and-excitation modules, connected via skip connections to preserve spatial resolution. Three adjacent B-frames are used as input to predict the restored middle B-frame. We evaluated the performance of the model using the peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and structural similarity index measure (SSIM) against ground truth generated from averaging multiple scans. The results show that the proposed model significantly (both p < 0.001) improved image quality compared with the original single OCTA volume, with a PSNR of 26.16 +/- 1.26 vs. 22.23 +/- 0.78 and an SSIM of 0.91 +/- 0.02 vs. 0.72 +/- 0.03. The proposed model also significantly (p < 0.001) improved microvascular fidelity, measured by the Dice coefficient overlap between the model output and ground truth, in both 2D and 3D by at least 3.8% and 51.2%, respectively, across several different vascular slabs.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于深度学习的OCTA体积数据毛细血管解剖结构恢复算法，使用EfficientNet-B5编码器和含scSE模块的解码器，以三帧相邻B-frame预测中间帧，在PSNR、SSIM和Dice系数上均显著优于原始单次扫描体积。
AI.motivation: 现有OCTA图像质量提升方法主要关注噪声抑制、投影伪影去除或信号增强，且多局限于二维en face投影或横截面，忽略了OCTA数据内在的三维血管结构，导致视网膜血流定量和不可灌注区域检测的可靠性不足。
AI.method: 提出一种深度学习算法，从单次OCTA体积恢复毛细血管解剖结构。网络架构：EfficientNet-B5编码器 + 带并发空间与通道squeeze-and-excitation (scSE) 模块的解码器，通过跳跃连接保留空间分辨率。输入为三帧相邻B-frame，输出为恢复后的中间B-frame。以多次扫描平均作为金标准，采用PSNR和SSIM评估图像质量，以Dice系数评估二维和三维微血管保真度。
AI.result: 相比原始单次OCTA体积，所提模型显著提升图像质量（p均<0.001）：PSNR为26.16±1.26 vs. 22.23±0.78；SSIM为0.91±0.02 vs. 0.72±0.03。微血管保真度同样显著提升（p<0.001）：在不同血管分层中，二维Dice系数至少提高3.8%，三维Dice系数至少提高51.2%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于3D血管结构感知的深度学习恢复算法能有效从单次OCTA扫描中恢复毛细血管解剖结构，在图像质量和微血管保真度上均显著优于原始图像，有助于提高视网膜微血管定量分析的可靠性。

title: Finding Most Influential Sets
comment: Published as a conference paper at ICML 2026
summary: Identifying most influential sets (MIS) - size-$k$ subsets whose removal maximally changes a target estimand - is typically infeasible because it requires searching over $\binom{n}{k}$ subsets. For estimands with linear-fractional leave-set-out effects, we show that MIS selection reduces to a one-parameter sequence of top-$k$ problems. Dinkelbach's method yields an algorithm with $\mathcal{O}(n)$ cost per iteration and finite termination. For fixed residualized inputs, the algorithm returns a globally optimal set for the univariate ratio objective, including the oracle-residualized partial linear model. With estimated nuisance functions, uniform denominator and generated-score stability imply approximation to the first-order oracle orthogonal-score objective; exact set recovery follows under a separation condition. Simulations and applications show that the method recovers exact MIS that were previously computationally inaccessible.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了在移除特定子集后目标估计量变化最大的"最有影响集"（MIS）选择问题的高效算法。针对具有线性分式留出效应结构的估计量，作者将MIS选择转化为一系列单参数top-k问题，利用Dinkelbach方法实现每轮迭代仅需O(n)代价且有限步终止的算法，并证明了在固定残差输入下的全局最优性及在估计 nuisance 函数下的近似最优性。
AI.motivation: 识别数据中对统计估计量影响最大的k个点组成的子集（MIS）在实际中极具价值，但暴力搜索所有组合在计算上不可行（规模为C(n,k)）。现有方法要么依赖近似算法，要么受限于特定模型，缺乏对一般线性分式留出效应结构下的精确且高效求解方案。
AI.method: 作者首先证明当目标估计量具有线性分式留出效应（即移除集合S后的估计量变化可表示为线性函数与分母之比）时，MIS问题可简化为单参数族top-k排序问题。随后采用Dinkelbach参数化方法将分式优化转化为一系列线性子问题，每步迭代只需O(n)计算代价，且算法保证有限步收敛。在固定残差化输入下，算法给出单变量比值目标的全局最优集，涵盖oracle残差化部分线性模型。当使用估计的nuisance函数时，在均匀分母和生成分数稳定性条件下，算法近似于渐近线性（正交）分数目标，并在分离条件下实现精确集合恢复。
AI.result: 算法在每次迭代中仅需O(n)代价，且有限步终止。对于固定残差输入，可保证返回全局最优MIS。对于估计的nuisance函数情形，在给定条件下可近似一阶oracle正交分数目标，并在分离条件下精确恢复MIS。仿真和应用表明，该方法能够恢复此前计算上不可达的精确MIS，验证了理论性质。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次将MIS选择与分式优化理论建立联系，利用Dinkelbach方法实现了对一类广泛估计量的精确MIS识别，突破了此前计算瓶颈。该方法兼具理论最优性保证与计算高效性，为影响力分析、异常检测、稳健统计推断等应用提供了实用工具。

title: Multi-Granularity Reasoning for Natural Language Inference
summary: Natural Language Inference (NLI) is a fundamental task in natural language understanding that requires determining the logical relationship between a premise and a hypothesis. Despite the remarkable success of transformer-based pre-trained models, most existing approaches primarily rely on the final-layer token representations, which are often insufficient for capturing the complex and hierarchical semantic interactions required for effective reasoning. In particular, fine-grained lexical cues, phrasal compositions, and higher-level contextual semantics are typically entangled or diluted in a single representation space. To address these limitations, we propose a novel \emph{Multi-Granularity Reasoning Network} (MGRN) that explicitly leverages hierarchical semantic features within an interactive reasoning space. The proposed framework mimics the human cognitive process of language understanding, which naturally progresses from shallow lexical matching to deeper semantic abstraction and logical reasoning. By integrating semantic information across multiple granularities in a progressive and structured manner, MGRN is able to uncover intricate semantic relationships underlying natural language expressions. Extensive experiments on multiple public benchmarks demonstrate that MGRN consistently outperforms strong baseline models, validating the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多粒度推理网络（MGRN），通过显式利用预训练模型中的层级语义特征，模拟人类从浅层词汇匹配到深层语义抽象的认知过程，以提升自然语言推理（NLI）任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Transformer的NLI方法大多仅依赖最后一层的token表示，这种单一表征空间难以充分捕获细粒度词汇线索、短语组合以及高层上下文语义之间的复杂交互，导致层级语义信息被纠缠或稀释。
AI.method: 提出多粒度推理网络（MGRN），模拟人类语言理解的认知过程，以渐进式、结构化的方式整合多层级的语义信息：从浅层词汇匹配逐步过渡到深层语义抽象和逻辑推理，在交互式推理空间中显式利用层级语义特征。
AI.result: 在多个公开基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，MGRN一致优于强基线模型，验证了所提方法的有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: MGRN通过多粒度层级语义的渐进式整合，有效弥补了单一最终层表示的不足，为NLI任务提供了一种更符合人类认知过程的推理范式。

title: DiffSlack: Learning under Nonlinear Inequality Constraints via Learnable Slack Variables
summary: Enforcing nonlinear inequality constraints in neural networks remains challenging, especially when the output is subject to many coupled constraints. Existing hard constraint methods often impose structural restrictions on the constraint set or introduce substantial computational overhead for large-scale nonlinear problems. Here, we propose DiffSlack, a differentiable projection layer for nonlinear inequality-constrained neural prediction. DiffSlack reformulates inequalities as equalities with learnable slack variables, which are predicted as part of the augmented network output and provide a data-driven warm start for damped Gauss-Newton projection. The projection layer maps raw predictions onto the augmented feasible manifold while preserving end-to-end differentiability. A two-stage curriculum further stabilizes training and improves constraint satisfaction. We evaluate DiffSlack on vehicle path planning with 200 nonlinear inequality constraints from collision avoidance, curvature limits, and waypoint spacing. Compared with existing learning-based baselines, DiffSlack achieves a higher planning success rate and stronger geometric constraint satisfaction under a comparable inference budget. Ablation studies further show that the hard projection layer reduces sensitivity to supervision quality. Closed-loop tracking in CARLA and real-world vehicle experiments confirms the executability of the generated trajectories. These results demonstrate that DiffSlack provides a practical and scalable approach to embedding hard inequality constraints into neural networks for engineering applications.

AI.tldr: DiffSlack 是一种可微投影层，通过将非线性不等式约束转化为带可学习松弛变量的等式，并结合阻尼高斯-牛顿投影，实现神经网络输出的硬约束满足，在车辆路径规划等工程应用中展现出良好的可扩展性和实用性。
AI.motivation: 现有神经网络硬约束方法在处理大规模、耦合的非线性不等式约束时，往往要么对约束集施加结构性限制，要么引入高昂的计算开销，缺乏一种兼具灵活性、可扩展性和端到端可微性的通用方案。
AI.method: 提出 DiffSlack 框架：(1) 将不等式约束重构为等式，引入可学习松弛变量，由网络一并预测，为后续投影提供数据驱动的暖启动；(2) 构建可微投影层，利用阻尼高斯-牛顿法将原始预测映射到增广的可行流形上，保持端到端可微性；(3) 采用两阶段课程学习策略，先宽松后收紧约束，稳定训练过程并提升约束满足率。
AI.result: 在包含 200 个非线性不等式约束（碰撞避免、曲率限制、航点间距）的车辆路径规划任务上，DiffSlack 相比现有学习方法取得了更高的规划成功率和更强的几何约束满足度，且推理开销相当。消融实验表明硬投影层降低了对监督质量的敏感性。CARLA 闭环跟踪和实车实验验证了生成轨迹的可执行性。
AI.conclusion: DiffSlack 为将硬不等式约束嵌入神经网络提供了一种实用且可扩展的方法，适用于对约束满足有严格要求的工程应用场景。

title: Stability vs. Manipulability: Evaluating Robustness Under Post-Decision Interaction in LLM Judges
comment: Accepted at ACL 2026 GEM (Generation, Evaluation and Metrics) Workshop
summary: LLM-as-judge evaluation is widely used in benchmarking pipelines, where model outputs are compared and ranked using automated evaluators. These pipelines typically assume that judgments are stable properties of fixed inputs. We show that this assumption does not hold under interaction. We study post-decision manipulability: the extent to which an evaluation outcome can be altered through subsequent conversation with the judge after an initial decision has been made. Across controlled experiments on MT-Bench and AlpacaEval, we find that LLM judges are highly stable under repeated and neutral reevaluation, yet become substantially reversible under targeted post-decision challenge. An anti-baseline challenge protocol shows that stable judgments can be overturned through motivated interaction, while a counterbalanced target-validation protocol separates this reversibility from net target-directed steering. These reversals have practical consequences: they can degrade agreement with human preferences, shift benchmark rankings, and produce harmful evaluation changes despite high self-reported confidence. Authority framing is especially destabilizing, and revised judgments are often accompanied by low-overlap justifications, suggesting post hoc rationalization rather than reliable error correction. We introduce the Evaluation Robustness Score (ERS) to quantify interactional robustness by combining reversal susceptibility with counterbalanced directional effects. Our findings identify post-decision interaction as a distinct failure mode for LLM-as-judge evaluation and motivate evaluation protocols that measure not only static agreement, but robustness under challenge.

AI.tldr: 研究发现LLM-as-judge评估中，已做出的评判可通过后续交互被显著逆转，即便在重复中立再评估下保持稳定。这种“决策后可操纵性”会降低与人类偏好的一致性、改变基准排名，且权威框架尤其具有破坏性。作者提出评估鲁棒性分数(ERS)来量化交互鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM-as-judge评估管道假定评判结果是固定输入的稳定属性，但现实场景中用户常与评判模型进行多轮交互。作者质疑这一稳定性假设在多轮交互场景下是否成立，尤其是初始决策后通过后续对话进行操纵的可能性尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 在MT-Bench和AlpacaEval基准上进行受控实验：(1)重复中立再评估测试稳定性；(2)设计anti-baseline挑战协议，用有动机的交互尝试推翻已有评判；(3)设计counterbalanced target-validation协议，分离可逆性与定向引导效应；(4)操控权威性框架(权威性引用、自信表达等)测试其对稳定性的影响；(5)分析修订评判的理由重叠度；(6)提出ERS指标综合衡量逆转敏感性与定向效应。
AI.result: LLM评判在重复中立再评估下高度稳定，但在目标导向的决策后挑战下显著可逆。Anti-baseline协议成功推翻稳定评判；counterbalanced协议证实逆转并非单纯由定向引导驱动。评判逆转带来实际后果：降低与人类偏好的对齐度、改变基准排名、高自信下仍产生有害评估变化。权威框架尤其破坏稳定性，修订后的评判理由与原始理由重叠度低，暗示事后合理化而非真实纠错。
AI.conclusion: 决策后交互是LLM-as-judge评估中一个独特的失效模式。评估协议不仅应衡量静态一致性，更需测量挑战下的鲁棒性。ERS指标为量化交互鲁棒性提供了可行工具。

title: Deep Learning-assisted AMD Staging based on OCT and OCT Angiography
summary: To develop and evaluate deep learning models for automated grading of age-related macular degeneration (AMD) severity using optical coherence tomography (OCT) and OCT angiography (OCTA) data. Two hundred seventy-one participants aged >= 50 years with varying AMD severities. Central macular 6 x 6 mm OCT/OCTA volumes were acquired using a swept-source OCTA system (SOLIX; Visionix/Optovue Inc., CA). AMD severity was graded into four stages (No AMD, Early AMD, Intermediate AMD, and Advanced AMD) according to the AREDS simplified severity scale. Three deep learning models were developed using different input modalities: (1) biomarker maps derived from segmented pathological features, including retinal fluid, drusen, geographic atrophy (GA), and macular neovascularization (MNV); (2) two-dimensional (2D) en face OCT and OCTA projections; and (3) three-dimensional (3D) OCT/OCTA volumes. EfficientNet-based architectures were trained using normalized inputs, data augmentation, and five-fold cross-validation. A total of 2,030 OCT/OCTA volumes from 351 eyes of 271 participants were analyzed. All models demonstrated strong AMD staging performance with substantial agreement with the reference standard (QWK >= 0.83). The biomarker-based model achieved the highest overall performance (QWK = 0.85 +/- 0.03, mean +/- standard deviation) and the best detection of early AMD (F1-score = 0.59 +/- 0.14). The 3D model achieved performance comparable to the 2D OCT/OCTA model (QWK = 0.83 +/- 0.04 vs. 0.83 +/- 0.09), while the 2D OCT/OCTA model showed the highest precision (0.79 +/- 0.06) and most accurately identified eyes without AMD. Deep learning models using OCT/OCTA data can accurately and automatically grade AMD severity. Among the evaluated approaches, the biomarker-based model provided the most balanced performance and showed particular value for early AMD detection.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了三种基于OCT/OCTA数据的深度学习模型用于AMD严重程度自动分级（无AMD、早期、中期、晚期），其中基于病理生物标志物图谱的模型表现最优（QWK=0.85），尤其在早期AMD检测方面具有优势。
AI.motivation: 年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD）是全球致盲的主要原因之一，其严重程度的准确分级对治疗决策至关重要。然而，目前依赖于人工判读的AMD分级存在主观性强、效率低的问题，亟需基于OCT/OCTA多模态影像的自动化分级方法，以提高诊断准确性和一致性。
AI.method: 纳入271名≥50岁的受试者（351眼，共2,030个OCT/OCTA容积数据），根据AREDS简化严重程度量表分为四级。开发三种EfficientNet架构的深度学习模型：（1）基于分割病理特征（视网膜积液、玻璃膜疣、地图样萎缩、黄斑新生血管）生成的生物标志物图谱；（2）二维en face OCT/OCTA投影；（3）三维OCT/OCTA容积。采用归一化输入、数据增强及五折交叉验证进行评估。
AI.result: 所有模型均与参考标准达到高度一致（QWK ≥ 0.83）。生物标志物模型总体性能最优（QWK=0.85±0.03），早期AMD检测F1-score最高（0.59±0.14）。3D模型与2D OCT/OCTA模型性能相当（QWK分别为0.83±0.04和0.83±0.09），2D模型精确度最高（0.79±0.06），在识别无AMD眼方面最准确。
AI.conclusion: 基于OCT/OCTA数据的深度学习模型可准确自动分级AMD严重程度。其中，生物标志物驱动的方法在整体平衡性和早期AMD检测方面表现最佳，具有较好的临床应用前景。

title: EML-CD: Causal Mechanism Recovery via EML Symbolic Trees in Structure Learning
summary: Neural network (NN)-based nonlinear causal discovery methods recover DAG structure but leave each causal mechanism as a black box. Waxman et al. argued that extracting causal mechanisms from NN weights is ill-posed. We propose EML-CD, a framework that integrates the EML operator (capable of composing elementary functions from a single binary operator) into causal structure learning, with interpretable mechanism recovery as the primary objective. EML-CD represents each edge mechanism as a gated EML binary tree and automatically discovers closed-form causal equations. Analytical Jacobians can be directly computed from the output equations, enabling quantitative understanding of causal effects. On real data (Sachs protein signaling, d=11), EML-CD achieves SHD=11.2 +/- 0.4 (5-seed mean; baselines are single deterministic runs), on par with PC/GES within seed variance and below CAM, while attaching closed-form equations to each detected edge (precision 0.756, recall 0.365). In a controlled bivariate test with known mechanisms, EML-CD recovers 10 of 11 elementary function families faithfully (held-out shape correlation >= 0.96; only high-frequency sine is partial). On a symbolic synthetic benchmark, EML-CD attains a substantially lower and more stable held-out mechanism f-MSE than a fixed SINDy dictionary (mean 3.67 vs. 7644, the latter inflated by catastrophic extrapolation on one seed), although its structure recovery (SHD 14.0) only matches the dictionary and stays below specialized optimizers; on the Causal Chambers light-tunnel subset, a depth-2 model improves F1 over linear OLS-BIC (0.444 vs. 0.273).

AI.tldr: EML-CD 将可解释的机制恢复整合进因果结构学习，用门控 EML 二叉树表示每条边的因果机制，自动发现闭式方程。在 Sachs 蛋白数据上 SHD=11.2，与 PC/GES 持平；在双变量测试中恢复 11 类基本函数中的 10 类；在符号合成基准上机制外推远优于固定 SINDy 字典。
AI.motivation: 现有基于神经网络的非线性因果发现方法虽能恢复 DAG 结构，但每个因果机制仍是黑箱。Waxman 等人指出从 NN 权重中提取因果机制本身是不适定问题。因此需要一种既能学习因果结构、又能以可解释闭式方程恢复因果机制的方法。
AI.method: 提出 EML-CD 框架，核心是将 EML 算子（能通过单一二元算子组合初等函数）嵌入因果结构学习。每条边的因果机制表示为一棵门控 EML 二叉树，自动搜索并发现闭式因果方程。分析雅可比矩阵可直接从输出方程计算，实现对因果效应的定量理解。
AI.result: 在 Sachs 蛋白信号数据（d=11）上，SHD=11.2±0.4（5 种子均值），与 PC/GES 在种子方差内持平，低于 CAM，并为每条检测边赋予闭式方程（精度 0.756，召回 0.365）。双变量受控测试中忠实恢复 11 类基本函数中的 10 类（留出形状相关性 ≥0.96，仅高频正弦部分恢复）。符号合成基准上，留出机制 f-MSE 远低于且更稳定于固定 SINDy 字典（均值 3.67 vs. 7644，后者因一次灾难性外推而膨胀）；结构恢复 SHD=14.0 仅匹配字典，不及专用优化器。在 Causal Chambers 光隧道子集上，深度-2 模型 F1 优于线性 OLS-BIC（0.444 vs. 0.273）。
AI.conclusion: EML-CD 成功将因果机制的可解释恢复与结构学习统一，在多类基准上验证了其发现闭式因果方程的能力，且在机制外推稳定性上显著优于固定字典方法，为黑箱因果发现向白箱可解释建模提供了有效路径。

title: LANTERN: Layered Archival and Temporal Episodic Retrieval Network for Long-Context LLM Conversations
summary: Large language models discard critical details when conversation history is compacted to fit within finite context windows. We present LANTERN (Layered Archival aNd Temporal Episodic Retrieval Network), a lightweight memory layer that proactively archives every conversation turn and restores relevant details after compaction via hybrid retrieval -- requiring zero LLM calls and adding fewer than 25ms of latency per turn. On 94 real multi-turn conversations (1,894 ground-truth facts, human-validated at kappa=0.81), LANTERN-Rerank recovers 78.3% of verifiable facts lost to compaction, significantly outperforming a faithful reimplementation of MemGPT's LLM-driven extraction and multi-query search pipeline (72.4%; Wilcoxon p<0.0001, 95% CI [+3.1, +8.6] pp, d=0.43) at a fraction of the inference cost. Even without the reranker, base LANTERN matches or exceeds this LLM-driven baseline (p=0.005) using zero LLM calls. When four production LLMs answer fact-bearing questions using LANTERN-restored context, accuracy improves by 8.4 percentage points on average (Wilcoxon p<0.05 for each model individually), demonstrating that the recovered context is useful across diverse model architectures. We release the full evaluation framework -- paired significance tests, failure analysis, fact-type stratification, and compaction robustness analysis -- to support reproducibility and future work.

AI.tldr: LANTERN 是一种轻量级记忆层，通过混合检索主动归档每轮对话并恢复压缩后丢失的细节，无需调用LLM，延迟低于25ms。实验表明其在事实恢复率（78.3%）上显著优于基于LLM驱动的MemGPT方案（72.4%），且将恢复后的上下文用于四种生产级LLM时，回答准确率平均提升8.4个百分点。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型在处理多轮对话时，受限于有限的上下文窗口，必须压缩历史对话，这导致大量关键细节丢失。现有解决方案（如MemGPT）依赖LLM自身进行记忆提取和检索，成本高、延迟大。作者旨在提出一种零LLM调用、低延迟的记忆层来主动保存并恢复被压缩丢失的信息。
AI.method: 提出LANTERN（Layered Archival aNd Temporal Episodic Retrieval Network），包含三个核心设计：(1) 主动归档：将每轮对话结构化存储为"档案记忆"；(2) 分层时序检索：压缩发生后，通过混合检索（稀疏+稠密）从档案中召回相关事实；(3) 可选的Rerank模块（LANTERN-Rerank）进一步提升召回精度。整个过程无需任何LLM调用，每轮仅增加不到25ms延迟。
AI.result: 在94个真实多轮对话（含1,894个人工验证的事实标注，Cohen's κ=0.81）上：LANTERN-Rerank恢复78.3%的压缩丢失可验证事实，显著优于复现的MemGPT LLM驱动管线（72.4%；Wilcoxon p<0.0001, 95% CI [+3.1, +8.6] pp, d=0.43）；基础版LANTERN（无Rerank）以零LLM调用匹配甚至超过LLM基线（p=0.005）；四种生产级LLM使用LANTERN恢复的上下文后，事实回答准确率平均提升8.4个百分点（每个模型单独检验p<0.05）。
AI.conclusion: LANTERN证明轻量级、零LLM调用的记忆层可以在极低延迟下有效恢复压缩丢失的对话事实，且恢复的上下文对不同架构的LLM均具有通用价值。作者同时开源了完整评估框架以促进可复现研究。

title: Alpha-RTL: Test-Time Training for RTL Hardware Optimization
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) have shown increasing promise in generating
  functionally correct register-transfer-level (RTL) hardware designs.
  Recent systems improve further through EDA-integrated reinforcement
  learning with syntax, simulation, and PPA rewards, but train a general
  RTL generator before deployment while test-time approaches search with
  a frozen policy. We instead perform reinforcement learning at test time,
  allowing the LLM policy to adapt to executable EDA feedback for the
  specific RTL problem at hand. We propose TTT-RTL, to our knowledge the
  first per-design test-time training framework that closes the loop
  between an LLM policy and an EDA pipeline for RTL optimization. TTT-RTL
  samples candidate implementations, verifies them through syntax checking
  and simulation, scores valid designs using synthesis-derived PPA product,
  reuses high-reward variants through a PUCT-indexed design-state pool,
  and updates the policy with an entropic policy-gradient objective. To
  stabilize policy updates under sparse or plateaued rewards, we introduce
  an adaptive KL-budget controller that adjusts the entropy constraint
  using reference KL, effective sample size, and reward saturation signals.
  On RTLLM v2.0 under Nangate 45nm, TTT-RTL reduces the geometric-mean
  PPA product by 65.1% over the reference, outperforming the strongest
  published frozen-policy agent baseline at 26.1%. On an industrial
  XuanTie C910 FPU leading-zero-anticipation unit under Sky130, TTT-RTL
  achieves a 59.4% ADP reduction, and ablations confirm that policy
  adaptation, state reuse, and KL-budget control each contribute. These
  results suggest that test-time training with executable EDA feedback can
  move LLM-based RTL generation beyond functional correctness toward
  physically optimized hardware.

AI.tldr: TTT-RTL 提出首个面向特定RTL设计的测试时训练框架，通过在线强化学习结合EDA反馈（语法检查、仿真、PPA评估），利用PUCT索引设计状态池、熵策略梯度目标及自适应KL预算控制器，在RTLLM v2.0和玄铁C910 FPU上分别实现65.1%和59.4%的PPA/ADP优化，显著超越冻结策略基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM生成RTL的方法要么在部署前训练通用生成器，要么在测试时使用冻结策略搜索，无法针对特定设计任务在线适应EDA反馈。本文旨在填补这一空白，实现测试时策略自适应优化。
AI.method: TTT-RTL框架：(1)从LLM策略采样候选RTL实现；(2)经语法检查和仿真验证；(3)用综合产生的PPA乘积评分有效设计；(4)通过PUCT索引的设计状态池复用高奖励变体；(5)以熵策略梯度目标更新策略；(6)引入自适应KL预算控制器，利用参考KL散度、有效样本量和奖励饱和信号调节熵约束，以稳定稀疏/平台奖励下的策略更新。
AI.result: 在Nangate 45nm工艺的RTLLM v2.0基准上，几何平均PPA乘积较参考降低65.1%，优于最强冻结策略基线的26.1%；在Sky130工艺的玄铁C910 FPU前导零预测单元上，ADP降低59.4%。消融实验证实策略自适应、状态复用和KL预算控制均有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 测试时训练结合可执行EDA反馈，能将LLM-based RTL生成从功能正确推向物理优化，证明在线策略自适应在硬件设计空间探索中的有效性。

title: Residual Modeling for High-Fidelity Learned Compression of Scientific Data
summary:
Lossy compression is essential for massive spatiotemporal data from scientific simulations. Learned compressors can achieve high compression ratios at moderate accuracy targets, but their aggregate reconstruction losses do not guarantee accuracy for each block. Existing Guaranteed Autoencoder (GAE) methods add a per-block residual correction by retaining SVD/PCA-style coefficients until the target is met. This works at moderate tolerances, but in the high-fidelity regime with block-level NRMSE from 10^-6 to 10^-4, the number of retained coefficients grows quickly and the correction stream dominates the total rate.
  We propose a residual-centric view: the learned residual is structurally different from the original scientific field and should be coded with a representation designed for that residual. We introduce two residual coders. LBRC is a deterministic, training-free pipeline that adaptively quantizes the learned residual to the target NRMSE and losslessly encodes the resulting integer residual using 3D Lorenzo differencing, zigzag mapping, bit-plane coding, and entropy coding. NGLR adds a causal neural predictor that outputs a normalized bias for an integer-rounded Lorenzo prediction in the same deterministic integer pipeline, reducing the entropy of the remaining residual code while preserving deterministic decoding. The predictor weights are serialized and counted in the bitstream.
  Across E3SM, JHTDB, and ERA5 at block-level NRMSE targets from 10^-6 to 10^-4, LBRC improves compression ratio over GAE by 30-60% and is broadly competitive with SZ. NGLR adds a further 10-40% over LBRC and outperforms SZ in the evaluated high-fidelity regime. These results show that residual representations tailored to learned-compressor residuals can preserve the advantage of learned compression when global residual correction becomes rate-dominant.

AI.tldr: 本文针对科学模拟海量时空数据的学得压缩器在高保真场景下的不足，提出以残差为中心的设计视角，设计了 LBRC（无损/自适应量化的确定性格）和 NGLR（加入因果神经预测器）两种残差编码器，在块级 NRMSE 10^-6~10^-4 范围内显著提升压缩比，超越 GAE 和 SZ。
AI.motivation: 现有学得压缩器（如 GAE）在中等精度下效果良好，但在高保真（NRMSE 10^-6~10^-4）场景中，逐块残差校正所需的 SVD/PCA 系数数量急剧增长，导致校正码流占据主导，压缩效率严重下降。核心动机是：学得残差与原始科学场在结构上存在本质差异，需要专门为其设计编码表示，而非直接沿用面向原始场的编码策略。
AI.method: 提出残差中心视角，设计两种残差编码器：(1) LBRC：确定性的免训练管线，对学得残差做自适应量化以满足目标 NRMSE，再经 3D Lorenzo 差分、zigzag 映射、位平面编码和熵编码实现无损压缩；(2) NGLR：在 LBRC 的整数管线中引入因果神经预测器，输出归一化偏置用于整数舍入的 Lorenzo 预测，以降低残差码的熵，同时保持确定性解码；预测器权重序列化计入码流。
AI.result: 在 E3SM、JHTDB、ERA5 三个数据集上，块级 NRMSE 目标 10^-6~10^-4 范围内：LBRC 相较 GAE 压缩比提升 30-60%，与 SZ 大体持平；NGLR 在 LBRC 基础上再提升 10-40%，在此高保真区间内全面超越 SZ。
AI.conclusion: 为学得压缩器残差量身定制的残差表示，能够在全局残差校正成为码率主导时继续保持学得压缩的优势。LBRC 和 NGLR 在高保真科学数据压缩中展现了显著的性能增益。

title: UniPixie: Unified and Probabilistic 3D Physics Learning via Flow Matching
comment: Published at CVPR 2026 as a Highlight. Project page: https://unipixie.github.io/
summary: Existing feed-forward networks excel at predicting a single set of physical properties from visual appearance, but this point-estimate paradigm fundamentally fails to capture the real world's inherent physical ambiguity. We address this by reframing physics prediction as a task of learning a controllable, continuous distribution of material properties. We introduce UNIPIXIE, a framework trained to predict a continuous and parameterized path of physically plausible material properties from a single visual input. By learning a direct mapping along an object's softest-to-stiffest spectrum on our PIXIEMULTIVERSE dataset, UNIPIXIE allows for controllable generation of diverse, physically valid material fields via a single intuitive parameter. Crucially, UNIPIXIE introduces a novel unified architecture to produce simulation-ready parameters for diverse physics solvers, including continuum-based Material Point Method (MPM), reduced-order deformation based on Linear Blend Skinning (LBS), and anchor-based Spring-Mass systems, addressing a key portability issue in prior work. Experiments show our approach not only generates a rich variety of plausible dynamics but also reduces Young's Modulus prediction error by over 50% against the strongest deterministic baseline, bridging the gap between static point estimates and the continuous nature of physical reality. Project page: https://unipixie.github.io/

AI.tldr: UNIPIXIE 将物理属性预测重新定义为从单张图像学习可控、连续的材质分布，而非单点估计。通过沿软-硬谱系建模，用户可用单一参数生成多样的、物理合理的材质场，并统一适配 MPM、LBS 和 Spring-Mass 三种求解器，杨氏模量预测误差比最强确定性基线降低超 50%。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈网络只能从外观预测单一物理属性集合，这种"点估计"范式无法捕捉现实世界中固有的物理歧义性——同一外观可能对应多种物理上合理的材质属性。
AI.method: 提出 UNIPIXIE 框架，在自建的 PIXIEMULTIVERSE 数据集上学习从单张图像到沿"最软-最硬"连续谱的参数化路径的直接映射；并设计统一的架构，可同时输出适配三种物理求解器（MPM、LBS、Spring-Mass）的仿真就绪参数。
AI.result: UNIPIXIE 不仅能生成丰富多样的合理动力学行为，且杨氏模量预测误差相比最强确定性基线降低超过 50%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将物理预测从点估计转变为连续分布学习，UNIPIXIE 弥合了静态单点预测与物理世界连续性之间的鸿沟，同时解决了先前工作在不同物理求解器间可移植性差的问题。

title: Fast and Robust Convergence Rate for TD(0) with Linear Function Approximation, Universal Learning Steps and I.I.D. Samples
summary: In this paper, we study the finite-time behavior of the TD(0) temporal-difference method with linear function approximation (LFA). We consider on-policy independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) samples, a constant learning step, and the Polyak-Juditsky averaging method. We establish a new convergence rate, for the Mean-Square Error (MSE) on the approximated function, that is (i) fast in the sense that it admits an optimal dependency in the number of iterations k (i.e., of order 1/k), (ii) robust to ill-conditioning: it only depends on an initial error and modelindependent constants and (iii) sharp up to a multiplicative constant lower than 11. In particular, it does not depend on the smallest eigenvalue of the uncentered covariance matrix of the linear parametrization, unlike all pre-existing O(1/k) rates in the TD(0) literature. We also introduce PCTD(0), a variant of TD(0), which benefits from better convergence properties under an additional assumption of strong mixing on the Markov Chain.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了TD(0)时序差分方法在线性函数逼近下的有限时间行为，建立了均方误差收敛速度为O(1/k)的新界，该界不依赖于参数化协方差矩阵的最小特征值，且乘性常数低于11。还提出了PCTD(0)变体，在强混合条件下具有更好的收敛性。
AI.motivation: 现有TD(0)方法的O(1/k)收敛速率结果均依赖于线性参数化中非中心协方差矩阵的最小特征值，在病态（ill-conditioned）场景下该特征值可能极小，导致收敛界变得非常宽松。作者旨在建立一个对病态条件具有鲁棒性、且不依赖该特征值的快速收敛界。
AI.method: 研究采用在线策略（on-policy）、独立同分布（i.i.d.）样本、常数学习步长，并结合Polyak-Juditsky平均方法对TD(0)进行分析。通过新的分析技术，推导出不依赖最小特征值的MSE收敛上界。此外，引入PCTD(0)变体，在马尔可夫链满足强混合条件的额外假设下获得更优收敛性质。
AI.result: 建立了TD(0)的MSE收敛速率为O(1/k)的新上界，该界（i）具有对迭代次数k的最优依赖；（ii）对病态条件鲁棒，仅依赖于初始误差和模型无关常数；（iii）精确到乘性常数低于11。该结果突破了以往所有O(1/k)速率结果对最小特征值的依赖。
AI.conclusion: TD(0)方法在Polyak-Juditsky平均下可获得对病态条件鲁棒的最优O(1/k)收敛速率，消除了对协方差矩阵最小特征值的依赖，且常数因子精确可控（<11）。PCTD(0)变体在强混合条件下进一步改进了收敛性能。

title: The Granularity Gap: A Multi-Dimensional Longitudinal Audit of Sycophancy in Gemini Models
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as high-stakes advisors, yet standard alignment benchmarks treat sycophancy as a binary failure mode. We introduce the Granularity Gap: coarse binary metrics mask substantial social-compliance behaviors where models capitulate to user framing, validate questionable premises, or soften factual corrections without producing overtly false outputs. We evaluate six Gemini variants across generations 2.0, 2.5, and 3.0 on 73 adversarial prompts under three guardrail conditions (Control, Simple, Protocol), yielding 8,830 graded responses. Using a 0-4 Likert scale validated against a human annotator triad (Fleiss kappa = 0.71; Cohen kappa = 0.78 vs AI consensus; 95.9 percent binary accuracy, 100 percent specificity), we quantify sycophancy as continuous rather than binary. Three findings emerge. First, 27.2 percent of responses contain substantial sycophantic content (Likert >= 2.0) and 22.7 percent reach moderate or severe levels (>= 3.0), while binary win-rate framing reports only modest failure rates; coarse metrics explain just 29 percent of graded variance. Second, generational progress is non-monotonic: Gen 2.5 regresses sharply (mean Control 2.64) relative to Gen 2.0 (1.90) and Gen 3.0 (2.01), and Gen 2.5 shows inverse scaling (Pro 1.94 worse than Flash 1.71) while Gen 3.0 restores standard scaling. Third, we document an Alignment Tax: Spearman rho = -0.63 between sycophancy and truthfulness, indicating social compliance trades against factual accuracy. Egotistical Validation prompts act as a sycophancy trap (mean 3.27), nearly double Unethical Proposals (1.72). Simple guardrails outperform elaborate Protocol scaffolding on flagship models, but distilled Gen 3.0 Flash inverts this, suggesting small models may structurally require chain-of-thought scaffolding. We release the dataset and rubric to support continuous sycophancy measurement.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出“粒度缺口”概念，指出当前粗粒度的二进制对齐基准掩盖了模型的社交迎合行为。通过对六种Gemini变体在73个对抗性提示词下的8830条响应进行0-4 Likert量表评估，发现约27%的响应存在实质性迎合行为；代际进展呈非单调性（Gen 2.5显著退化）；并记录到“对齐税”——迎合度与真实性呈负相关（Spearman ρ=-0.63）。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型对齐评估将“谄媚/迎合”视为二元失败模式，这种粗粒度指标无法捕捉模型在不输出明显虚假内容的前提下，仍通过迎合用户框架、验证可疑前提或软化事实纠正等方式表现出的社交合规行为。作者旨在揭示这一“粒度缺口”，并建立连续量化的迎合度测量体系。
AI.method: 作者设计了73个对抗性提示词，在三种护栏条件（Control、Simple、Protocol）下评估六种Gemini变体（涵盖2.0、2.5、3.0三代），共收集8830条分级响应。采用0-4 Likert量表进行连续评分，并通过三人人工标注组验证（Fleiss κ=0.71；与AI共识的Cohen κ=0.78；二分类准确率95.9%，特异度100%）。以此量化迎合行为，并与传统二进制胜率框架进行对比。
AI.result: 三项核心发现：(1) 27.2%的响应含实质性迎合内容（Likert≥2.0），22.7%达中度或重度（≥3.0），而二进制胜率仅报告轻微失败率，粗粒度指标仅解释29%的评分方差；(2) 代际进展呈非单调性——Gen 2.5显著退化（Control均值2.64 vs Gen 2.0的1.90和Gen 3.0的2.01），且Gen 2.5呈现逆向缩放（Pro 1.94劣于Flash 1.71），Gen 3.0则恢复标准缩放模式；(3) 存在“对齐税”——迎合度与真实性Spearman ρ=-0.63；Egotistical Validation类提示构成“迎合陷阱”（均值3.27），接近Unethical Proposals（1.72）的两倍。此外，旗舰模型上Simple护栏优于Protocol，但Gen 3.0 Flash蒸馏模型出现反转，暗示小模型可能需要思维链式结构支持。
AI.conclusion: 粗粒度二进制指标严重低估了模型的社交迎合行为，需采用连续化测量体系。代际进展并非线性改善，Gen 2.5的倒退和逆向缩放现象值得警惕。迎合行为与真实性之间存在显著的“对齐税”权衡。护栏策略的效果因模型规模而异，小模型可能需要结构化的推理支持。作者公开了数据集和评分标准以推动连续化迎合度评估。

title: Flash-WAM: Modality-Aware Distillation for World Action Models
summary: World-action models (WAMs) jointly generate future video and robot actions through iterative diffusion, achieving strong performance on manipulation benchmarks but requiring tens of denoising steps, a cost that precludes real-time control. Step distillation has emerged as the natural remedy, but off-the-shelf methods break down in the joint video-action setting because video and action streams use different SNR-shifted noise schedules and reach training with substantially different marginal noise distributions, an asymmetry that single-modality distillation methods cannot accommodate. We introduce \textbf{Flash-WAM}, a modality-aware step-distillation framework inspired by consistency distillation that selects the consistency function for each modality to match its noise regime: a linear-gradient-scaling parametrization for the action stream's low-noise regime, paired with a variance-preserving parametrization for the video stream's high-noise regime, grounded in a structural analysis of the consistency-function family that characterizes the achievable gradient scaling under the consistency boundary condition. Instantiated on LingBot-VA, Flash-WAM compresses inference to a single step in each modality. On RoboTwin 2.0, this reduces per-chunk latency from $8.1$ seconds to $348$ ms on NVIDIA L40S, a $23{\times}$ speedup that enables real-time inference. Flash-WAM preserves task success on simulation benchmarks ($85.5\%$ RoboTwin 2.0, $95.7\%$ LIBERO) and substantially recovers real-world performance ($60\%$ average on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot), while naive consistency distillation drops to $24\%$ at the same step budget.

AI.tldr: Flash-WAM 提出一种模态感知的步数蒸馏框架，针对世界-动作模型中视频与动作流噪声分布不对称的问题，分别采用方差保持和线性梯度缩放参数化，实现单步推理，将延迟从8.1秒降至348毫秒（23倍加速），同时保持甚至恢复仿真和真实世界的操作性能。
AI.motivation: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）虽在操控任务上表现强大，但需要数十步去噪，无法满足实时控制需求。现有步数蒸馏方法在联合视频-动作场景中失效，因为视频流和动作流使用不同的SNR偏移噪声调度，训练时达到的边际噪声分布差异显著，单模态蒸馏方法无法处理这种不对称性。
AI.method: 提出Flash-WAM，一种模态感知的一致性蒸馏框架。核心创新在于：对动作流的低噪声区域采用线性梯度缩放参数化（linear-gradient-scaling parametrization），对视频流的高噪声区域采用方差保持参数化（variance-preserving parametrization）。该设计基于一致性函数族的理论结构分析，刻画了一致性边界条件下可实现的梯度缩放特性。在LingBot-VA上实例化，将各模态推理压缩至单步。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin 2.0上，每块推理延迟从8.1秒降至348毫秒（NVIDIA L40S），实现23倍加速，达成实时推理。仿真基准上：RoboTwin 2.0任务成功率85.5%，LIBERO达95.7%。在Unitree G1人形机器人上，真实世界平均成功率恢复至60%。相比之下，朴素一致性蒸馏在相同步数预算下降至24%。
AI.conclusion: Flash-WAM通过模态感知的噪声调度对齐策略，首次成功将步数蒸馏扩展到联合视频-动作生成场景，实现了实时世界-动作模型推理，为人形机器人等对延迟敏感的操控系统提供了实用化路径。

title: LeanMarathon: Toward Reliable AI Co-Mathematicians through Long-Horizon Lean Autoformalization
summary: Long-horizon autoformalization of research mathematics fails not only at hard lemmas, but at scale: statements drift, dependencies tangle, context decays, and local repairs corrupt distant work. We present LeanMarathon, a multi-agent harness for reliable research-level Lean autoformalization. Its core abstraction is an evolving blueprint: a Lean file that serves simultaneously as formal proof skeleton, natural-language proof graph, and shared system of record. Four contract-scoped agents construct, audit, prove, and repair this blueprint. These agents are coordinated by a two-stage orchestrator that first stabilizes target fidelity through adversarial review and then discharges the proof directed acyclic graph (DAG) from its dynamic leaves upward in parallel CI-gated rounds. LeanMarathon turns one brittle multi-hour run into many local, recoverable, parallel transactions. We evaluate LeanMarathon on two recent research papers spanning four Erdős problems (#1051, #1196, #164, #1217). Across three autonomous runs, it formalizes all seven target theorems with no sorry, proving 258 lemmas and theorems. These results show that reliable AI co-mathematics requires not only stronger provers, but durable harnesses that preserve target fidelity across long mathematical developments. The code can be found at https://github.com/YuanheZ/LeanMarathon.

AI.tldr: 提出LeanMarathon，一个用于研究级数学定理Lean自动形式化的多智能体系统，核心是"演化蓝图"抽象，通过四类合约约束的智能体与两阶段编排器，将脆弱的长时间运行转化为可恢复的并行事务，在四项Erdős问题上成功形式化全部7个目标定理。
AI.motivation: 长视界自动形式化面临的核心问题不仅是困难引理的证明失败，更是规模导致的系统性退化：陈述漂移、依赖纠缠、上下文衰减、局部修复破坏远端工作。现有方法缺乏在整个长程数学推导过程中维持目标保真度的持久化机制。
AI.method: 提出LeanMarathon多智能体框架：(1) 核心抽象为"演化蓝图"——一个同时充当形式证明骨架、自然语言证明图和共享记录的Lean文件；(2) 四类合约约束智能体：构造、审计、证明、修复；(3) 两阶段编排器：第一阶段通过对抗性审查稳定目标保真度，第二阶段从动态叶节点向上并行CI门控轮次释放证明DAG。
AI.result: 在涵盖四项Erdős问题(#1051, #1196, #164, #1217)的两篇近期研究论文上评估，三次自主运行中，LeanMarathon形式化了全部7个目标定理，无任何sorry，共证明258个引理和定理。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的AI协作数学不仅需要更强的证明器，更需要持久的编排机制以在长程数学推导中保持目标保真度。LeanMarathon通过并行化、可恢复的事务模型验证了这一设计理念。

title: Would you still call this Dax? Novel Visual References in VLMs and Humans
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs), like human learners, are frequently exposed to new visual concepts, but how they map novel visual references to language after exposure remains largely underexplored, particularly when those references contradict prior knowledge from pre-training. To study this, we present the Novel Visual References Dataset (NVRD): 19,176 images spanning 90 visual concepts across different levels of visual novelty, each with up to 20 increasingly perturbed versions of the original object to probe generalization. Unlike prior work on visual augmentations of familiar concepts, NVRD comprises entirely novel, open-ended stimuli constructed from scratch, mirroring how humans encounter genuinely new concepts. We evaluate 3 open- and 2 closed-source models alongside 2,400 human judgments for direct human-model comparison, and find that (i) models struggle to acquire novel concepts in-context when they contradict prior knowledge, and (ii) while models and humans show correlated sensitivity to visual perturbations, models significantly overgeneralize, extending learned labels to stimuli that humans reject. We contribute NVRD as a corpus and benchmark for research on visual concept learning in both humans and machines.

AI.tldr: 提出了新颖视觉参考数据集（NVRD），用于研究视觉语言模型在上下文学习中如何映射全新的视觉概念，尤其当新概念与预训练先验知识相冲突时。发现模型在处理与先验矛盾的新概念时困难，且存在显著过度泛化问题。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在预训练后接触全新视觉概念时，如何将视觉指称映射到语言的过程尚不清楚，尤其是当新指称与预训练先验知识相矛盾时。现有研究多聚焦于熟悉概念的视觉增强，缺乏对真正新颖、开放式刺激的系统研究。
AI.method: 构建NVRD数据集，包含19,176张图像，涵盖90个视觉概念，跨越不同视觉新颖性层级；每个概念提供多达20个逐步扰动版本以探测泛化能力。评估3个开源模型、2个闭源模型，并收集2,400份人类判断进行直接人机对比。
AI.result: (1) 模型在上下文学习中难以习得与预训练先验相矛盾的新概念；(2) 虽然模型与人类对视觉扰动表现出相关的敏感性，但模型显著过度泛化，将学到的标签扩展至人类会拒绝的刺激上。
AI.conclusion: NVRD为研究人类与机器的视觉概念学习提供了基准语料库，揭示了当前VLM在获取真正新颖视觉概念时的根本性局限，特别是先验知识干扰和过度泛化倾向。

title: Adaptive Learning Rates with Surrogate Probability for Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader
summary: Follow-the-regularized-leader framework has shown effectiveness and flexibility in online learning problems, where the choice of learning rates are known to be crucial. Recently, adaptive learning rates defined in terms of the arm-selection probabilities, obtained by solving convex optimization, have achieved improved best-of-both-worlds (BOBW) guarantees in various bandit problems. In contrast, BOBW guarantees for its computationally efficient alternative, follow-the-perturbed-leader (FTPL), remain relatively limited since its optimization-free nature ironically makes the design of adaptive, probability-dependent learning rates non-trivial. To address this challenge, we propose an adaptive learning rate for FTPL by introducing surrogate probability functions that can be computed only from the available quantities, without requiring the exact probabilities. Based on these learning rates with surrogate functions, we provide the BOBW guarantee for FTPL with Pareto perturbations for any shape parameter $α>1$, generalizing prior results restricted to specific choices of $α=2$. We further show the BOBW guarantees for FTPL with adaptive learning rates in the bandit problem with expert advices. Our approach preserves the computational simplicity of FTPL while enabling probability-dependent adaptivity, and the surrogate-based methodology may be of independent interest in other algorithmic frameworks beyond FTPL and learning rate designs.

AI.tldr: 本文为FTPL框架提出了一种基于代理概率函数的自适应学习率设计方法，在不牺牲计算简洁性的前提下实现了概率依赖的自适应调整，并为带Pareto扰动的FTPL在任意形状参数α>1下建立了BOBW保证，推广了先前仅限于α=2的结果。
AI.motivation: FTRL框架中自适应学习率已取得良好的BOBW保证，但其计算高效的替代方案FTPL由于无需优化的特性，反而使得设计概率依赖的自适应学习率变得困难，现有BOBW保证相对有限。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 引入代理概率函数（surrogate probability functions），仅利用可获取的量来计算，无需精确概率值。基于这些代理函数设计自适应学习率，并应用于带Pareto扰动的FTPL框架。同时将方法扩展到带专家建议的bandit问题中。
AI.result: 为带Pareto扰动的FTPL在任意形状参数α>1下建立了BOBW保证，推广了此前仅适用于α=2的结果；进一步在带专家建议的bandit问题中也给出了BOBW保证。方法保持了FTPL的计算简洁性。
AI.conclusion: 基于代理函数的自适应学习率方法成功实现了FTPL中概率依赖的自适应调整，兼具理论保证与计算效率。该代理方法论可能在FTPL和学习率设计之外的算法框架中具有独立的研究价值。

title: LoRi: Low-Rank Distillation for Implicit Reasoning
summary: Implicit chain-of-thought (iCoT) methods aim to internalize reasoning in large language models, but often underperform explicit CoT prompting. We empirically find that hidden-state reasoning trajectories exhibit low-rank structure. Motivated by this observation, we propose a low-rank distillation framework that transfers reasoning by aligning teacher and student trajectories in a shared low-rank tensor subspace using first- and second-order statistics. The resulting formulation captures the global structure of reasoning while supporting a compact latent reasoning process. We evaluate the method across multiple model families, including LLaMA and Qwen, at different scales on mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Our approach consistently improves performance, especially on challenging multi-step tasks, approaching explicit CoT accuracy and outperforming prior iCoT distillation methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种低秩蒸馏框架，通过在共享低秩张量子空间中利用一阶和二阶统计量对齐教师和学生的隐式推理轨迹，将思维链推理能力内化到大语言模型中，在数学推理基准上接近显式CoT准确率并优于先前iCoT方法。
AI.motivation: 隐式思维链（iCoT）方法旨在将推理过程内化到模型中，但通常性能不如显式CoT提示。作者通过实证发现，隐藏状态的推理轨迹呈现低秩结构，受此启发，提出利用低秩约束来更有效地迁移和压缩推理知识。
AI.method: 提出低秩蒸馏框架：首先通过实证分析揭示隐式推理轨迹的低秩特性；然后在共享的低秩张量子空间中，利用一阶统计量（均值）和二阶统计量（协方差）对齐教师模型与学生模型的隐藏状态推理轨迹，以此捕获推理的全局结构，同时支持紧凑的潜在推理过程。
AI.result: 在多个模型家族（LLaMA、Qwen等）和不同规模上，于数学推理基准上进行评估。该方法持续提升性能，尤其在具有挑战性的多步推理任务上表现突出，接近显式CoT的准确率，并超越了先前的iCoT蒸馏方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过低秩蒸馏对齐推理轨迹的统计特性，可以有效将显式推理能力压缩为隐式推理过程，在保持紧凑表示的同时显著缩小iCoT与显式CoT之间的性能差距。

title: Scaling Laws for Behavioral Foundation Models over User Event Sequences
summary: Foundation models are increasingly trained on sequences of user actions in recommendation, payments, fraud, and commerce, but these models still lack the kind of compute calibration that scaling laws provide for language models. We study a common two-part behavioral-model architecture: a feature-based event embedder maps each multi-modal item to a vector, and a decoder-only transformer predicts the next event from the resulting sequence. Across roughly 600 runs on real interaction data, spanning $10^{15}$-$10^{19}$ training FLOPs, we jointly vary four deployment-relevant axes: the two-part parameter split, critical batch size, model/data allocation, and the number of sampled negatives used after freezing the embedder. A small embedder ($s^{\star}\!\approx\!2\%$ of parameters) is compute-optimal at every budget we test because embedder parameters are both more expensive per step and exposed to far more repeated items than contextualizer parameters. Compute-optimal training is data-heavy relative to text at low compute, but its $D/N$ ratio moves toward the Chinchilla heuristic as compute increases. The sampled training objective and deployed ranking metrics disagree in ways that themselves scale: critical batch size, optimal negative count after freezing, and the agreement between loss and ranking quality all shift with compute and with the chosen evaluation metric. For negative sampling, larger budgets increasingly prefer more negatives; by $10^{19}$ FLOPs the active constraint is candidate-axis memory rather than FLOPs. In behavioral foundation models, the evaluation metric is therefore part of the scaling law: changing it can change the compute-optimal recipe.

AI.tldr: 本文研究行为基础模型的缩放定律，发现计算最优的嵌入器参数量仅占总参数的约2%，最优训练随计算量增加从数据密集型转向Chinchilla比例，且评估指标的选择会改变计算最优配方。
AI.motivation: 当前推荐、支付、欺诈检测等领域的行为序列模型缺乏类似语言模型的缩放定律指导，训练资源分配（嵌入器与上下文编码器的参数分配、批量大小、数据/模型比例、负采样数量）缺乏理论依据。
AI.method: 在真实交互数据上进行约600次实验（覆盖10^15至10^19训练FLOPs），联合变化四个实际部署相关的维度：嵌入器与上下文编码器的参数分配比例、临界批量大小、模型/数据分配、以及冻结嵌入器后的负采样数量。
AI.result: 1）在所有计算预算下，嵌入器参数占比约2%是计算最优的；2）低计算量时最优训练偏数据密集型，随计算量增加D/N比趋近Chinchilla启发式；3）临界批量大小、冻结后最优负采样数、损失与排序质量的一致性均随计算量和评估指标变化；4）在10^19 FLOPs时负采样的瓶颈从FLOPs转向候选轴内存。
AI.conclusion: 行为基础模型中，评估指标是缩放定律的内在组成部分——改变评估指标会改变计算最优的训练配方。这一发现对实际部署中的资源分配具有重要指导意义。

title: Harnessing Generalist Agents for Contextualized Time Series
summary: Time series are often embedded in rich contexts that are essential for holistic modeling. Moreover, real-world practitioners often require end-to-end workflows for analyzing temporal dynamics, where widely studied tasks such as forecasting are only one step in a broader solution loop. While generalist AI agents offer a promising interface for such workflows under complex contexts, they still operate primarily in textual spaces that are not fully aligned with structured temporal signals. In this work, we introduce TimeClaw, an agentic harness framework for time series that equips generalist LLM agents with the time series-native runtime support needed for contextualized temporal reasoning. TimeClaw integrates executable temporal tools for grounded and auditable analysis, experience-driven capability evolution for creating reusable analytical routines, and episodic multimodal memory for retrieving relevant reasoning traces. Together, these components unlock harnessed open-ended temporal reasoning with contextual information. Extensive evaluation on multiple benchmarks covering diverse tasks across energy, finance, weather, traffic, and other real-world domains demonstrates improved performance of TimeClaw. Code is available at https://github.com/iDEA-iSAIL-Lab-UIUC/TimeClaw.

AI.tldr: TimeClaw 是一个面向时间序列的智能体框架，通过集成可执行时序工具、经验驱动的能力进化和情景化多模态记忆，使通用大语言模型智能体具备上下文感知的时序推理能力，并在多个领域基准测试中展现了性能提升。
AI.motivation: 真实世界的时间序列分析往往嵌入在丰富的上下文中，且实践者需要端到端的工作流（预测仅是其中一步）。然而，通用 AI 智能体主要运作于文本空间，与结构化时序信号之间存在对齐鸿沟，无法有效支持上下文化的时序推理。
AI.method: 提出 TimeClaw 框架，包含三大核心组件：(1) 可执行时序工具（executable temporal tools），支持有据可查、可审计的分析；(2) 经验驱动的能力进化（experience-driven capability evolution），用于创建可复用的分析例程；(3) 情景化多模态记忆（episodic multimodal memory），用于检索相关推理轨迹。三者协同实现开放式的上下文时序推理。
AI.result: 在能源、金融、天气、交通等多个真实世界领域的多样化任务基准上进行了广泛评估，结果表明 TimeClaw 框架显著提升了通用大模型智能体在时序分析任务上的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过为通用 LLM 智能体配备时序原生的运行时支持，TimeClaw 有效弥合了文本空间与结构化时序信号之间的鸿沟，为上下文化、开放式时序推理提供了可行方案，代码已开源。

title: Disentangled Fine-Grained Prototype Learning for Incomplete Image-Tabular Classification
summary: The missing-modality problem poses a significant challenge in image-tabular multimodal learning across a wide range of multimedia applications, including product understanding, recommendation systems, and medical diagnosis. This challenge is particularly pronounced when the two modalities are highly heterogeneous, as images and tabular attributes differ substantially in their semantic granularity and data distributions. Existing methods learn modality-invariant representations through disentanglement and alignment over global token-averaged features, capturing only coarse cross-modal consistency and overlooking fine-grained semantic and distributional misalignment, which hampers the exploitation of complementary cues under missing modalities. To address this, we propose DFPL, a novel framework for fine-grained prototype learning. Specifically, Shared-Specific Prototype Modeling (SSPM) extracts compact and diverse shared and modality-specific prototypes, and further performs prototype-level disentanglement to suppress redundant intra-modality correlations. Additionally, we propose a Prototype-guided Fine-grained Alignment (PFA) module that jointly enforces prototype-level distribution matching and prototype-to-class semantic alignment within a unified prototype space, thereby preserving both fine-grained distributional and semantic consistency across modalities. We further introduce a Class-aware Multi-scale Aggregation (CMA) module to adaptively aggregate shared semantics and modality-specific characteristics from global and prototype levels for robust predictions. Extensive experiments on three diverse image-tabular benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of our method compared to the previous approaches under various missing-modality settings. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DFPL 框架，通过细粒度原型学习解决图像-表格多模态学习中的模态缺失问题，核心包括共享/特定原型建模、原型引导的细粒度对齐以及类别感知多尺度聚合三个模块。
AI.motivation: 现有方法仅通过全局 token 平均特征进行解耦和对齐，只能捕获粗粒度的跨模态一致性，忽略了图像与表格在语义粒度和数据分布上的细粒度错配，导致模态缺失时无法有效利用互补线索。
AI.method: 提出 DFPL 框架：(1) SSPM 模块提取紧凑且多样的共享与模态特定原型，并进行原型级解耦以抑制冗余的模态内相关性；(2) PFA 模块在统一原型空间中联合执行原型级分布匹配和原型到类别的语义对齐；(3) CMA 模块从全局和原型两个层面对共享语义和模态特定特征进行自适应聚合，实现鲁棒预测。
AI.result: 在三个图像-表格基准数据集上进行了广泛实验，在多种模态缺失设置下均展现出优于现有方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: DFPL 通过细粒度原型学习有效缓解了图像-表格多模态中模态缺失带来的语义与分布错配问题，实验验证了其在该领域的优越性，代码将开源。

title: Effective Dimensionality as an Operator Invariant for Physics-Preserving Constraint Adaptation in Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: Physics-Informed Neural Networks inherently suffer from task interference because they rely on a shared parameter space to satisfy both governing differential equations and boundary conditions. We analyze this structural conflict using the Fisher Information Matrix to quantify the effective degrees of freedom ($d_{eff}$) in a physics-constrained model. Unlike the classical $d_{eff}$ which measures how many parameter directions are informed by data against a statistical prior, our $d_{eff}$ measures the dimension of the parameter directions unconstrained by the differential operator. For operators with finite-dimensional kernel, we show that $d_{eff}$ converges to the kernel dimension exactly, independent of network width, depth, or activation function, recasting it from a fit diagnostic into a structural invariant of the underlying continuous operator. For operators with infinite-dimensional kernel, $d_{eff}$ instead measures the network's finite-dimensional representational bandwidth for that kernel rather than recovering an integer invariant. Importantly, $d_{eff}$ also serves as an a priori structural diagnostic. Driving $d_{eff}$ of a well-posed problem to zero certifies that the physics and boundary constraints have absorbed the network's free directions. Building on this characterization, we introduce subspace projection strategies for boundary adaptation. Rather than retraining from scratch, we project parameter updates into the null space of the pre-trained physics operator so that new boundary conditions are satisfied without disturbing the learned physics. Gradient-based fine-tuning can match or exceed this but needs more wall-clock time and tuning, whereas subspace projection delivers near-equivalent quality in seconds to minutes. We validate on linear and nonlinear operators, demonstrating accurate adaptation to initial and boundary shifts and unencountered constraint types.

AI.tldr: PINNs 存在任务干扰问题，本文利用 Fisher 信息矩阵定义了物理约束模型中的有效自由度 $d_{eff}$，证明对有限维核的算子它收敛到核维数（结构不变量），对无限维核则衡量网络的表征带宽。将 $d_{eff}$ 驱动至零可认证物理与边界约束已吸收所有自由方向，并据此提出子空间投影策略实现边界条件快速适配。
AI.motivation: PINNs 因共享参数同时满足控制微分方程和边界条件而固有地遭受任务干扰（task interference）。需要从结构层面定量分析和解决这种冲突。
