AI.method: 1. 使用 Fisher 信息矩阵（FIM）定义物理约束模型的有效自由度 $d_{eff}$，即未被微分算子约束的参数方向维度。2. 理论分析 $d_{eff}$ 与微分算子核维数的关系：有限维核时 $d_{eff}$ 收敛到核维数，与网络宽度、深度、激活函数无关；无限维核时 $d_{eff}$ 衡量网络对该核的有限维表征带宽。3. 提出子空间投影策略：将参数更新投影到预训练物理算子的零空间，实现边界条件适配而不扰动已学习的物理。
AI.result: 1. 对有限维核算子，$d_{eff}$ 精确收敛到核维数，成为连续算子的结构不变量而非拟合诊断量。2. 将适定问题的 $d_{eff}$ 驱动至零可认证物理与边界约束已完全吸收网络自由方向。3. 子空间投影适配在秒到分钟级时间内取得与梯度微调相当或更优的质量，而梯度微调需要更多时间和调参。4. 在线性和非线性算子上验证了该方法对初边值偏移及未遇到约束类型的精确适配能力。
AI.conclusion: $d_{eff}$ 从拟合诊断转变为微分算子的结构不变量，可先验地诊断 PINNs 中的任务干扰；基于零空间投影的子空间策略为边界条件适配提供了高效、无需重新训练的解决方案，兼具理论洞察与工程实用价值。

title: A Model of Multi-turn Human Persuadability Using Probabilistic Belief Tracing
summary: Large language models can shift human beliefs across high-stakes domains, but most persuasion studies rely on pre/post belief change. These endpoint measures identify whether persuasion occurred, yet miss where and how beliefs moved within a dialogue. We present PERSUASIONTRACE, a framework for studying persuasion in human-LLM interaction. Built on a web-based experimental platform, PERSUASIONTRACE contributes a tool for multi-turn persuasion studies and a process-level evaluation protocol: it records multi-turn belief reports from human or simulated targets of persuasion, annotates persuader turns with rhetorical dimensions (logos/pathos/ethos), and evaluates simulators by fidelity to real human belief dynamics. Using this framework, we find that human targets group into two clusters of multi-turn belief updates and exhibit susceptibility to rhetorical strategies, and that LLMs are persuasive across generic and personalized topics, text and audio modalities, and multi-turn interactions. Prior work has chiefly used vanilla-prompted LLMs to simulate human targets, but we show that these simulators fail to replicate human belief dynamics. We introduce a Bayesian-network simulated target that maintains an explicit latent belief state over time so each persuader message yields cognitively realistic belief updates. In human-likeness evaluation, our Bayesian target scores near a human reference (81 vs 80), while baseline LLM targets score substantially lower (64). PERSUASIONTRACE reframes persuasion evaluation from endpoint movement alone to process fidelity, providing a stronger basis for scientific analysis and safer optimization of persuasive systems.

AI.tldr: PERSUASIONTRACE 是一个研究人-LLM说服过程的框架，通过多轮对话追踪信念变化轨迹，而非仅测量前后端点变化。研究发现人类信念更新分为两类簇并对修辞策略敏感；LLM在多种条件下具有说服力；朴素LLM模拟器无法复现人类信念动态，而作者提出的贝叶斯网络模拟目标在人类相似度上接近真人水平（81 vs 80）。
AI.motivation: 现有说服研究大多仅依赖对话前后的信念变化（端点测量），只能判断说服是否发生，却无法揭示信念在对话过程中如何以及在哪里发生变化。缺乏过程层面的追踪工具和评估协议，限制了对说服机制的深入理解以及说服系统安全优化的能力。
AI.method: 作者构建了基于Web实验平台的PERSUASIONTRACE框架，包含三个核心贡献：(1) 多轮说服研究工具，记录人类或模拟目标在每轮对话中的信念报告；(2) 对说服者回合按修辞维度（logos/pathos/ethos）进行标注；(3) 通过忠实度评估模拟器是否复现真实人类信念动态。此外，提出贝叶斯网络模拟目标，维护显式潜在信念状态，使每条说服消息产生认知上现实的信念更新。
AI.result: 实验发现：(1) 人类目标的多轮信念更新聚为两类，并对修辞策略表现出易感性；(2) LLM在通用与个性化话题、文本与音频模态、多轮交互中均具有说服力；(3) 朴素提示LLM模拟器无法复现人类信念动态；(4) 贝叶斯模拟目标在人类相似度评估中得分接近人类参考水平（81 vs 80），远超基线LLM目标（64）。
AI.conclusion: PERSUASIONTRACE将说服评估从仅关注端点变化重新定位为过程忠实度评估，为科学分析和说服系统的安全优化提供了更强的基础。贝叶斯网络模拟目标有效弥补了现有LLM模拟器在信念动态复现上的不足。

title: Policy-Conditioned Counterfactual Credit for Verifiable Reinforcement Learning of Long-Horizon Language Agents
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves reasoning and tool use, yet long-horizon language agents still learn unsupported evidence chains, belief drift, and shortcut actions that satisfy terminal checks. Existing process rewards are mostly correlational: they reward retrieval-, reflection-, or verification-like steps without estimating whether the step contributes to final verified success under a specified intervention. We propose CVT-RL, a constrained policy-gradient algorithm with dense verifiable rewards, intervention-validity gating, and a policy-conditioned counterfactual contribution (PCCC) estimator. Deletion, semantic substitution, evidence substitution, and tool-output perturbation define separate controlled interventions; continuations are sampled from a frozen reference policy, and a selection-adjusted doubly robust estimator augments the advantage. Belief control uses only prefix-observable labels, while an augmented Lagrangian constrains unsupported claims, skipped verification, tool tampering, and unsafe calls. On long-context QA, ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and web/tool tasks, CVT-RL improves average task success from 71.8% for compute-matched non-causal RL and 75.4% for an information-matched counterfactual-process baseline to 78.9%, improves evidence F1 from 78.9 to 82.8 over the information-matched baseline, and reduces measured hacking from 7.2% to 3.9%. Independent human audit estimates 4.6% hacking for CVT-RL versus 8.1% for the information-matched baseline, and adaptive detector-evasion attacks raise hacking only to 7.1%. Stratified bootstrap and mixed-effects tests give p<0.01 after Holm correction for all primary metrics. Carefully scoped counterfactual credit, paired with validity gating, diagnostics, and verifiable constraints, provides a reproducible route toward more reliable long-horizon RL for language agents.

AI.tldr: 针对长程语言智能体中存在的无支撑证据链、信念漂移和捷径行为，提出CVT-RL算法，通过干预有效性门控和策略条件反事实贡献估计器(PCCC)提供密集可验证奖励，结合增广拉格朗日约束，在多项长程任务上将成功率从基线71.8%提升至78.9%，并将作弊行为从7.2%降至3.9%。
AI.motivation: 现有过程奖励多为相关性奖励（奖励检索、反思、验证式步骤），未评估特定干预下该步骤是否真正贡献于最终验证成功。长程语言智能体因此产生无支撑证据链、信念漂移和仅满足终端检查的捷径行为，亟需因果性的过程监督方法。
AI.method: 提出CVT-RL约束策略梯度算法：(1)设计四种受控干预——删除、语义替换、证据替换、工具输出扰动；(2)从冻结参考策略采样延续，使用选择调整的双重鲁棒估计器增强优势函数，构建策略条件反事实贡献估计器(PCCC)；(3)信念控制仅使用前缀可观测标签；(4)采用增广拉格朗日方法约束无支撑声明、跳过验证、工具篡改和不安全调用。
AI.result: 在长上下文QA、ALFWorld、ScienceWorld及网页/工具任务上：(1)平均任务成功率从计算匹配非因果RL的71.8%和信息匹配反事实过程基线的75.4%提升至78.9%；(2)证据F1从信息匹配基线的78.9提升至82.8；(3)测量作弊率从7.2%降至3.9%；(4)独立人工审计估计CVT-RL作弊率4.6% vs 基线8.1%；(5)自适应检测器规避攻击下作弊率仅升至7.1%；(6)分层自助法与混合效应检验Holm校正后p<0.01。
AI.conclusion: 精心划定的反事实信用分配，结合有效性门控、诊断工具和可验证约束，为更可靠的长程语言智能体强化学习提供了一条可复现的技术路径。

title: Agents' Last Exam
summary: Recent AI systems have achieved strong results on a wide range of benchmarks, yet these gains have not translated into economically meaningful deployment across many professional domains. We argue that this gap is largely an evaluation problem: widely used benchmarks lack sustained performance measurement on real and economically valuable workflows. This paper introduces Agents' Last Exam (ALE), a benchmark designed to evaluate AI agents on long-horizon, economically valuable, real-world tasks with verifiable outcomes. Developed in collaboration with 250+ industry experts, ALE covers non-physical industries defined with reference to O*NET / SOC 2018 (the U.S. federal occupational taxonomy). It is organized around a task taxonomy with 55 subfields grouped into 13 industry clusters covering 1K+ tasks. Current results show that the hardest tier remains far from saturated: across mainstream harness and backbone configurations, the average full pass rate is 2.6%. ALE is designed as a living benchmark: its task pool grows continuously as new workflows and industries are onboarded. More broadly, ALE is intended not merely as another leaderboard, but as an instrument for closing the gap between benchmark success and GDP-relevant impact.

AI.tldr: ALE 是一个由250+行业专家协作构建的长期限、经济价值型真实任务基准，涵盖13个行业集群、55个子领域、1000+任务；当前最强配置的平均完全通过率仅2.6%，旨在弥合基准测试成功与GDP相关影响之间的鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 当前AI系统在诸多基准上表现强劲，但这些成果未能转化为跨专业领域具有经济意义的实际部署。作者认为这一差距根源于评估问题：广泛使用的基准缺乏对真实、有经济价值工作流的持续性能测量。
AI.method: 引入ALE基准：联合250+行业专家，参照O*NET/SOC 2018美国联邦职业分类体系定义非体力产业；构建包含55个子领域、13个行业集群、1000+任务的任务分类法；设计为"活基准"（living benchmark），任务池随新工作流和行业的加入而持续增长。
AI.result: 当前主流harness与backbone配置下，最难层级的平均完全通过率仅为2.6%，远未饱和。
AI.conclusion: ALE不仅是一个新的排行榜，更是缩小基准成功与经济影响力之间差距的评测工具，旨在推动AI系统在真实、长期限、有可验证结果的经济任务上取得实质性进展。

title: Horse Eye Blink Detection and Classification for Equine Affective State Assessment
summary: Automated detection of equine facial action units (AUs) is a promising yet under-explored avenue for pain and affective state assessment in horses. Half and full-blink movements are recognised indicators of pain and stress, but as micro-expressions, their subtle, fine-grained nature makes them easily missed by the naked eye and only discernible through frame-by-frame video inspection, making reliable automated detection from video a particularly demanding task. We develop and evaluate three methods for automated blink classification from horse videos: a frame-based YOLOv12 detector, an optical flow magnitude thresholding approach, and a fine-tuned VideoMAE model, tested on a publicly available dataset. We achieve a macro-F1 score of 0.898 when doing blink classification and 0.926 on binary blink detection. Our results highlight both the potential and the inherent challenges of fine-grained AU detection for equine welfare monitoring.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了马匹面部动作单元（AU）的自动检测，重点针对作为疼痛和压力指标的半眨眼和全眨眼运动。作者开发并评估了三种方法：基于帧的YOLOv12检测器、光流幅度阈值法以及微调后的VideoMAE模型，在眨眼分类任务上达到0.898的宏F1分数，在二分类眨眼检测上达到0.926。
AI.motivation: 马匹的半眨眼和全眨眼是疼痛和压力的公认指标，但作为微表情，其细微、精细的特性使得肉眼极易遗漏，只能通过逐帧视频检查才能辨别。因此，迫切需要开发可靠的自动化视频检测方法，以辅助马匹福利监测。
AI.method: 在公开数据集上开发并评估了三种自动化眨眼分类方法：(1) 基于帧的YOLOv12目标检测器；(2) 光流幅度阈值法；(3) 微调后的VideoMAE视频理解模型。任务分为眨眼分类（多分类）和二元眨眼检测两类。
AI.result: 在眨眼分类任务上达到0.898的宏F1分数，在二元眨眼检测任务上达到0.926的F1分数。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果凸显了细粒度AU检测在马匹福利监测中的巨大潜力，同时也揭示了该任务固有的挑战性。自动化面部动作单元检测有望成为马匹疼痛和情感状态评估的有效工具。

title: Diffusion Models Observe Only Gradients: A Geometric Perspective on Score Matching Errors
summary: Score-based diffusion models are typically trained by minimizing the $L^2$ score matching error, and standard theoretical analyses rely on this quantity to bound the sampling discrepancy between the learned and target distributions. We show the $L^2$ score error is not the right intrinsic measure of marginal distributional quality: a learned diffusion model can incur arbitrarily large $L^2$ score error while perfectly matching the target distribution. By decomposing score errors into a gradient and a solenoidal component (a Helmholtz-Hodge decomposition), we identify the geometric reason behind this: only the gradient component enters the marginal Fokker-Planck dynamics, while the solenoidal component is structurally invisible. We make this precise in three results. First, building on the corrected geometry, we prove an impossibility result: no monotone function of the $L^2$ score error can uniformly lower bound any divergence between the learned and target distributions. Second, we derive an upper bound on the Kullback-Leibler divergence that depends only on the observable gradient component of the error, tightening the standard Girsanov bound and identifying its looseness as the cost of operating on path-space rather than marginal-space dynamics. Third, we give a tractable estimator of the gradient component via a dual Sobolev identity, which is shown to empirically correlate substantially better with sample quality than the full $L^2$ error.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了扩散模型中L²分数匹配误差的几何缺陷：仅误差的梯度分量影响边际分布，而散度分量（solenoidal component）在Fokker-Planck动力学中不可见。基于此，作者证明了L²分数误差无法单调下界任何分布散度，推导出仅依赖梯度分量的更紧KL上界，并给出了梯度分量的可估计算子。
AI.motivation: 标准扩散模型理论将L²分数误差作为衡量采样质量的核心指标，但作者发现该误差可能任意大而模型却完美匹配目标分布，表明L²分数误差并非评估边际分布质量的内在正确度量。需要从几何结构上重新审视分数误差的构成及其与分布差异的关系。
AI.method: 通过Helmholtz-Hodge分解将分数误差拆分为梯度分量与散度（无旋）分量。证明只有梯度分量进入边际Fokker-Planck方程，而散度分量在结构上不可见。基于该几何洞察：（1）证明不存在L²分数误差的单调函数能统一下界学习分布与目标分布间的任意散度；（2）利用Girsanov定理推导仅依赖梯度分量的KL散度上界；（3）通过对偶Sobolev恒等式构造梯度分量的可估计算子。
AI.result: 三个核心结果：（1）不可能性定理——L²分数误差无法单调控制分布散度；（2）新KL上界仅依赖可观测的梯度分量，比标准Girsanov界更紧，揭示了路径空间与边际空间动力学之间的代价差异；（3）梯度分量估计器与样本质量的经验相关性显著优于全L²误差。
AI.conclusion: L²分数匹配误差因包含结构上不可见的散度分量而具有误导性。应关注梯度分量作为扩散模型训练与评估的更本质指标。该理论为设计更好的训练目标和评估准则提供了几何基础。

title: Self-supervised User Profile Generation for Personalization
summary: Personalizing large language models (LLMs) has become a central challenge as LLMs are deployed across recommendation, search, dialogue, and content generation -- settings where the same query should yield different answers given different users. A promising route is to summarize each user's interaction history into a natural-language memory or profile and prepend it to the prompt to facilitate personalization. Existing methods learn such profile generators with explicit rewards derived from labeled downstream tasks, which are expensive and sparse as they require annotated supervision for every target task. In light of this challenge, we introduce Bidirectional User Modeling via Profiles (BUMP), a self-supervised framework that trains a profile generator without any downstream labels. Specifically, given a user's interaction history, we use GRPO to train an LLM to emit a free-form textual profile under a bidirectional in-batch ranking objective: a small LLM judge measures (i) how well the generated profile, used as a query, ranks the user's own held-out interactions above interactions from other users in the batch, and (ii) how well a held-out interaction, used as a query, ranks the user's own profile above profiles of other users. Both directions are scored with multi-positive NDCG and combined into a dense reward per rollout; other users in the batch supply free negatives, so every training example yields supervision from raw interaction logs alone. Evaluated on the LaMP benchmark, BUMP matches or outperforms closed-source APIs and prior methods relying on labeled rewards, while requiring no task label at training.

AI.tldr: BUMP 是一种自监督框架，通过双向批内排序目标训练 LLM 生成用户文本画像，无需任何下游任务标注即可实现个性化，在 LaMP 基准上匹配或超越依赖标注奖励的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 个性化方法依赖下游任务标注信号来训练用户画像生成器，但标注成本高、稀疏且难以泛化到新任务。作者希望利用原始交互日志本身，以自监督方式训练画像生成器，消除对标注的依赖。
AI.method: 提出 BUMP 框架：给定用户交互历史，使用 GRPO 训练 LLM 生成自由文本画像，优化目标为双向批内排序——(1) 以生成画像为查询，评估其对用户自身留出交互的排序能力；(2) 以留出交互为查询，评估其对用户自身画像的排序能力。两者均使用多正样本 NDCG 评分并合并为稠密奖励，批内其他用户提供天然负样本。
AI.result: 在 LaMP 基准上，BUMP 匹配或超越闭源 API 及依赖标注奖励的先前方法，且训练时完全不需要任务标签。
AI.conclusion: BUMP 证明通过双向排序目标利用原始交互日志即可有效训练用户画像生成器，实现零任务标注的 LLM 个性化，为低成本、可泛化的个性化 LLM 提供了新范式。

title: REGEN: Reference-Guided Synthetic Multivariate Time Series Generation for Forecasting
summary:
Training robust multivariate time series forecasting models requires large, diverse corpora, yet many real-world domains provide only a handful of observed sequences. Existing generators fail to resolve this mismatch: prior-based approaches (e.g., CauKer, TimePFN) produce domain-agnostic samples, while data-driven methods (e.g., TimeGAN) treat references as black-box supervision, forfeiting explicit control over periodic structure, local variability, and cross-variable dynamics.
  We propose ReGeN, a reference-guided generative pipeline that treats observed sequences not as examples to imitate, but as structural scaffolds for controllable synthesis. ReGeN decomposes each reference into three interpretable components: a phase-aligned periodic backbone capturing dominant domain morphology; per-variable stochastic residuals modeled with a deep-kernel Gaussian process; and lag-aware cross-variable dependencies injected through a structural causal model with fitted coupling coefficients. Sampling these components at controllable temperature broadens distributional coverage while preserving domain-grounded structure.
  We show that ReGeN-generated data consistently substitutes for real sibling data with minimal forecasting degradation, and in strongly periodic domains such as traffic, can outperform the real source itself. We further show that a foundation model pretrained on ReGeN corpora outperforms those pretrained on prior-based and data-driven synthetic alternatives. This suggests that in low-data regimes, how reference data is structurally exploited can matter as much as how much data is available.

AI.tldr: ReGeN 是一种参考引导的生成管线，将观测序列分解为相位对齐的周期骨架、深度核高斯过程残差、以及结构因果模型中的跨变量依赖，通过可控温度采样实现保持域结构的多样化合成，在低数据场景下生成的合成数据可替代甚至超越真实数据。
AI.motivation: 真实世界中许多领域仅能提供少量观测序列，现有生成方法要么产生域无关的样本（基于先验的方法），要么将参考数据视为黑箱监督而丧失对周期结构、局部变异和跨变量动态的显式控制（数据驱动方法），两者均无法弥合数据供需之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: ReGeN 将每条参考序列分解为三个可解释组件：(1) 相位对齐的周期骨架，通过捕获主导域形态来建模全局周期性；(2) 逐变量随机残差，采用深度核高斯过程进行灵活建模；(3) 基于结构因果模型注入的滞后感知跨变量依赖，通过拟合耦合系数实现。各组件可在可控的温度参数下独立采样，在保持域结构的同时扩展分布覆盖范围。
AI.result: ReGeN 生成的数据可一致地替代真实兄弟数据且预测性能退化极小；在交通等强周期域中，合成数据甚至超越真实数据。此外，在 ReGeN 语料上预训练的基础模型优于在基于先验和数据驱动的合成替代方案上预训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: 在低数据场景下，如何从结构上利用参考数据，其重要性不亚于拥有多少数据量。

title: Mutation Without Variation: Convergence Dynamics in LLM-Driven Program Evolution
comment: Accepted to the Genetic and Evolutionary Computation Conference (GECCO '26) Workshop on Large Language Models for and with Evolutionary Computation
summary: When an LLM repeatedly mutates a program, does it explore new forms or circle back to the same ones? We study this question by analyzing LLM-driven mutation chains in the absence of selection pressure within a domain-specific language, varying prompt design, model family, and stochastic replication. We find that LLM-based mutation consistently converges toward restricted attractor regions in program space. Convergence is especially severe at the structural level: in 87% of chains, over 93% of mutations revisit a previously seen structural form, with most variation confined to terminal substitutions within recurring templates. Cycle analysis reveals short cycles and self-loops dominating the transition structure. The rate of convergence varies with prompt wording and model choice, but the phenomenon is robust across conditions. A classical GP subtree mutation operator does not exhibit comparable convergence, suggesting that the effect is intrinsic to the LLM mutation pipeline. These findings reveal a tension at the heart of LLM-driven program evolution: the same capabilities that enable semantics-aware program transformation also carry a systematic bias toward structural homogeneity that must be accounted for if such systems are to sustain open-ended exploration. Source code is available at https://github.com/can-gurkan/lmca.

AI.tldr: 研究了LLM在无选择压力下对程序进行反复变异时的行为，发现变异链会收敛到有限的"吸引子"区域，尤其在结构层面：87%的链中超过93%的变异会重复出现已有的结构形式。该现象在多种提示设计、模型和随机复制条件下均稳健存在，而传统GP子树变异算子则未表现出类似收敛，说明这是LLM变异管道的内禀偏差。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM驱动的程序变异是否真正产生新颖性，还是在无选择压力下会陷入重复模式。这直接关系到LLM在程序演化、自动化编程和开放式探索中的适用性。
AI.method: 在领域特定语言（DSL）中，构建LLM驱动的变异链（mutation chains），不加选择压力。系统性地变换提示设计（prompt design）、模型家族（model family）和随机复制（stochastic replication）三个因素，分析变异链的程序空间轨迹。通过结构级相似度统计、循环分析（cycle analysis）等方法量化收敛程度，并与传统遗传编程（GP）子树变异算子进行对照实验。
AI.result: LLM变异一致地收敛到程序空间中的受限吸引子区域。结构层面收敛尤为严重：87%的变异链中，超过93%的变异重新访问已见过的结构形式，大部分变化仅限于在重复出现的模板内进行终结符替换。循环分析显示短循环和自环主导了转移结构。收敛速率受提示措辞和模型选择影响，但整体现象跨条件稳健。经典GP子树变异算子未表现出可比拟的收敛，表明该效应为LLM变异管道所固有。
AI.conclusion: LLM的程序变异能力存在内在张力：语义感知的程序变换能力同时也携带着系统性的结构同质化偏向。若要将LLM用于开放式程序演化，必须对这种收敛倾向进行显式补偿或设计相应的多样性保持机制。

title: ORACLE-CT: Anatomy-Aware Support Pooling for CT Classification
summary:
Abdominal CT disease classification is challenging because each scan is a large 3D volume with many possible findings, while diagnostic evidence is often confined to specific organs or anatomical compartments. Most study-level classifiers aggregate encoder features using anatomy-agnostic pooling or attention, creating a mismatch between localized disease evidence and global evidence aggregation. We propose ORACLE--CT, an encoder-agnostic anatomy-aware aggregation framework that uses multi-organ segmentation to define label-specific anatomical supports and restrict attention pooling to relevant regions. The framework supports single-organ, multi-organ union, comparative, localized, and global support strategies.
  We evaluate ORACLE--CT with three encoder families: DINOv3, I3D--ResNet-121, and the radiology-native Pillar--0 encoder. Models are trained end-to-end on MERLIN and evaluated internally and under frozen external transfer to Duke--Abdomen and AMOS. Compared with global average pooling, support-masked pooling improved MERLIN macro-AUROC/AUPRC from 0.838/0.638 to 0.858/0.676 for DINOv3 and from 0.829/0.617 to 0.848/0.659 for I3D--ResNet-121. On harmonized 10-label external evaluation, DINOv3 improved on Duke--Abdomen from 0.802/0.628 to 0.835/0.683 and on AMOS from 0.742/0.313 to 0.762/0.350, with similar gains for I3D--ResNet-121. For Pillar--0, most gains came from learned attention, with smaller additional benefit from anatomical masking. ORACLE--CT improves discrimination and external robustness while preserving an auditable link between predictions and anatomical evidence.

AI.tldr: ORACLE-CT 提出一种基于多器官分割的解剖感知聚合框架，通过将注意力池化限制在标签特定的解剖支持区域内，解决了腹部CT分类中局部病灶证据与全局池化不匹配的问题。在多个编码器和外部数据集上均验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 腹部CT疾病分类面临的核心矛盾：每个扫描是大型3D体积，诊断证据往往局限于特定器官或解剖区域，但现有研究级分类器多采用解剖无关的全局池化或注意力机制，导致局部病灶证据与全局聚合方式不匹配。
AI.method: 提出ORACLE-CT框架：(1) 利用多器官分割定义标签特定的解剖支持区域（anatomical supports）；(2) 将注意力池化限制在这些区域内，支持单器官、多器官联合、比较性、局部及全局五种策略；(3) 编码器无关设计，可适配DINOv3、I3D-ResNet-121、Pillar-0等多种编码器。
AI.result: 在MERLIN数据集上，DINOv3的macro-AUROC/AUPRC从0.838/0.638提升至0.858/0.676；I3D-ResNet-121从0.829/0.617提升至0.848/0.659。外部迁移至Duke-Abdomen（DINOv3从0.802/0.628到0.835/0.683）和AMOS（DINOv3从0.742/0.313到0.762/0.350）均有显著增益。Pillar-0的提升主要来自学习注意力，解剖掩码增益较小。
AI.conclusion: ORACLE-CT通过解剖感知聚合提升了腹部CT疾病分类的判别能力和外部鲁棒性，同时保留了预测与解剖证据之间的可审计联系，为临床可解释性提供了保障。

title: Trajectory Dynamics in Language Model Hidden States Predict Human Processing Costs Beyond Surprisal
summary: Human language comprehension unfolds sequentially: each word is processed in the context of those that came before, and the interpretation builds incrementally over time. Surprisal, the negative log probability of a word given its context, has been the dominant predictor of incremental processing cost. But surprisal reduces rich sequential representations to a single scalar at each word, discarding information about the direction in which the interpretation has been evolving. Dynamical-systems approaches suggest that the trajectory of the evolving interpretive state, not just its position at each moment,should shape processing, and language itself may have local momentum, since speakers plan utterances a few words at a time. We introduce trajectory extrapolation error: at each word, we fit a linear trajectory to the preceding hidden states of a transformer language model and measure deviation from the extrapolated path. On the Natural Stories corpus, this measure is nearly orthogonal to surprisal (r = .044) and independently predicts self-paced reading times. The effect is especially pronounced in garden-path sentences, strengthens with model scale (GPT-2 Small to Large), and replicates across architectures with different positional encoding schemes (GPT-2 vs. Pythia/RoPE). A displacement control shows the effect is not reducible to representational change magnitude: displacement and extrapolation error predict in opposite directions. These findings reveal two dissociable components of processing cost: word-level prediction error (surprisal) and sensitivity to the local momentum of the unfolding interpretation (trajectory extrapolation error).

AI.tldr: 本文提出"轨迹外推误差"（trajectory extrapolation error）这一新指标，通过拟合Transformer语言模型前文隐藏状态的线性轨迹并测量偏离程度，捕捉理解过程中解释轨迹的局部动量。该指标与surprisal近乎正交（r=.044），能独立预测阅读时间，尤其在花园路径句中效应显著，且随模型规模增大而增强。
AI.motivation: Surprisal将丰富的序列表征压缩为单一标量，丢失了关于解释方向演变的信息。动态系统理论表明，理解过程的轨迹（而不仅仅是每时刻的位置）应影响加工成本，且语言本身因说话者按几个词为单位规划话语而具有局部动量。因此需要一种能捕捉这种轨迹级信息的度量。
AI.method: 研究者提出"轨迹外推误差"：在每个词处，对Transformer语言模型前几个时间步的隐藏状态拟合一条线性轨迹，然后测量当前词的实际隐藏状态与从该轨迹外推得到的预期状态之间的偏差（欧氏距离）。在Natural Stories语料库上进行自定步速阅读时间实验，并设置了"位移控制"（displacement control）以排除表征变化幅度的混淆。跨GPT-2 Small到Large及Pythia/RoPE架构进行验证。
AI.result: 轨迹外推误差与surprisal近乎正交（r=.044），且独立显著预测自定步速阅读时间。在花园路径句中效应尤为突出。效应随模型规模（GPT-2 Small → Large）增强，并在不同位置编码架构间可复现（GPT-2 vs. Pythia/RoPE）。位移控制分析表明，外推误差与位移方向相反地预测加工成本，效应不可归约为表征变化幅度。
AI.conclusion: 加工成本存在两个可分离的成分：词级预测误差（surprisal）和对展开中解释的局部动量的敏感性（轨迹外推误差）。这为语言理解的动态系统视角提供了计算和实证支持。

title: Data-efficient flood depth prediction through domain-aware coreset selection and tabular foundation models
summary: Near-real-time flood depth prediction demands surrogate models that are accurate, fast, and transferable across watersheds. Supervised surrogates can match physics-based simulators in accuracy but need millions of training rows per watershed and cannot extrapolate beyond their original mesh. We propose a domain-aware coreset construction pipeline that conditions a tabular foundation model at inference time. The pipeline stratifies storms by return period and most-affected watershed, then samples hexagons with a target-aware spatial selector. With 0.7% of the per-watershed training pool, the model attains a mean $R^2$ of 0.663 across nine Houston-area watersheds, within 98.5% of the supervised reference ($R^2$ = 0.673). It transfers to held-out watersheds without task-specific retraining, staying ahead of a coreset-trained supervised baseline. On real storms it exceeds the supervised reference on a far out-of-distribution case and trails it on a mostly in-distribution one. Domain-aware coreset construction lets tabular foundation models deliver data-efficient, watershed-transferable flood predictions without per-watershed training.

AI.tldr: 提出一种领域感知的核心集构建方法，使表格基础模型在推理时只需0.7%的流域训练数据即可实现与全量监督模型相当的洪水深度预测精度，并具备跨流域迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 洪水深度近实时预测需要准确、快速且可跨流域迁移的替代模型。现有监督替代模型虽精度高，但每个流域需数百万训练行且无法外推到原始网格之外，数据效率和迁移性严重不足。
AI.method: 提出领域感知核心集构建流程：(1) 按重现期和最受影响流域对风暴进行分层；(2) 使用目标感知空间选择器采样六边形网格单元；(3) 在推理时用构建的核心集条件化表格基础模型，无需逐流域训练。
AI.result: 仅用每流域0.7%的训练数据，在休斯顿区域9个流域上达到平均R²=0.663，相当于监督参考模型（R²=0.673）的98.5%；在留存的未见过流域上无需任务特定重训练即可迁移；在真实风暴的远分布外案例中超越监督模型。
AI.conclusion: 领域感知核心集构建使表格基础模型能够以极高数据效率实现可跨流域迁移的洪水预测，摆脱了对逐流域大规模训练的依赖。

title: A Motivational Architecture for Conversational AGI
summary: Motivational architectures in cognitive AI have largely been designed for physical agents regulating bodily needs. Conversational agents operate in a different regime: their sensorimotor loop is linguistic, their environment is a user's evolving mental state, and their consequential actions are speech acts, tool invocations, and strategic silences. This paper proposes a conversational reinterpretation of the OpenPsi motivational lineage, coupled to MetaMo's higher-level motivational scaffold, for agents built on a modular execution substrate. Homeostasis is recast in dialogue-native terms: the agent regulates competence, uncertainty reduction, affiliation, affinity, legitimacy, nurturing, and aesthetic coherence rather than bodily deficits. We propose three contributions: a ten-stage motivational processing pipeline that architecturally separates cognitive modulation from situational appraisal; a dual decision strategy blending urgency-driven fast response with deliberative multi-goal optimization; and an architecturally useful distinction between pre-action feelings and post-action emotions as functionally different forms of affect. We specialize the framework to two example agents -- CompanionAgent and ResearchAgent -- and sketch its extension to social robotics and domain-generic human-level AGI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将OpenPsi动机体系进行对话式重新诠释，并与MetaMo高层动机支架相结合，为模块化执行基底上的对话智能体构建动机架构。核心创新包括：十阶段动机处理管线、双决策策略（紧急快速响应+审慎多目标优化），以及前行动感受与后行动情绪的功能性区分。
AI.motivation: 现有认知AI的动机架构主要面向需要调节身体需求的物理智能体设计。对话智能体运行在截然不同的机制中：感知-运动回路是语言性的，环境是用户不断演化的心理状态，行动是言语行为、工具调用和策略性沉默。因此需要一种对话原生的动机架构来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 1）提出十阶段动机处理管线，将认知调制与情境评估在架构层面分离；2）设计双决策策略，融合基于紧迫性的快速响应与审慎的多目标优化；3）将内生稳态（homeostasis）重新定义为对话原生指标：能力感、不确定性消减、归属感、亲和力、正当性、培育性和审美一致性；4）区分"行动前感受"与"行动后情绪"两种功能不同的情感形式；5）在CompanionAgent和ResearchAgent两个实例上专门化该框架，并延伸至社交机器人及通用人类级AGI。
AI.result: 成功构建了一个对话原生的动机架构，将OpenPsi动机谱系与MetaMo高层动机支架耦合。通过两个具体智能体实例（CompanionAgent和ResearchAgent）验证了框架的可专门化能力，并论证了其向社交机器人和领域通用AGI的扩展潜力。
AI.conclusion: 对话智能体需要与物理智能体不同的动机架构。通过在对话原生维度上重新定义内生稳态，结合分离式动机处理管线、双决策策略以及前行动感受/后行动情绪的功能区分，该框架为对话AI的动机建模提供了系统性解决方案，并具备向社会机器人和人类级AGI扩展的潜力。

title: Formal Concept Lattices are Good Semantic Scaffolds for Concept-Based Learning
summary: Learning semantics is essential for deep learning models to be interpretable and better aligned with human reasoning. Concept-based models approach this by representing classes through meaningful semantic abstractions, but typically treat all concepts as a flat, unstructured set learned at a single neural network layer. This overlooks a fundamental property of human semantic understanding: concepts being organized hierarchically, from general to specific. While deep networks do learn a hierarchy of visual features, this structure is rarely aligned with explicit semantic hierarchies. Drawing on Formal Concept Analysis, we demonstrate that formal concept lattices provide principled semantic scaffolds to guide neural network learning. These lattices naturally identify where in the network concepts should be learned based on their level of generality. This allows the model to develop staged, semantically grounded representations throughout its depth. Empirical results on real-world datasets show that our models produce more interpretable embeddings, support more effective interventions, and learn concept representations that are both meaningful and hierarchically structured.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用形式概念分析中的概念格作为语义支架，引导神经网络在正确的深度层级学习不同抽象程度的概念，从而构建具有层级化、可解释语义表示的模型。
AI.motivation: 现有基于概念的模型将概念视为扁平、无结构集合，忽略了人类语义理解的核心特性——概念是分层组织的（从一般到具体）。深度网络虽能学习层级化视觉特征，但该层级结构很少与显式语义层次对齐。
AI.method: 借鉴形式概念分析（FCA）理论，以形式概念格（formal concept lattices）作为语义支架来指导神经网络学习。概念格根据概念的泛化程度，自然地决定每个概念应在网络的哪一层被学习，使得模型在整个深度上逐步发展出有语义基础的阶段性表示。
AI.result: 在真实世界数据集上的实验表明，所提模型生成的可解释嵌入更优、支持更有效的干预操作，且学习到的概念表示既具有语义意义又呈现层级化结构。
AI.conclusion: 将FCA概念格与深度学习结合，能够有效赋予模型层级化语义理解能力，为构建更符合人类推理方式的可解释AI提供了新路径。

title: Discrete Causal Representations from Heterogeneous Domains: A Bayesian Approach with Social Survey Applications
summary: Causal representation learning aims to infer the high-level latent causal concepts that give rise to observed low-level measurements. This is particularly relevant for heterogeneous data from different environments or domains since distribution shifts often arise through sparse, localized changes in some of the underlying causal mechanisms, while other parts of the generative process remain unchanged. Whereas identifiability of causal representations has been studied extensively, practical uncertainty-aware methods and real-world use cases remain less explored. In this work, we propose a Bayesian approach to learning causal representations from multi-environment data, focusing on the case of discrete causal concepts and unknown multi-node soft interventions. To this end, we translate causal assumptions and interpretability desiderata into suitable priors and parametric choices within a hierarchical model. We then devise an inference scheme based on sequential Monte Carlo sampling to approximate the resulting multimodal posterior. We showcase our approach through case studies on social survey data, where latent causal concepts correspond to cultural values or political opinions, measurements to survey responses, and environments to different countries or states. Our model infers meaningful high-level concepts and plausible causal relations among them, demonstrating its utility for learning causal representations of complex real-world data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种贝叶斯方法，从多环境数据中学习离散因果概念的因果表征，通过层次模型中的先验设计和序贯蒙特卡洛采样推断多模态后验，并在社会调查数据上验证了其发现文化价值观间因果关系的有效性。
AI.motivation: 当前因果表征学习的研究主要集中在可识别性理论上，而实用的、能量化不确定性的方法及其在真实世界数据上的应用仍较少被探索。特别是在多环境异构数据中，分布偏移往往由少数因果机制的稀疏局部变化引起，如何利用这一特性从观测数据中推断潜在因果概念是一个重要但未充分解决的问题。
AI.method: 提出一个层次贝叶斯模型，将因果假设（如稀疏干预、机制不变性）和可解释性需求转化为合适的先验分布和参数化选择。针对离散因果概念和未知多节点软干预的场景，采用序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）采样进行近似推断，以捕获后验分布的多模态特性。
AI.result: 在社会调查数据（涵盖不同国家/州的问卷回答）上进行了案例研究，模型成功推断出有意义的潜在高层概念（如文化价值观、政治观点）及其间的合理因果关系，展示了该方法在复杂真实数据上学习因果表征的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 该贝叶斯因果表征学习方法能够有效从多环境观测数据中发现可解释的潜在因果结构，并通过不确定性量化提供更可靠的推断结果，为因果表征学习在社会科学等真实场景中的应用开辟了新路径。

title: ReasoningFlow: Discourse Structures for Understanding LLM Reasoning Traces
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) produce reasoning traces with non-linear structures, such as backtracking and self-correction, that complicate the evaluation and monitoring of the reasoning process. We introduce ReasoningFlow, a framework that captures the discourse structures of LRM reasoning traces into fine-grained directed acyclic graphs (DAGs). We develop and validate our annotation schema through careful manual annotation of 31 traces (2.1k steps), achieving high inter-annotator agreement, then scale to automatic annotation of 1,260 traces (247.7k steps) spanning three tasks (math, science, argumentation) and five models (Qwen2.5-32B-Inst, QwQ-32B, DeepSeek-V3, DeepSeek-R1, GPT-oss-120B). By analyzing ReasoningFlow graphs, we find: (1) LRMs exhibit structurally similar traces, despite being trained from different base models and potentially non-overlapping post-training data. (2) ReasoningFlow reveals diverse fine-grained reasoning behaviors (e.g., local verification, self-reflection, and assumptions) that can be used for better reasoning trace monitorability. (3) In LRMs, most of the erroneous steps are not used to derive final answers. (4) Mechanistic causal dependencies between steps do not reflect the language-level discourse structure. We release the dataset and code in: https://github.com/jinulee-v/reasoningflow.

AI.tldr: 推理流(ReasoningFlow)框架将大型推理模型的非线性推理轨迹转化为有向无环图,通过分析1260条轨迹发现:不同模型呈现相似结构、可细粒度监控推理行为、大部分错误步骤不影响最终答案、步骤间的因果依赖与语言层面的话语结构不一致。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型(LRM)产生的推理轨迹具有回溯、自我修正等非线性结构,给推理过程的评估和监控带来困难。现有线性分析方法无法充分捕捉这些复杂的话语结构,因此需要一个能够精细刻画推理轨迹结构的框架。
AI.method: 作者提出ReasoningFlow框架,将LRM推理轨迹的话语结构捕获为细粒度有向无环图(DAG)。首先通过人工标注31条轨迹(2100步)开发并验证标注模式,达到高标注者间一致性;随后扩展至自动标注1260条轨迹(24.77万步),覆盖数学、科学、论证三个任务和五个模型(Qwen2.5-32B-Inst、QwQ-32B、DeepSeek-V3、DeepSeek-R1、GPT-oss-120B)。
AI.result: (1)尽管基于不同基座模型和可能不重叠的后训练数据,LRM仍展现出结构相似的推理轨迹;(2)ReasoningFlow揭示了多样化的细粒度推理行为(如局部验证、自我反思、假设提出),可用于提升推理轨迹的可监控性;(3)LRM中大部分错误步骤并未用于推导最终答案;(4)步骤间的机制性因果依赖与语言层面的话语结构并不一致。
AI.conclusion: ReasoningFlow为理解和监控LRM的推理过程提供了新的结构化视角,揭示了推理轨迹中话语结构与因果依赖之间的差异,对改进推理模型的设计与评估具有启示意义。

title: Sharp Low-Degree Thresholds for Planted-vs-Planted Testing
summary: We establish the first sharp thresholds for low-degree polynomial tests in planted-vs-planted settings, where the goal is to determine with vanishing error which of two structured planted mechanisms generated the observed data. We prove matching low-degree upper and lower bounds for counting communities in the planted submatrix and planted dense subgraph models. The resulting testing threshold coincides, down to the sharp constant, with the known low-degree recovery threshold. In contrast, the task of weak testing, where the goal is to outperform random guessing, does not have a sharp threshold but rather a smooth transition, which we identify. To prove our results, we develop a framework for planted-vs-planted testing that builds on a latent-variable expansion originating in low-degree recovery and employs new methods to identify and prune non-signal contributions.

AI.tldr: 该论文在 planted-vs-planted（两个结构化模型间判别）的低次多项式测试中首次建立了尖锐阈值，证明计数社区在 planted 子矩阵和 planted 稠密子图模型中的匹配上下界，并揭示弱测试存在平滑过渡而非尖锐阈值。
AI.motivation: 在先前的 planted 模型中，低次多项式测试与恢复的阈值关系已被广泛研究，但 planted-vs-planted 设定（即区分两个不同的结构化 planted 机制）缺乏尖锐阈值结果。论文旨在填补这一空白，精确刻画该设定下低次多项式测试的计算极限。
AI.method: 作者开发了一个基于潜变量展开（latent-variable expansion）的 planted-vs-planted 测试框架，该展开源自低次恢复领域。框架通过低次多项式上下界的匹配论证，并对非信号贡献进行识别与剪枝（pruning），从而推导出尖锐的测试阈值。
AI.result: 在 planted 子矩阵和 planted 稠密子图模型中，得到了低次多项式测试的匹配上下界，且该测试阈值（精确到尖锐常数）与已知的低次恢复阈值一致。此外，弱测试（目标仅为优于随机猜测）不存在尖锐阈值，而是呈现平滑过渡，论文精确刻画了这一过渡区域。
AI.conclusion: Planted-vs-planted 测试在低次多项式框架下确实存在尖锐阈值，且与恢复阈值精确对应；弱测试任务则呈现本质上不同的平滑相变行为。新开发的潜变量展开与剪枝框架为后续 planted-vs-planted 分析提供了通用工具。

title: Assessing the Carbon Emissions and Energy Consumption of U.S. Hyperscale Data Centers
summary: The rapid proliferation of hyperscale data centers (HDCs) in the US, mainly driven by the adoption of artificial intelligence, has raised concerns about this industry's environmental footprint. We compiled facility-level information on 403 US hyperscale data centers operating between May 2024 and April 2025 and estimated their electricity consumption, electricity sources, and attributable CO2 emissions. Across different facility-load scenarios, these HDCs consumed approximately 68-99 TWh of electricity and were associated with about 37-54 million metric tons of CO2. Under the central scenario, HDC electricity demand corresponded to approximately 1.8% of total US electricity consumption, with roughly 54% of attributed generation supplied by fossil-fuel sources. The HDC electricity-weighted average carbon intensity was approximately 545 gCO2/kWh, about 48% above the contemporaneous US national grid-average carbon intensity of 370 gCO2/kWh. Our approach provides an attributional tool for assessing the environmental footprint of hyperscale data centers using the most recent EPA eGRID plant-level data.

AI.tldr: 该研究汇编了2024年5月至2025年4月期间美国403个超大规模数据中心的设施级数据，估算了其电力消耗、电力来源及归因CO₂排放。结果显示，数据中心消耗约68-99 TWh电力，排放约3700-5400万吨CO₂，其电力碳强度（约545 gCO₂/kWh）比美国电网平均值（370 gCO₂/kWh）高出约48%。
AI.motivation: 以人工智能应用为主要驱动力，美国超大规模数据中心迅速扩张，其环境足迹引发广泛关注。该研究旨在量化该行业的电力消耗结构、化石燃料依赖度及归因碳排放，弥补设施级精细化评估的空白。
AI.method: 汇编2024年5月至2025年4月期间403个美国超大规模数据中心的设施级信息；利用EPA eGRID电厂级数据，在不同设施负荷情景下估算电力消耗、电力来源及归因CO₂排放，并计算电力加权平均碳强度。
AI.result: 在中心情景下，HDC电力需求约占美国总用电量的1.8%；约54%的归因发电来自化石燃料；电力加权平均碳强度约545 gCO₂/kWh，高出同期美国电网平均值（370 gCO₂/kWh）约48%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一套基于最新EPA eGRID电厂级数据的归因工具，可用于评估超大规模数据中心的环境足迹，揭示了当前数据中心电力碳强度显著高于全国电网平均水平，暗示其能源采购和选址策略在减碳方面存在改进空间。

title: Can We Predict The Human Preference For Text-to-Image Content Prior To Generation And Is It Even Useful To Do So?
summary: Diffusion Models (DM) have revolutionized text-driven generation by enabling the synthesis of high-quality, photorealistic visual content from user prompts. Whereas prior advances in visual generation such as VAEs and GANs were primarily evaluated on perceptual or visual similarity metrics such as FID PSNR, DM advances have fostered the development of more advanced Human Preference Metrics (HPM) that model and quantify human judgment as scalar values. However, DMs synthesize content using an inherently stochastic process where random noise seeds generation. The initial random noise directly affects the quality of generated outputs, both qualitatively and quantitatively. This influence is pronounced in smaller models for local deployment scenarios. Given this phenomenon, we first investigate to what extent we can predict scalar HPM scores prior to committing compute resources for generation. Further, we then investigate to what extent we can leverage such prediction to improve the quality of generated images, and also study which HPMs are best suited for this task. Our investigation reveals that not only is this possible, but that it is feasible to achieve negligible hardware overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文研究扩散模型中初始随机噪声对人类偏好指标(HPM)评分的影响，发现可以在生成前预测HPM评分，并利用该预测以极小的硬件开销提升生成图像质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型的随机噪声种子直接影响生成输出的质量，尤其在本地部署的小型模型中更为显著。现有研究缺乏对生成前预测质量评分可行性的探索，以及如何利用该预测来优化生成质量。
AI.method: 首先研究在投入计算资源进行生成之前预测标量HPM评分的可行性；然后探索如何利用预测来提升生成图像质量；同时比较不同HPM在此任务中的适用性。
AI.result: 实验表明，在生成前预测HPM评分是可行的，且能够以可忽略的硬件开销实现基于预测的质量提升。
AI.conclusion: 论文验证了利用噪声层面的预测来指导扩散模型生成的可行性，为低成本优化生成质量提供了新思路。

title: Symmetric Divergence and Normalized Similarity: A Unified Topological Framework for Representation Analysis
summary: Topological Data Analysis (TDA) offers a principled, intrinsic lens for comparing neural representations. However, existing paired topological divergences (e.g., RTD) are limited by heuristic asymmetry and, more critically, unbounded scores that depend on sample size, hindering reliable cross-scenario benchmarking. To address these challenges, we develop a unified topological toolkit serving two complementary needs: fine-grained structural diagnosis and robust, standardized evaluation. First, we complete the RTD framework by introducing Symmetric Representation Topology Divergence (SRTD) and its efficient variant SRTD-lite. Beyond resolving the theoretical asymmetry of prior variants, SRTD consolidates diagnostic information into a single, comprehensive cross-barcode signature. This allows for precise localization of structural discrepancies and serves as an effective optimization objective without the overhead of dual directional computations. Second, to enable reliable benchmarking across heterogeneous settings, we propose Normalized Topological Similarity (NTS). By measuring the rank correlation of hierarchical merge orders, NTS yields a scale-invariant metric bounded between -1 and 1, effectively overcoming the scale and sample-dependence of unnormalized divergences. Experiments across synthetic and real-world deep learning settings demonstrate that our toolkit captures functional shifts in CNNs missed by geometric measures and robustly maps LLM genealogy even under distance saturation, offering a rigorous, topology-aware perspective that complements measures like CKA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套统一的拓扑数据分析工具包，包含两个核心组件：(1) 对称表示拓扑散度(SRTD)及其高效变体SRTD-lite，解决了现有RTD框架的启发式不对称性问题，并整合了双向诊断信息；(2) 归一化拓扑相似度(NTS)，通过测量层次合并顺序的秩相关性，生成有界于[-1,1]的尺度不变度量，克服了非归一化散度对样本量和尺度的依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有配对拓扑散度（如RTD）存在两大缺陷：一是启发式的不对称性在理论上不完善，二是得分无界且依赖于样本量，导致无法在不同场景间进行可靠的基准测试。这限制了TDA在神经表示比较中的实际应用。
AI.method: 方法包含两部分：(1) SRTD：通过对称化RTD框架，将诊断信息整合到单一的跨条形码签名(cross-barcode signature)中，实现结构差异的精确定位，同时避免双向计算开销；(2) NTS：利用层次归并顺序(hierarchical merge orders)的秩相关性测量拓扑相似度，得到一个尺度不变且严格有界于[-1,1]的度量。
AI.result: 在合成数据和真实深度学习场景实验中，该工具包能够捕捉CNN中几何度量遗漏的功能性偏移，并能在距离饱和条件下鲁棒地映射LLM的谱系关系，提供了与CKA等度量互补的拓扑视角。
AI.conclusion: 作者构建的统一拓扑工具包为神经表示比较提供了双重能力：SRTD服务于细粒度结构诊断，NTS服务于鲁棒的标准化评估。该框架从拓扑学视角填补了现有方法的空白，是对CKA等几何度量的重要补充。

title: When Evidence is Sparse: Weakly Supervised Early Failure Alerting in Dialogs and LLM-Agent Trajectories
summary: Early failure alerting requires deciding, while a dialog or agent trajectory is still unfolding, whether to flag it as likely to fail. This is challenging because supervision is typically available only as a trajectory-level success/failure label while alerts must be raised from partial interactions. Prior early-classification methods often bridge this gap by assigning the terminal label to every prefix, treating every turn as failure evidence. We hypothesize that this prefix-label assumption is poorly matched to multi-turn language interactions, where evidence of eventual failure is sparse and often delayed. In this paper, we introduce a two-stage approach that learns from this sparse evidence structure and uses the resulting risk estimates for controllable early alerting. Specifically, our attention-based failure predictor learns sparse turn-level failure evidence from trajectory labels and uses it to estimate failure risk from partial histories. We then pair this predictor with $α$-STOP, a single preference-conditioned stopping policy that selects an accuracy-earliness operating point at inference time rather than training a separate trigger for each preference. Across five benchmarks spanning customer support, task-oriented dialog, persuasion, tool use, and planning, we first show that high-relevance failure evidence occupies only 4.7-11.3% of turns and first appears after 59.0-83.6\% of trajectories on average. We further show that the attention-based predictor improves Pareto-frontier quality (hypervolume) by 1-10\% over naive prefix supervision, and that the full system improves frontier quality by 3-42\% over state-of-the-art trigger policies while reducing training cost per operating point by 1-3 orders of magnitude.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种两阶段早期故障预警方法：先用基于注意力的故障预测器从轨迹标签中学习稀疏的回合级故障证据，再结合α-STOP可控停止策略，在五个基准上显著提升Pareto前沿质量，训练成本降低1-3个数量级。
AI.motivation: 现有早期分类方法将终端标签赋给每个前缀，假设每轮交互都是失败证据，但多轮语言交互中失败证据稀疏且延迟出现，这种前缀标签假设与实际不匹配。
AI.method: 提出两阶段方法：(1) 基于注意力的故障预测器，从轨迹级标签中学习稀疏的回合级故障证据，用于从部分历史中估计故障风险；(2) α-STOP，一种单一偏好条件停止策略，可在推理时选择准确率-提前量的操作点，无需为每个偏好分别训练触发器。
AI.result: 在客服对话、任务导向对话、说服、工具使用和规划五个基准上：(1) 高相关故障证据仅占回合的4.7-11.3%，首次出现平均在59.0-83.6%轨迹之后；(2) 基于注意力的预测器在Pareto前沿质量（超体积）上比朴素前缀监督提升1-10%；(3) 完整系统前沿质量比SOTA触发器策略提升3-42%，每个操作点的训练成本降低1-3个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习稀疏的回合级故障证据结构并结合α-STOP，所提方法实现了更优的准确率-提前量权衡，且大幅降低了多偏好设置下的训练开销。

title: Learning Manifold and Itô Dynamics with Branched Neural Rough Differential Equations
summary: Neural rough differential equations (NRDEs) stay accurate under irregular sampling while taking far fewer integration steps than standard neural differential equations, summarising a finely sampled driver by its log-signature and advancing the hidden state over coarse intervals using the log-ODE method. This efficiency rests on the shuffle algebra, the algebraic counterpart of Stratonovich calculus. This reliance means NRDEs cannot expose the quadratic-variation terms Itô dynamics require, nor the ordered covariant derivatives that govern Itô flows on connection-equipped manifolds. Ameliorating this, we introduce Branched Neural Rough Differential Equations (B-NRDEs), a Hopf-algebraic framework that recasts the NRDE log-ODE step as geometric numerical integration on the state-space manifold, matching the driving algebra to the governing calculus: Grossman--Larson rooted trees for Euclidean Itô dynamics, Munthe-Kaas--Wright planar rooted trees for ordered covariant derivatives on manifolds, and the shuffle algebra in the classical Stratonovich case. This yields intrinsic coarse-step dynamics that exactly preserve manifold constraints. Finally, we introduce a branched signature-kernel objective to enable Itô-consistent law matching by making quadratic-variation terms visible during training. On rough Bergomi volatility, sim-to-real $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ dynamics forecasting, and SPD covariance dynamics, B-NRDEs offer a unified, effective approach to stochastic and manifold-valued dynamics beyond the Euclidean--Stratonovich setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分支神经粗糙微分方程（B-NRDEs），利用Hopf代数框架将NRDE的log-ODE步骤重新诠释为状态空间流形上的几何数值积分，根据不同的随机积分（Itô/Stratonovich）和空间结构（欧氏/流形）匹配相应的代数结构（Grossman–Larson有根树、Munthe-Kaas–Wright平面有根树、shuffle代数），从而在保持流形约束的同时实现内在粗步进动力学，并引入分支签名核目标函数使训练中可见二次变差项。
AI.motivation: 标准NRDE依赖shuffle代数，本质上是Stratonovich积分对应的代数结构，无法处理Itô动力学所需的二次变差项，也无法处理配备联络的流形上有序协变导数。这限制了NRDE在流形值随机动力系统和Itô型方程上的应用。
AI.method: 提出B-NRDEs框架，核心是将NRDE的log-ODE步进重新表述为流形上的几何数值积分。关键在于"将驱动代数匹配到主导积分"：欧氏Itô动力学匹配Grossman–Larson有根树（Hopf代数）；流形上有序协变导数匹配Munthe-Kaas–Wright平面有根树；经典Stratonovich情形保留shuffle代数。同时引入分支签名核目标函数，使训练过程中Itô二次变差项对损失函数可见，实现Itô一致的法律匹配（law matching）。
AI.result: 在粗糙Bergomi波动率模型、模拟到真实SO(3)动力学预测、SPD协方差动力学三个任务上验证了框架的有效性，展示了B-NRDEs能够统一处理欧氏-Stratonovich设定之外的随机和流形值动力学。
AI.conclusion: B-NRDEs通过Hopf代数视角统一了Itô/Stratonovich积分与欧氏/流形空间的NRDE粗步进方法，填补了NRDE在非Stratonovich非欧氏设定下的空白，为随机流形值动力学提供了有效且几何上一致的建模工具。

title: Minimizing the Hidden Cost of Scales: Graph-Guided Ultra-Low-Bit Quantization for Large Language Models
comment: Preprint. 18 pages, 10 figures, 7 tables, including appendix
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is critical for the efficient deployment of large language models (LLMs). Recent ultra-low-bit PTQ methods rely on rigid weight-saliency assumptions or position heuristics, introducing substantial hidden scaling overhead. We propose SAGE-PTQ (Saliency-Aware Graph-guided Efficient PTQ), a novel ultra-low-bit quantization framework for LLMs that minimizes hidden scaling cost. SAGE-PTQ separates salient and unsalient weights using distributional statistics, then models subsampled unsalient weights as a sparse graph to estimate the optimal number of groups per layer. SAGE-PTQ applies dual-mode quantization, assigning multi-bit precision to salient weights and binarizing unsalient weights. To reduce scaling overhead, SAGE-PTQ uses one per-channel scale for salient weights and one scalar per unsalient group. Finally, SAGE-PTQ implements adaptive saliency thresholding to select the optimal saliency ratio per matrix. SAGE-PTQ achieves 1.03 weight bits and only 0.004 scaling bits per matrix on average, outperforming state-of-the-art methods such as BiLLM and PB-LLM. On LLaMA-3-8B, SAGE-PTQ achieves 6.74 WikiText2 perplexity, compared to 55.8 for BiLLM, while using less than 50% of BiLLM's GPU memory. On LLaMA-2-70B, SAGE-PTQ provides 1.5x faster decoding on one NVIDIA L40 GPU, demonstrating practical inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: SAGE-PTQ 是一种面向大语言模型的超低比特后训练量化框架，通过将权重分为显著与非显著两部分并对非显著权重进行稀疏图建模，结合双模式量化和自适应阈值，以极低的缩放开销实现了 1.03 比特的平均权重位宽，在困惑度和推理速度上显著优于 BiLLM 和 PB-LLM 等现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有超低比特 PTQ 方法依赖刚性的权重显著性假设或位置启发式，导致大量隐藏的缩放开销；论文旨在设计一种能最小化缩放成本的高效超低比特量化框架。
AI.method: SAGE-PTQ 包含四个核心设计：(1) 利用分布统计量分离显著与非显著权重；(2) 将子采样的非显著权重建模为稀疏图，以估计每层最优分组数；(3) 双模式量化——显著权重采用多比特精度，非显著权重二值化，分别使用逐通道缩放标量和逐组标量以降低开销；(4) 自适应显著性阈值选择每个矩阵的最优显著比例。
AI.result: 平均每矩阵仅 1.03 权重比特和 0.004 缩放比特。在 LLaMA-3-8B 上 WikiText2 困惑度为 6.74（BiLLM 为 55.8），GPU 内存占用不到 BiLLM 的 50%；在 LLaMA-2-70B 上单张 NVIDIA L40 GPU 实现 1.5 倍加速解码。
AI.conclusion: SAGE-PTQ 以极低的缩放开销实现了接近原始精度的性能，验证了基于显著性感知图引导的自适应双模式量化在 LLM 高效部署中的有效性，为超低比特 PTQ 提供了新思路。

title: LLM-Guided ANN Index Optimization for Human-Object Interaction Retrieval
summary: Retrieval systems underpin modern AI applications -- spanning visual search, recommendation engines, and multi-modal question answering. Modern multi-stage retrieval systems require the joint optimization of highly coupled parameters, yet traditional hyperparameter optimization (HPO) methods -- including Tree-structured Parzen Estimators (TPE) and Gaussian Process Bayesian Optimization -- rely on an independence assumption that fundamentally prevents them from navigating these coupled configuration spaces. We address this limitation with a phase-aware large language model (LLM) agent that conditions each proposal on its full optimization history, navigating the coupled parameter space across phase-partitioned exploration, exploitation, and fine-tuning stages. Evaluated on the HICO-DET human-object interaction retrieval benchmark using Intel VDMS (Visual Data Management System), our agent outperforms Optuna TPE by +33.3% and VDTuner by +34.2% under SIEVE (Safeguarded Index Evaluation of Vector-search Efficiency, a quality-constrained throughput metric), delivering a 15.3x throughput gain over UniIR. Validation across three benchmarks confirms that the agent's advantage grows with the degree of parameter coupling: +33.3% on HICO-DET (high coupling), methods converge within 1% on GLDv2 (moderate coupling) and within 3.6% on SIFT1M (near-independent control). Cross-system validation on Milvus confirms the optimizer ranks first on all three datasets without modification, demonstrating transferability across vector database management system (VDBMS) platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种阶段感知的大语言模型（LLM）智能体，用于多阶段检索系统中的耦合超参数联合优化，突破了传统HPO方法依赖参数独立假设的局限。在HICO-DET等基准上，该方法显著优于Optuna TPE和VDTuner，且优势随参数耦合度增加而扩大，并具备跨VDBMS平台的迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现代多阶段检索系统包含高度耦合的参数，但传统超参数优化方法（如TPE和GP-BO）依赖参数独立性假设，无法有效导航耦合配置空间。这导致检索系统性能优化存在根本性瓶颈，亟需一种能够建模参数间依赖关系的优化方法。
AI.method: 提出一个阶段感知的LLM智能体，该智能体以完整的优化历史为条件生成每个参数提案，在阶段划分的探索（exploration）、利用（exploitation）和微调（fine-tuning）阶段中导航耦合参数空间。采用SIEVE指标（质量约束下的吞吐量）进行评估，基于Intel VDMS平台，并在HICO-DET、GLDv2、SIFT1M三个基准以及Milvus系统上进行跨平台验证。
AI.result: 在HICO-DET基准上，LLM智能体在SIEVE指标下优于Optuna TPE +33.3%、优于VDTuner +34.2%，相比UniIR实现了15.3倍的吞吐量增益。在三个不同耦合度的基准上验证了方法的可扩展性：高耦合HICO-DET上领先+33.3%，中等耦合GLDv2上方法差距收敛至1%以内，近独立控制的SIFT1M上差距在3.6%以内。在Milvus上的跨系统验证表明，该优化器无需修改即在三个数据集上均排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 阶段感知LLM智能体通过利用完整优化历史和阶段划分策略，有效解决了多阶段检索系统中耦合参数联合优化的难题。方法不仅在性能上显著超越传统HPO方法，还表现出良好的跨平台迁移性，且优势与参数耦合度呈正相关，验证了LLM在复杂超参数优化任务中的潜力。

title: Function-Space Priors for Bayesian Neural ODEs with Application to Vessel Trajectory Prediction
summary: Vessel trajectory prediction from Automatic Identification System (AIS) data is essential for maritime situational awareness, yet it remains challenging due to irregular sampling, missing reports, and complex dynamics. Beyond accurate point forecasts, maritime applications also demand well-calibrated uncertainty estimates for reliable decision-making. Bayesian Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs) offer a principled framework for continuous-time trajectory modeling with uncertainty quantification by placing a prior over the neural vector field parameters. However, the commonly used isotropic Gaussian weight prior fails to encode informative structural properties of vessel dynamics, such as smoothness and locality. Existing function-space Bayesian neural network methods address this limitation for static mappings, but do not transfer directly to Neural ODEs, where the primary quantity of interest is the trajectory rather than the vector field itself. In principle, one could place a Gaussian process (GP) prior directly over ODE solutions, but this requires propagating distributions through a nonlinear ODE solver, which is analytically intractable. To address this challenge, we adopt a practical approach that imposes a GP-kernel-based prior directly on the vector field evaluated at a finite set of measurement points. Specifically, we augment the standard weight-space variational objective with a kernel-based regularizer that penalizes deviations of the vector field from the structure implied by a GP prior. To handle long and irregular AIS trajectories, we further combine this function-space regularization with probabilistic multiple shooting, which decouples inference across temporal segments while maintaining global consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合高斯过程核先验与概率多重打靶法的贝叶斯神经常微分方程方法，用于AIS船舶轨迹预测，解决了标准贝叶斯Neural ODE中各向同性权重先验无法编码轨迹平滑性/局部性等结构先验的问题，实现更好的不确定性量化。
AI.motivation: 标准贝叶斯Neural ODE使用各向同性高斯权重先验，无法编码船舶动力学的平滑性、局部性等结构信息。现有函数空间BNN方法仅适用于静态映射，不能直接迁移到Neural ODE（因为关注的是轨迹而非向量场本身）。直接在ODE解上放置GP先验在解析上不可行（需通过非线性求解器传播分布）。
AI.method: 1) 在有限测量点集上对向量场施加基于GP-核的先验；2) 用基于核的正则化项增强标准权重空间变分目标，惩罚向量场偏离GP先验所隐含的结构；3) 结合概率多重打靶法，将长且不规则的AIS轨迹在时间片段间解耦推断，同时保持全局一致性。
AI.result: 该方法能够在AIS轨迹预测任务中产生良好校准的不确定性估计，同时保持点预测精度，并有效处理不规则采样和缺失报告问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过函数空间正则化将GP结构先验注入贝叶斯Neural ODE，辅以概率多重打靶法处理长序列，是一种实用且有效的连续时间轨迹建模与不确定性量化方案。

title: Executable Schema Contracts: From Automatic Ingestion to Multi-Source Retrieval
summary: Real-world data spans tables, documents, and semi-structured files with implicit semantics. Querying this data requires integrating evidence across inconsistent schemas and formats, yet existing approaches either demand costly manual engineering or bypass structure entirely. We present a system that automatically discovers an executable schema from raw multi-source data and uses it as a shared contract for knowledge graph construction and query-time retrieval. A closed-world field catalog constrains LLM-based schema discovery to attested fields; deterministic structural analysis infers identity keys, foreign keys, and source hierarchy; and the resulting schema drives extraction, deduplication, and cross-source linking into a provenance-aware knowledge graph. At query time the schema -- optionally extended via a monotonic protocol -- conditions a multi-tool agent routing retrieval across structured lookup, graph traversal, and vector search, returning grounded answers with traceable citations. In controlled zero-shot comparisons using the same LLM, data, and evaluation harness, the system improves over retrieval-only and decomposition-based baselines across four QA benchmarks, with ablations showing that schema-conditioned routing, structural intelligence, and schema-guided construction each contribute to the gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个自动从异构多源数据中发现可执行模式（schema）的系统，利用该模式驱动知识图谱构建和查询时检索，通过模式条件路由、结构智能和模式引导构建，在多个QA基准上超越仅检索和分解式基线。
AI.motivation: 现实世界数据跨表格、文档和半结构化文件，隐含着语义，查询需要整合不一致的模式和格式。现有方法要么依赖昂贵的人工工程，要么完全绕过结构。需要一个自动发现模式并统一利用结构的方案。
AI.method: 系统包含三大组件：(1) 闭世界字段目录约束LLM进行模式发现，仅限已证实的字段；(2) 确定性结构分析推断标识键、外键和源层级；(3) 所得模式驱动抽取、去重和跨源链接，构建带溯源的知识图谱。查询时，模式通过单调协议可选扩展后，条件化一个多工具智能体，在结构化查找、图遍历和向量搜索间路由检索，返回带可追溯引用的有据答案。
AI.result: 在受控零样本对比中（相同LLM、数据和评估框架），该系统在四个QA基准上优于仅检索和基于分解的基线方法。消融实验表明，模式条件路由、结构智能和模式引导构建各自均贡献于性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 自动发现的模式作为共享契约，能有效统一异构数据的知识图谱构建与查询检索，各组件协同带来显著的QA性能增益。

title: Anomaly Detection for Electro-Hydrostatic Actuators using LSTM Autoencoder
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables, ESREL 2026 -European Safety and Reliability Conference, accepted paper to be published
summary: Electro-Hydrostatic Actuators (EHAs) are widely used in aerospace and industrial systems, where timely detection of sensor anomalies is essential to ensure safe and reliable operation. However, the large volume and high sampling frequency of EHA sensor data pose challenges for accurate and efficient anomaly detection. Conventional statistical and classical machine-learning methods such as Z-score, Interquartile Range (IQR), Median Absolute Deviation (MAD), Isolation Forest, Gaussian Mixture, and k-means often fail to capture the temporal dependencies inherent in EHA signals, resulting in limited detection accuracy and elevated false-alarm rates. Furthermore, systematic evaluations of data-driven anomaly detection approaches for EHA systems remain scarce, particularly under varying operational conditions. This study presents an offline anomaly-detection framework for univariate EHA sensor signals, focusing on temperature and pressure data collected from a controlled test bench. The method employs a reconstruction-based Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) autoencoder, calibrated and evaluated using validation-set reconstruction-error distributions. Performance is assessed across multiple fault-injection scenarios using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, complemented by sensitivity analyses under varying operating conditions. The LSTM autoencoder achieved an average accuracy of 99.0\%, precision up to 100\%, recall between 90.2\% and 99.6\%, and F1-scores from 93.1\% to 99.8\%, demonstrating high detection sensitivity and a very low false-alarm rate across all evaluated sensors. These results highlight the feasibility of data-driven offline anomaly detection for EHAs. Future work will focus on adapting the developed framework for an online (real-time) environment.

AI.tldr: 提出基于LSTM自编码器的重构式异常检测框架，用于EHA传感器单变量信号离线异常检测，在多种故障注入场景下平均准确率达99.0%，F1分数最高99.8%，显著优于传统统计和机器学习方法。
AI.motivation: EHA传感器数据量大、采样频率高，传统方法（Z-score、IQR、MAD、Isolation Forest等）无法捕捉时序依赖性，导致检测精度有限、误报率高；且缺乏面向EHA系统数据驱动异常检测的系统性评估，尤其在不同工况下。
AI.method: 采用基于重构的LSTM自编码器框架，在受控测试台采集温度和压力传感器单变量信号，利用验证集重构误差分布进行标定与评估，通过精度、召回率、F1分数等指标在多种故障注入场景下评估性能，并进行不同工况的敏感性分析。
AI.result: LSTM自编码器平均准确率99.0%，精确率最高达100%，召回率90.2%-99.6%，F1分数93.1%-99.8%，在所有评估传感器上均表现出高检测灵敏度和极低误报率。
AI.conclusion: 验证了数据驱动离线异常检测方法在EHA系统中的可行性，未来工作将聚焦于将该框架适配至在线（实时）环境。

title: Zero knowledge verification for frontier AI training is possible
summary: Frontier AI governance frameworks increasingly use cumulative training compute as the primary criterion for designating high-impact models, but enforcement rests on self-reporting because no technical verification primitive for training exists. Any future international agreement on frontier AI faces the same problem at higher stakes: coordinated regulation of technologies with significant externalities has historically rested on technical verification, without which agreements are declaratory. Recent governance analyses judge zero-knowledge proofs a promising candidate but currently impractical at frontier scale [26, 4]. We argue the impracticality is paradigm-bound rather than fundamental, and propose a verification architecture for frontier dense pre-training combining a pre-committed training specification, inter-node network observations, and on-the-fly Merkle commitments of intermediate computation, verified through a zero-knowledge Virtual Machine (zkVM) with native BF16/FP32 precompiles. The proof checks the actual floating-point computation the GPU performed rather than a fixed-point approximation, and preserves model-architecture confidentiality through a private training specification. The protocol produces three proof types: a genesis proof at initialisation, in-training step proofs across the run, and ex-ante attestations enforcing policy-relevant claims as running invariants, turning the training record into a governance-enforceable artefact. We estimate a deployable proof of concept within approximately 36 months at single-digit-percent training-side overhead, against a six-to-ten-year cycle for verification-grade custom silicon. Thirteen open research and engineering problems are catalogued as a research agenda for external contribution

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于零知识证明的前沿AI训练验证架构，通过预承诺训练规范、节点间网络观测及Merkle承诺，结合原生支持BF16/FP32的zkVM，实现对GPU实际浮点运算的验证，并保护模型架构机密性。作者估计约36个月内可实现概念验证，训练侧开销在个位数百分点。
AI.motivation: 当前前沿AI治理框架依赖训练算力的自我报告，缺乏技术验证手段。任何未来国际AI协议都面临同样问题——历史上对具有显著外部性技术的协调监管都依赖于技术验证，否则协议仅具宣示性质。现有零知识证明方案在 frontier 规模上被认为不切实际，作者认为这是范式局限而非根本性限制。
AI.method: 提出一种针对前沿密集预训练的验证架构，包含四个核心组件：(1)预承诺的训练规范；(2)节点间网络观测；(3)中间计算的在线Merkle承诺；(4)通过原生支持BF16/FP32预编译的零知识虚拟机(zkVM)进行验证。证明针对GPU实际执行的浮点运算进行检验，并通过私有训练规范保护模型架构机密性。协议生成三种证明类型：初始化时的"创世证明"、训练过程中的"步骤证明"，以及将策略相关声明作为运行不变量的"事前attestation"。
AI.result: 作者估计约36个月内可实现可部署的概念验证，训练侧开销在个位数百分点（single-digit-percent）。相比之下，验证级定制芯片的开发周期为六到十年。同时梳理出13个开放研究与工程问题作为外部贡献的研究议程。
AI.conclusion: 前沿AI训练的零知识验证在范式上是可行的，当前的不切实际源于范式选择而非根本性限制。所提出的架构为将训练记录转化为治理可执行的工件提供了技术路径，并有望在国际AI治理协议中发挥技术验证的基石作用。

title: Unpaired RGB-Thermal Gaussian-Splatting Using Visual Geometric Transformers
comment: Accepted at ICRA 2026's Workshop MM-SpatialAI: Multi-Modal Spatial AI for Robust Navigation and Open-World Understanding
summary: Multi-modal novel view synthesis (NVS) combining RGB and thermal imagery enables precise 3D scene reconstruction with visual and thermal information. However, existing methods typically rely on precisely calibrated RGB-thermal image pairs or stereo setups, limiting scalability and practical deployment. To address this, we introduce a framework for unpaired RGB-thermal NVS that leverages VGGT, a 3D feed-forward transformer architecture, to independently estimate camera poses for each modality. The pose sets are then aligned using the Procrustes algorithm with a cross-modal feature matcher, enabling joint registration without paired calibration. Building on this alignment, we further propose a multi-modal 3D Gaussian Splatting approach that learns directly from unpaired RGB and thermal images. Experiments on diverse scenes demonstrate that our method achieves competitive performance in thermal view synthesis while maintaining RGB fidelity. Moreover, we show that existing reconstruction approaches can produce modality-specific reconstructions that lack cross-modal consistency. We thus introduce a benchmarking framework to rigorously evaluate both per-modality image synthesis and the multi-modal coherence of reconstructed scenes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需配对校准的多模态（RGB+热红外）新视角合成框架，利用VGGT独立估计各模态相机位姿，再通过Procrustes算法与跨模态特征匹配进行位姿对齐，并结合多模态3D高斯泼溅实现联合重建，同时引入基准评估框架衡量跨模态一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有RGB-热红外多模态新视角合成方法依赖精确校准的图像对或立体装置，限制了可扩展性和实际部署。作者旨在解决无配对RGB-热红外图像下的多模态场景重建问题，消除对配对校准的依赖。
AI.method: (1) 利用VGGT（3D前馈Transformer架构）独立估计RGB和热红外各模态的相机位姿；(2) 采用Procrustes算法结合跨模态特征匹配器对齐两套位姿；(3) 在无配对图像上直接训练多模态3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）模型；(4) 提出评估基准框架，同时衡量各模态图像合成质量与重建场景的跨模态一致性。
AI.result: 在多种场景上的实验表明，该方法在热红外视图合成上取得有竞争力的性能，同时保持了RGB保真度。此外，实验揭示现有重建方法会产生模态特定但缺乏跨模态一致性的重建结果。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的无配对RGB-热红外NVS框架有效消除了对精确多模态校准的依赖，在保持各模态合成质量的同时，通过新的基准框架推动了对跨模态一致性的严格评估。

title: Conformal Risk Sharing: Certified Cost Allocation with Participation Guarantees
summary: Sharing the financial impact of rare adverse events across a group can soften extreme individual burdens, but any participant made worse off by the arrangement has reason to leave. A credible mechanism must therefore provide each agent with a trustworthy cap on their future obligation and should be deployed only if the aggregate harm across participants is bounded. We formalise this as the Certified Allocation Problem: from finite data and without distributional assumptions, find a redistribution rule, produce obligation caps for every participant, and verify that no participant is made materially worse off. We propose Conformal Risk Sharing, which solves this problem by pairing an interpretable sharing policy with split conformal calibration. The sharing intensity is tuned on training data, while held-out calibration data produces distribution-free per-agent guarantees (valid under exchangeability). Experiments on synthetic and real-world data, including precipitation and energy-cooperative data, confirm that the framework can substantially reduce extreme obligations for high-risk agents while controlling harm to others.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“共形风险分担”（Conformal Risk Sharing）框架，通过将可解释的分担策略与分裂共形校准相结合，在无需分布假设的情况下，从有限数据中学习再分配规则，为每位参与者提供义务上限的保证，并验证无人因此变得更差。
AI.motivation: 稀有不良事件的财务冲击在个体层面可能是灾难性的，而通过群体分担可以平滑极端负担。但任何因分担安排而受损的参与者都有动机退出。因此，需要一种可信的机制：（1）为每人提供可信的未来义务上限，（2）仅在总损害有界时才部署。现有方法要么依赖强分布假设，要么缺乏有限样本下的个体保证。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为“认证分配问题”（Certified Allocation Problem）；提出共形风险分担方法，核心是将一个可解释的参数化分担策略（如线性分担规则）在训练数据上调优分担强度，再利用留出的校准数据集进行分裂共形推断（split conformal calibration），为每个参与者生成分布无关的、有限样本有效的义务上限保证（在可交换性条件下成立）。
AI.result: 在合成数据以及降水数据、能源合作社数据等真实世界数据上的实验表明，该框架能大幅降低高风险个体的极端义务，同时有效控制对其他参与者的损害，且所提供的个体化保证是有效的。
AI.conclusion: 共形风险分担提供了一种分布无关的、具有有限样本保证的风险共担方案，成功平衡了高风险个体的保护与低风险个体的参与激励，适用于保险、互助社、能源合作社等多种实际场景。

title: ComplexityMT: Benchmarking the Interaction Between Text Complexity and Machine Translation
summary: When a text is translated, does the translation retain the complexity of the original? We introduce ComplexityMT, a new challenge for assessing how text complexity and machine translation interact with and influence each other, using the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) levels as the measure of text complexity. Across six languages, including Arabic, Dutch, English, French, Hindi, and Russian, we evaluate three open-weight models, one closed model, and a commercial machine translation system on two tasks: i) correlation of CEFR with translation difficulty, and ii) shifts in CEFR levels of the source texts. Our experiments show that higher CEFR levels make texts more difficult to translate, and that machine translation shifts the CEFR level of the target text compared to the original source, for most languages. These findings provide new insights for researchers and practitioners working on multilingual pedagogical content generation and machine translation difficulty estimation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了 ComplexityMT 基准，利用 CEFR 语言等级评估机器翻译中文本复杂度与翻译质量之间的相互作用。在六种语言上的实验表明：CEFR 等级越高翻译难度越大，且机器翻译会改变目标文本的复杂度等级。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于探索翻译是否能够保留原文的复杂度特征。目前缺乏系统性的基准来评估文本复杂度（以 CEFR 为标准）与机器翻译之间的相互影响，这限制了多语言教学内容生成和翻译难度评估等领域的发展。
AI.method: 构建 ComplexityMT 挑战集，涵盖阿拉伯语、荷兰语、英语、法语、印地语和俄语六种语言。评估三个开源权重模型、一个闭源模型和一个商业机器翻译系统，完成两项任务：(1) CEFR 等级与翻译难度的相关性分析；(2) 翻译前后源文本与目标文本之间 CEFR 等级的偏移检测。
AI.result: 实验发现：(1) CEFR 等级越高，翻译难度越大；(2) 对于大多数语言，机器翻译会导致目标文本的 CEFR 复杂度等级相对于源文本发生偏移。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为多语言教学材料自动生成和机器翻译难度预估领域提供了新的洞见，揭示了复杂度与翻译之间的深层关联，并指明了未来在保持翻译中文本复杂度一致性方面的改进方向。

title: Agentic Monte Carlo: Simulating Reinforcement Learning for Black-Box Agents
summary: LLM agents operate in two distinct regimes: open-weight agents amenable to reinforcement learning (RL) and black-box agents whose behaviour must be controlled purely at test time. Although black-box agents are often backed by state-of-the-art proprietary LLMs, API-only access precludes parameter-level optimization, rendering most RL methods inapplicable. To address this limitation, we turn to a known equivalence between RL and Bayesian inference. We propose Agentic Monte Carlo (AMC) to directly sample from the optimal policy of a black-box agent rather than training it through RL. The optimal policy is a posterior over trajectories whose prior we define as the fixed black-box LLM agent. We employ Sequential Monte Carlo to sample from this posterior by learning a value function to steer the agent while leaving the underlying black-box model unchanged. We validate AMC on three diverse environments from the AgentGym benchmark, demonstrating significant improvements over prompting baselines and even outperforming Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) as we scale the test-time compute of our method. AMC demonstrates the feasibility of performing principled RL-style optimization of black-box LLM agents. Code is available at https://github.com/layer6ai-labs/Agentic-Monte-Carlo

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agentic Monte Carlo (AMC)，利用RL与贝叶斯推断之间的等价性，通过序贯蒙特卡洛方法直接从黑盒LLM智能体的最优策略后验分布中采样，无需参数级优化即可实现类RL的策略改进。
AI.motivation: 黑盒LLM智能体（如闭源API模型）无法进行参数级优化，传统RL方法不适用；需要在仅能控制测试时行为的约束下，实现对黑盒智能体的策略优化。
AI.method: 基于RL与贝叶斯推断的等价性，将最优策略定义为以固定黑盒LLM为先验的轨迹后验分布；采用序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）通过学到的价值函数引导采样过程，在不改变底层黑盒模型的前提下从后验中采样，实现测试时优化。
AI.result: 在AgentGym基准的三个环境中验证，AMC显著优于提示工程基线，且随着测试时计算量扩展，性能超过Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)。
AI.conclusion: AMC证明了在无需参数访问的情况下，对黑盒LLM智能体进行有原则的RL式优化是可行的，为黑盒智能体的策略改进提供了新范式。

title: Ten Headache Specialists versus Artificial Intelligence for Clinical Literature Summarization: A Critical Evaluation and Comparison
summary: Summarizing the latest medical literature to guide clinical decision-making is essential for evidence-based medicine and high-quality patient care. Yet clinicians face increasing challenges due to limited time with patients and a rapidly growing volume of published articles. Although retrieval-augmented large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in clinical summarization, human evaluations of their effectiveness in synthesizing broader scientific literature and direct comparisons to expert-written syntheses remain scarce. We constructed a RAG-based agentic AI framework using three state-of-the-art LLMs: Sonnet, GPT-4o, and Llama 3.1. A headache specialist created 13 questions, three for prompt optimization and ten for evaluation. Ten headache specialists across the United States and Canada each wrote a summary for one question, yielding four summaries per question (expert, Sonnet, GPT-4o, and Llama). The experts, blinded to authorship, critically evaluated the summaries, excluding the topic for which they wrote a summary, based on correctness, completeness, conciseness, and clinical utility, scoring each from 1 to 10 using standardized rubrics. They also ranked the summaries by preference and indicated whether they believed each summary was written by an expert or an LLM. Our study, comparing LLM- and expert-written literature summaries evaluated by headache specialists, showed that expert-written summaries were preferred, although experts sometimes found it challenging to distinguish between human- and AI-generated summaries. We also identified key expert-valued features beyond standard evaluation metrics that can guide future refinement of both human and AI literature summarization pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了基于RAG的智能体AI框架，使用三种大语言模型（Sonnet、GPT-4o、Llama 3.1）生成医学文献摘要，并与专家撰写的摘要进行盲法对比评估。结果显示专家摘要更受偏好，但专家有时难以区分人机撰写来源，研究同时识别出超越传统评估指标的专家重视特征。
AI.motivation: 临床医生面临时间有限与医学文献量激增的双重压力，尽管检索增强大语言模型在临床摘要方面展现潜力，但对其综合科学文献效果的人工评估及与专家摘要的直接对比研究仍然稀缺。
AI.method: 构建基于RAG的智能体AI框架，集成三种SOTA大语言模型（Claude Sonnet、GPT-4o、Llama 3.1）。由头痛专家设计13个临床问题（3个用于提示优化，10个用于评估），10位北美头痛专家各为一道问题撰写摘要，每道问题最终获得四份摘要（专家、Sonnet、GPT-4o、Llama各一）。专家在盲法条件下对非自己撰写的摘要从正确性、完整性、简洁性和临床实用性四个维度进行1-10分评分，并对摘要进行偏好排序及人机来源判断。
AI.result: 专家撰写的摘要总体上更受偏好，但专家在区分人类与AI生成的摘要时存在一定困难（辨别准确率有限）。研究还识别出超出传统评估指标之外的、专家所重视的摘要特征。
AI.conclusion: 尽管LLM生成的文献摘要具有竞争力且有时难以与专家摘要区分，但专家摘要仍具优势。识别出的专家重视特征可为未来人机文献摘要流程的优化提供指导方向。

title: Robust Scene Transfer for PointGoal Navigation via Privileged Sensor Guided Contrastive Learning
summary:
We propose a sensor-guided adaptive contrastive learning framework for visual representation learning in PointGoal navigation. During training, privileged LiDAR sensing guides the contrastive objective through a geometry-aware similarity metric and adaptive temperature scaling, encouraging visual embeddings to capture navigation-relevant structure rather than scene-specific appearance. The resulting encoder is pretrained independently, frozen, and used as the perceptual backbone for reinforcement learning, decoupling representation learning from policy optimization. We further introduce a cross-stage domain mismatch between representation pretraining and policy learning to suppress environment-specific shortcuts and promote reliance on task-relevant features.
  Extensive experiments in high-fidelity simulation demonstrate that our approach significantly improves policy-level scene transfer across diverse indoor and outdoor environments. At deployment, the agent relies only on monocular RGB observations together with standard task-related inputs such as goal position and proprioceptive signals, without access to LiDAR or other privileged sensors. Our method outperforms large pretrained vision models and standard contrastive baselines under severe appearance and semantic shifts. We also release a multimodal dataset to support future research on privileged-guided visual representation learning for navigation. The code is available at:

AI.tldr: 提出一种传感器引导的自适应对比学习框架，利用训练时的特权LiDAR信息通过几何感知相似度度量和自适应温度缩放来指导视觉表征学习，冻结编码器后作为RL的感知骨干，并引入跨阶段域不匹配以抑制环境捷径，在室内外场景迁移中显著优于大型预训练模型和标准对比基线。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉导航系统中，视觉表征往往捕捉场景特定外观而非导航相关结构，导致策略在面临外观和语义漂移时泛化能力差。利用训练时特权传感器（LiDAR）提供的几何信息引导视觉编码器学习任务相关表征，可解耦表征学习与策略优化，提升场景迁移能力。
AI.method: 提出传感器引导的自适应对比学习框架：(1) 几何感知相似度度量——利用特权LiDAR信息定义正负样本对，使视觉嵌入聚焦导航相关结构；(2) 自适应温度缩放——动态调整对比损失的浓度参数；(3) 编码器预训练后冻结，作为强化学习策略的固定感知骨干；(4) 跨阶段域不匹配——在表征预训练和策略学习之间引入域差异，抑制环境特定捷径，迫使策略依赖任务相关特征。
AI.result: 在高保真仿真中对多样室内外环境进行广泛实验，方法在策略级场景迁移上显著优于大型预训练视觉模型和标准对比基线，尤其在严重外观和语义漂移下表现突出。部署时仅需单目RGB、目标位置和本体感知信号，无需LiDAR等特权传感器。同时发布了多模态数据集。
AI.conclusion: 传感器引导的自适应对比学习能有效利用训练时的特权信息，使视觉编码器学习导航相关几何结构而非场景外观，结合跨阶段域不匹配策略进一步抑制捷径学习，显著提升PointGoal导航的策略迁移能力，且部署时完全不需要特权传感器。

title: Multilingual Coreference Resolution via Cycle-Consistent Machine Translation
summary: Coreference resolution is a core NLP task, having a broad range of downstream applications, e.g.~machine translation, question answering, document summarization, etc. While the task is well-studied in English, comparatively less attention is dedicated to coreference resolution in other languages, especially low-resource ones. To mitigate this gap, we propose a novel coreference resolution pipeline that harnesses machine translation (MT) from English to a target low-resource language, to generate or expand training data. To automatically validate the quality of the translated samples, we back-translate the samples and assess the similarity with the original English samples via cosine similarity in the latent space of a BERT model. The resulting similarity scores are integrated into the loss function to weight training samples according to their MT cycle consistency. Extensive experiments on four low-resource languages show that our pipeline brings significant performance gains in coreference resolution. Moreover, our pipeline enables accurate coreference resolution in languages where no previous corpora were available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向低资源语言的核心ference解析流水线，通过机器翻译从英语生成训练数据，并利用回译与BERT余弦相似度进行质量验证，将相似度分数加权融入损失函数。在四种低资源语言上的实验表明，该方法显著提升了核心ference解析性能，甚至在无现有语料的语言上也能实现准确解析。
AI.motivation: 核心ference解析在下游NLP任务中应用广泛，但现有研究主要集中于英语，低资源语言受到的关注严重不足，缺乏标注训练数据是主要瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出一种利用机器翻译的数据增强流水线：（1）将英语核心ference标注数据通过MT翻译到目标低资源语言，生成/扩充训练数据；（2）通过回译（将翻译样本再译回英语）并与原始英语样本在BERT潜在空间中进行余弦相似度计算，自动评估翻译质量；（3）将相似度分数作为权重融入损失函数，赋予MT循环一致性更高的训练样本更大权重。
AI.result: 在四种低资源语言上的广泛实验表明，该流水线在核心ference解析任务上取得了显著的性能提升，并且能在之前没有任何语料可用的语言上实现准确的核心ference解析。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于机器翻译的数据增强方法，结合回译一致性加权机制，有效解决了低资源语言核心ference解析的训练数据稀缺问题，展现了良好的跨语言迁移能力。

title: Statistically Reliable LLM-Based Ranking Evaluation via Prediction-Powered Inference
summary: With PRECISE, we extended Prediction-Powered Inference to produce bias-corrected estimates of ranking evaluation metrics by combining a small human-labeled set with a large LLM-judged set. PPI is provably unbiased regardless of the LLM judge's error profile. We make it applicable to hierarchical metrics like Precision@K, where annotations are per-document but the metric is per-query, by reducing the output-space computation from O(2^|C|) to O(2^K). On the ESCI benchmark, augmenting 30 human annotations with Claude 3 Sonnet judgments reduces the standard error of Precision@4 estimates from 4.45 to 3.50 (a 21% relative reduction). In a production system, our framework correctly identified the best of three system variants from 100 human labels and 2 hours of domain-expert annotation; A/B testing confirmed this ranking with +407 bps in daily sales.

AI.tldr: PRECISE 将预测驱动的推断（PPI）扩展到排序评估指标，通过结合少量人工标注和大量LLM判断，生成偏差校正的估计量。该方法在层次化指标（如 Precision@K）上将计算复杂度从 O(2^|C|) 降至 O(2^K)，在 ESCI 基准上使用 Claude 3 Sonnet 将 Precision@4 的标准误降低了 21%，并在真实生产系统中通过仅 100 个人工标签和 2 小时专家标注成功识别出最佳系统变体。
AI.motivation: 排序评估指标（如 Precision@K、nDCG）的人工标注成本高昂，而仅使用 LLM 判断会引入系统性偏差。现有 PPI 框架不直接适用于层次化排序指标（标注在文档级但指标在查询级），需要一种既能利用 LLM 降低成本又能保证统计无偏性的方法。
AI.method: 将 Prediction-Powered Inference 框架扩展到排序评估场景，核心创新在于：1）将查询级指标表述为文档级预测的函数，通过重要性采样实现偏差校正；2）通过将输出空间计算从枚举所有文档组合 O(2^|C|) 降至仅考虑 Top-K 的 O(2^K) 来实现层次化指标的高效计算；3）使用小规模人工标注集与大规模 LLM 判断集联合估计，构建渐近无偏且方差更低的估计量。
AI.result: 在 ESCI 基准上，用 Claude 3 Sonnet 判断增强 30 个人工标注后，Precision@4 的标准误从 4.45 降至 3.50（相对降低 21%）。在真实生产系统中，仅用 100 个人工标签和 2 小时领域专家标注即正确识别出三个系统变体中的最佳者，后续 A/B 测试确认该排序，日销售额提升 407 个基点。
AI.conclusion: PRECISE 成功将 PPI 框架适配到排序评估场景，在保持统计无偏性的同时显著降低了人工标注需求。其计算优化使层次化排序指标的 PPI 估计变得可行，并在学术基准和真实生产环境中均验证了方法的有效性。

title: Brick-Composer: Using MLLMs for Assembly with Diverse Bricks
summary: We dream of AI agents that can read arbitrary designs and construct real-world objects from reusable building blocks. As a first step toward this vision, we study whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) possess the visual grounding and spatial reasoning capabilities required for brick assembly. We formulate brick assembly as a sequential decision-making problem, where each step involves two subtasks: brick selection, identifying the target brick from candidate components, and brick pose estimation, predicting where and how the selected brick should be placed. To support this study, we introduce BC-Bench (Brick Construction Benchmark), the first benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on assembly with diverse bricks. Experiments show that current state-of-the-art MLLMs remain far from reliable builders, struggling with fine-grained brick selection and failing at precise pose estimation. To bridge this gap, we propose Brick-Composer, a learning framework that equips MLLMs with assembly skills through three complementary signals: Human Design Sparks, which provide affordance-rich construction demonstrations; World Feedback, which grounds predicted actions in visual and physical consequences; and Synthetic Experience, which scales learning beyond existing object designs. Brick-Composer improves brick selection accuracy by over three times, substantially reduces pose estimation errors, and raises strict step-level assembly success from less than 1% to around 15%. After training, a Qwen-3-8B can correctly compose up to 42% of the steps for a complete object, suggesting that MLLMs can acquire assembly capabilities through targeted, physically grounded learning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在积木组装任务中的视觉定位与空间推理能力，提出BC-Bench基准和Brick-Composer学习框架，将组装成功率从不足1%提升至约15%，证明MLLMs可通过物理 grounded 学习获得组装能力。
AI.motivation: 探索AI agent能否从任意设计图中读取信息并用可复用积木构建真实物体，核心在于验证MLLMs是否具备积木组装所需的视觉定位和空间推理能力。
AI.method: 将积木组装形式化为序贯决策问题（砖块选择 + 位姿估计）；构建BC-Bench基准数据集；提出Brick-Composer框架，通过三种互补信号训练：Human Design Sparks（人工构造示范）、World Feedback（视觉与物理后果反馈）、Synthetic Experience（合成经验扩展）。
AI.result: 当前SOTA MLLMs在组装任务上表现不佳；Brick-Composer使砖块选择准确率提升超3倍，位姿估计误差大幅降低，严格步骤级组装成功率从不1%提升至约15%；Qwen-3-8B训练后可正确完成42%的完整物体组装步骤。
AI.conclusion: MLLMs当前缺乏可靠的组装能力，但通过针对性、物理grounded的训练可以显著获得组装技能，为实现从设计图到实物构建的AI agent迈出第一步。

title: BRepCLIP: Contrastive Multimodal Pretraining on BRep Primitives for CAD Understanding
summary: Learning representations of CAD models is a largely open problem. While 3D representation learning has flourished around point clouds and meshes, the native format of CAD - boundary representations BReps, which encodes exact parametric surfaces, curves, and their topology, has received little attention as a representation learning substrate. We introduce BRepCLIP, the first framework to align BRep geometry with language and image embeddings through contrastive pretraining. We model each CAD object as a sequence of face and edge tokens with separate discrete vocabularies for surface and curve geometry, augmented with spatial and semantic descriptors that capture surface types (e.g., cylindrical, torus, NURBS) and curve primitives (e.g., line, arc, B-spline). A transformer encoder aggregates these tokens into a global BRep embedding, aligned with CLIP's text and image encoders via a joint contrastive objective.
