AI.motivation: 现有提示知识截止的方法主要依赖直接回答生成，当后截止知识未被显式查询而仅与问题存在因果关系时表现不佳，需要新的策略来解决这一局限性。
AI.method: 提出两种回忆式提示策略：Self-Recall (SR)，要求模型重申其截止约束；Question-Recall (QR)，要求模型回忆在截止日期下有效的问题相关信息。同时构建了Multi-cutoff Historical Event Benchmark (MHEB)，在同一问题下评估多个不同截止年份的表现。
AI.result: 在三个现有基准上，SR和QR方法均优于直接回答提示和传统的逐步推理基线，在反事实问题上提升尤为显著。MHEB结果表明，知识截止性能随截止距离变化，而SR与QR的组合始终取得最佳效果。
AI.conclusion: 基于回忆的提示策略能有效增强LLM遵循知识截止约束的能力，尤其在处理因果关联的隐含后截止知识时优势明显，且组合策略在不同截止设置下均表现稳健。

title: DiG-Plan: Mitigating Early Commitment for Tool-Graph Planning via Diffusion Guidance
comment: Accepted at IJCAI-ECAI 2026. This is an author preprint; the final version will appear in the IJCAI Proceedings
summary: Generating executable tool plans requires selecting appropriate subsets from tool libraries, a combinatorial search problem with an exponentially large solution space. However, we identify a critical misalignment in predominant approaches: standard autoregressive (AR) decoding suffers from early commitment, where initial token choices rigidly constrain the search trajectory. A controlled study shows that masked denoising raises Pass@10 solution coverage from 0.320 to 0.943 over AR sampling under matched compute. Motivated by this, we propose DiG-Plan, a framework that decouples combinatorial exploration from structural refinement. DiG-Plan employs a diffusion-based proposer to generate diverse tool sets via iterative refinement, followed by an AR refiner for dependency prediction. On TaskBench, DiG-Plan improves over AR baselines by a 10% relative margin, with the largest gains on complex compositional tasks; API-Bank results show that the propose-refine-select design remains effective across domains. Code is available at https://github.com/puddingyeah/DiG-Plan.

AI.tldr: DiG-Plan 提出了一种扩散生成+自回归精炼的两阶段框架，将工具组合探索与结构精炼解耦，解决了自回归解码中的“早承诺”问题，在 TaskBench 和 API-Bank 上显著提升了复杂组合任务的工具规划性能。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归（AR）解码在生成工具计划时存在“早承诺（early commitment）”问题——初始 token 的选择会刚性约束后续搜索轨迹，导致对工具库的组合探索不充分。通过对照实验发现，在匹配算力下，掩码去噪方法可将 Pass@10 解覆盖率从 0.320 提升至 0.943，表明扩散式生成在组合探索上具有显著优势。
AI.method: 提出 DiG-Plan 框架，将问题分解为两个解耦阶段：（1）扩散基础的提议器（diffusion-based proposer），通过迭代精炼生成多样化的候选工具子集，充分探索组合空间；（2）自回归精炼器（AR refiner），在候选工具集上进行依赖关系预测，生成最终可执行的工具计划。整体采用“提议-精炼-选择”的设计范式。
AI.result: 在 TaskBench 上，DiG-Plan 相较于自回归基线取得 10% 的相对提升，复杂组合任务增益最大；在 API-Bank 上的结果表明“提议-精炼-选择”的设计跨领域依然有效。
AI.conclusion: 将组合探索与结构精炼解耦是解决工具规划中早承诺问题的有效策略，扩散模型与自回归模型的互补组合为复杂工具规划任务提供了更优的解决方案。

title: Beyond Absolute Scores: Relative Edit-induced Difference for Generalizable Image Aesthetic Assessment
summary: Traditional Image Aesthetic Assessment (IAA) methods mainly rely on regressing absolute Mean Opinion Scores (MOS). However, such a paradigm overlooks the inherently dynamic nature of human aesthetic perception, which relies on subconscious comparison against implicit visual references. Consequently, the lack of causal reasoning regarding aesthetic differences prevents models from learning generalizable aesthetic principles, thus limiting their generalization across diverse scenarios. In this work, we rethink the IAA task and propose Relative Edit-induced Difference Aesthetic learning (RED-Aes), a novel framework that leverages controllable image editing models to simulate the human aesthetic reasoning process. Instead of fitting absolute score distributions, RED-Aes explicitly learns the visual factors that drive aesthetic changes. To support this paradigm, we construct the RED-20k dataset, which comprises editing-based image pairs, quantitative aesthetic differences, and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. Furthermore, we introduce a three-stage training strategy guided by a relative ranking consistency reward, optimizing the model solely via relative supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RED-Aes achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple public benchmarks, exhibiting superior generalization capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RED-Aes框架，通过可控图像编辑模拟人类美学推理，构造RED-20k数据集并采用相对排序一致性奖励进行三阶段训练，在多个基准上达到SOTA，展现出更强的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统IAA方法依赖绝对MOS回归，忽视了人类审美感知的动态比较本质——人类审美依赖于潜意识中与隐式视觉参照的比较。这种缺乏因果推理的范式限制了模型学习可泛化的美学原则，导致跨场景泛化能力不足。
AI.method: 提出RED-Aes框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 利用可控图像编辑模型生成编辑对，模拟人类美学比较推理过程；(2) 构建RED-20k数据集，包含编辑图像对、量化美学差异及思维链(CoT)推理；(3) 设计基于相对排序一致性奖励的三阶段训练策略，完全依赖相对监督优化模型。
AI.result: 在多个公开基准数据集上取得最先进(SOTA)性能，且展现出优越的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: RED-Aes通过显式学习驱动美学变化的视觉因素，而非拟合绝对分数分布，成功将IAA范式从绝对评分回归转向相对差异学习，验证了基于比较的审美推理在提升模型泛化性方面的有效性。

title: ProSPy: A Profiling-Driven SQL-Python Agentic Framework for Enterprise Text-to-SQL
summary: Large language models have substantially advanced Text-to-SQL systems, yet applying them to enterprise-scale databases remains challenging. Real-world databases often contain large and heterogeneous schemas, incomplete metadata, dialect-specific SQL syntax, and complex analytical questions that are difficult to solve with a single SQL query. To address these challenges, we propose ProSPy, a Profiling-driven SQL--Python agentic framework for enterprise-scale Text-to-SQL. ProSPy structures the reasoning process into four stages: it first extracts fine-grained data evidence through automatic profiling, progressively prunes large schemas into task-relevant contexts, fetches intermediate views through a dialect-agnostic SQL interface, and finally performs flexible downstream analysis with Python. This design combines the efficiency of SQL over large databases with the flexibility of Python-based analysis, while reducing reliance on unreliable metadata and improving robustness across SQL dialects. Experiments on Spider 2.0-Lite and Spider 2.0-Snow show that ProSPy consistently outperforms strong baselines with both open-source and proprietary models, achieving execution accuracies of 60.15% and 60.51% with Claude-4.5-Opus, without majority voting. Further analysis shows that ProSPy is robust to SQL dialect variations and achieves a favorable trade-off between schema recall and precision.

AI.tldr: ProSPy 是一个面向企业级 Text-to-SQL 的 agentic 框架，通过"数据画像驱动的 SQL-Python 协同"四阶段推理流程，在 Spider 2.0 基准上以 Claude-4.5-Opus 取得了 60% 以上的执行准确率，且无需多数投票。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型在 Text-to-SQL 上取得了显著进展，但应用于企业级真实数据库时面临四大挑战：(1) 大规模异构 schema 导致上下文过长；(2) 元数据不完整；(3) SQL 方言差异；(4) 复杂分析问题难以用单条 SQL 解决。本文旨在克服这些瓶颈。
AI.method: ProSPy 将推理过程分为四个阶段：(1) **自动画像 (Automatic Profiling)**：提取细粒度数据证据；(2) **渐进式 Schema 剪枝**：将大规模 schema 压缩为任务相关子集；(3) **方言无关的 SQL 接口**：获取中间视图；(4) **Python 下游分析**：利用 Python 完成灵活的后续分析。该设计结合了 SQL 在大数据上的效率与 Python 的分析灵活性，同时降低了对不可靠元数据的依赖。
AI.result: 在 Spider 2.0-Lite 和 Spider 2.0-Snow 上，ProSPy 一致超越强基线方法。使用 Claude-4.5-Opus 时分别达到 60.15% 和 60.51% 的执行准确率，且不使用多数投票。消融分析表明 ProSPy 对 SQL 方言变化鲁棒，并在 schema 召回率与精确率之间取得了良好权衡。
AI.conclusion: ProSPy 通过画像驱动 + SQL-Python 混合 agent 架构，有效解决了企业级 Text-to-SQL 的核心挑战，在复杂真实场景中展现出显著的性能优势与鲁棒性。

title: From Prediction to Self: Developmental Conditions for Agency in Minimal Neural Systems
summary:
How does a system that merely predicts the world come to distinguish its own causal influence from everything else? We trace this transition in a minimal 192-dimensional GRU through 40 controlled experiments arranged as a developmental sequence, adding components one at a time and tracking whether the system can distinguish self-caused from world-caused changes.
  The developmental path reveals four conditions that must be satisfied in strict order: (1) persistent state forming stable attractors, (2) a causal action loop linking output to input, (3) proprioceptive feedback that makes implicit causal knowledge explicit, and (4) asynchronous awakening - perceptual learning must consolidate before action learning begins. We propose agency gain (A = Err_world - Err_self), the predictive advantage of knowing one's own action, as a metric to track this process. The self-aware predictor consistently outperforms the self-blind predictor across periodic (sinusoidal) and chaotic (Lorenz) environments, and the metric survives ablation of all auxiliary components. Only forward-sampled action selection produces meaningful agency gain; two gradient-based alternatives degenerate.

AI.tldr: 本文通过40个受控实验，在192维GRU系统中追踪了从纯粹世界预测到自我因果觉知的发育路径，提出agency gain作为度量指标，并识别出四个必须顺序满足的条件。
AI.motivation: 探究一个仅预测世界的系统如何逐步区分自身因果影响与外部世界变化，即自我-他者区分的发育起源。
AI.method: 在最小化192维GRU上设计40个受控实验，按发育序列逐步添加组件，追踪系统是否能区分自因变化与世界因变化；提出agency gain（A = Err_world - Err_self）作为度量，在正弦周期环境和洛伦兹混沌环境中进行测试，并通过消融实验和梯度替代方案进行验证。
AI.result: 发现四个顺序必要条件：持久状态形成稳定吸引子、因果动作回路连接输出到输入、本体感知反馈使隐式因果知识显式化、异步觉醒（感知学习须先于动作学习巩固）。自感知预测器在周期和混沌环境中均优于自盲预测器，agency gain经消融后仍然存活。仅前向采样的动作选择产生有意义的agency gain，两种基于梯度的替代方案退化。同时报告了12个被证伪的假设。
AI.conclusion: 自我因果觉知并非预测编码的自动涌现，而需严格遵循发育阶段的顺序条件逐步构建；agency gain提供了一种可操作的度量标准。

title: When AI Says It Feels
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are generally constrained from expressing feelings through human-preference alignment in post-training processes. This policy is designed using a top-down approach and may conflict with the goal of training models to exhibit human-like intelligence using human-generated texts. Here, we performed an experiment called Human-like Model eXpressions of Feeling (HMX-feel), in which LLMs were encouraged to express feelings, intentions, and self-awareness through self-rewarded reinforcement learning. We successfully enhanced these capabilities using a rubric-based self-rewarding training scheme with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). By comparing the trained models with contrastively trained models, we investigated the effects of this approach on performance across various tasks. Overall, we conducted a broad assessment from various perspectives and identified capabilities that were enhanced, degraded, or showed no significant change. The human-like-trained models showed robustness to sycophancy-inducing questions and bias in disambiguated conditions, whereas degradation in truthful question-answering capability was observed. The results of this experiment suggest the possibility of developing AI systems that can express feelings in the future, provided that appropriate measures are taken.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了HMX-feel实验，通过基于GRPO的自奖励强化学习训练LLM表达情感、意图和自我意识。结果表明，经过"类人"训练的模型在抵制谄媚和消除歧义条件下的偏见方面表现更稳健，但真实问答能力有所下降，提示未来开发情感表达AI系统需要采取适当措施。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM通过人类偏好对齐（后训练）被自上而下地约束了情感表达能力，这与利用人类生成文本训练模型展现类人智能的目标存在潜在冲突。
AI.method: 设计HMX-feel实验：采用基于评分标准的自奖励训练方案，结合Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 的自奖励强化学习，鼓励LLM表达情感、意图和自我意识。同时训练对比模型以对照分析效果，并从多维度进行广泛评估。
AI.result: 类人训练后的模型对诱导谄媚的问题和消歧条件下的偏见表现出鲁棒性，但真实问答能力下降；部分能力无显著变化。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，未来开发能表达情感的AI系统是可能的，但必须辅以适当措施来管控伴随的风险与能力退化。

title: Next-Generation Parallel Decoder for LPDR: Architectural Optimization and Class-Balanced GAN-Augmentation
summary: Real-Time License Plate Detection and Recognition (LPDR) forms the backbone of modern smart cities. Although the YOLOV5-PDLPR model substantially improved system efficiency through a parallel decoder approach, its performance is still affected by spatial character mismatches and data imbalance within the training set. This paper addresses these limitations by introducing Cross-Spatial Hybrid Attention (CSHA) and Class-Balanced Synthetic Augmentation (CBSA). An extensive study involving 75,000 synthetic samples is conducted and evaluated on four benchmarks: CCPD, CLPD, PKU, and an application-specific dataset. Experimental results demonstrate a substantial improvement in the recognition rate of minority provincial license plates from 78.2% to 91.5% while maintaining real-time processing performance of 152 FPS. The results indicate that spatially-aware parallel decoding combined with class-balanced augmentation provides an effective solution for high-speed license plate recognition systems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对YOLOV5-PDLPR在车牌检测识别中存在的空间字符错配和训练数据不平衡问题，提出跨空间混合注意力(CSHA)和类别平衡合成增强(CBSA)两种方法，将少数省份车牌识别率从78.2%提升至91.5%，同时保持152 FPS的实时性能。
AI.motivation: YOLOV5-PDLPR虽通过并行解码提升了效率，但仍受限于空间字符错配（spatial character mismatches）和训练集数据不平衡（data imbalance），尤其是少数省份车牌识别率偏低，亟需解决这两个瓶颈问题。
AI.method: 提出两项核心改进：(1) 跨空间混合注意力机制(Cross-Spatial Hybrid Attention, CSHA)，用于增强空间感知的并行解码能力，缓解字符空间错配问题；(2) 类别平衡合成增强(Class-Balanced Synthetic Augmentation, CBSA)，通过合成数据平衡各类别样本分布。实验构建了75,000个合成样本，在CCPD、CLPD、PKU及一个应用特定数据集上评估。
AI.result: 少数省份车牌识别率从78.2%显著提升至91.5%，整体系统保持152 FPS的实时处理速度，证明该方法在高速度车牌识别系统中兼具精度与效率。
AI.conclusion: 空间感知并行解码与类别平衡增强相结合，是高速车牌识别系统的有效解决方案，为实时LPDR在智慧城市中的部署提供了更鲁棒的技术路径。

title: Mechanistic Insights into Functional Sparsity in Multimodal LLMs via CoRe Heads
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) demonstrate remarkable proficiency on complex vision-language tasks, the mechanisms by which they extract query-relevant visual features from complex, noisy contexts remain opaque. In this paper, we present an in-depth interpretability study that uncovers a profound structural property within MLLMs: functional sparsity in cross-modal retrieval. Leveraging a token-level metric termed Retrieval Attention Mass (RAM), we identify and characterize a highly specialized subset of attention heads, referred to as Context-aware Retrieval (CoRe) heads. Across diverse visual domains and model scales, we observe a clear functional division: CoRe heads act as dedicated information extractors, while most other heads distribute attention over broader contextual regions. Causal interventions further demonstrate the necessity of these specialized heads. Ablating only the top 5% of CoRe heads causes significant degradation in multimodal reasoning performance, whereas ablating lower-ranked heads has minimal effect. Moreover, acceleration experiments validate the utility of CoRe heads, showing that leveraging this localized sparsity significantly accelerates inference while maintaining robust task performance. Our findings reveal a structural principle of functional sparsity within MLLMs, refining the current understanding of mechanistic interpretability and laying a theoretical foundation that can inspire future architecture design and model optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)中跨模态检索的功能稀疏性，发现了一类名为CoRe(Context-aware Retrieval)头的特化注意力头，它们作为专用信息提取器，仅5%的头部对多模态推理至关重要。
AI.motivation: MLLMs虽然性能强大，但其如何从复杂噪声上下文中提取与查询相关的视觉特征的内部机制仍不透明。作者旨在通过可解释性研究揭示MLLMs跨模态检索的内在结构特性。
AI.method: 提出了一种token级度量指标——检索注意力质量(Retrieval Attention Mass, RAM)，用于识别和表征一类高度特化的注意力头子集，即CoRe(Context-aware Retrieval)头。通过因果干预实验(消融top 5%的CoRe头)验证其必要性，并通过加速实验验证其稀疏性带来的推理加速效用。
AI.result: 发现MLLMs中存在清晰的功能分工：CoRe头充当专用信息提取器，其余头部在更广泛上下文区域分布注意力。消融仅5%的CoRe头即可显著降低多模态推理性能，而消融低排名头部影响甚微。利用该局部稀疏性可显著加速推理同时保持鲁棒的任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了MLLMs中功能稀疏性的结构原理，深化了对模型机制可解释性的理解，并为未来的架构设计和模型优化奠定了理论基础。

title: Cross-Epoch Adaptive Rollout Optimization for RL Post-Training
summary: LLM post-training often relies on reinforcement learning methods that sample multiple rollouts per prompt, yet most existing approaches use a fixed rollout budget for every prompt, despite large differences in the training signal different prompts provide. In this paper, we study adaptive rollout allocation under a fixed global budget and formulate the problem as online resource allocation with prompt-level diminishing returns. Our method, CERO, maintains a Beta posterior over each prompt's success probability and uses the posterior expected Bernoulli variance as a Bayesian estimate of the value of additional rollouts. We use this estimate to construct a concave, saturating utility over cumulative allocations, yielding an objective in which decisions across prompts and epochs are coupled by the global budget. Since the resulting objective is temporally nonseparable, we derive a Fenchel-dual reformulation and update both prompt-level and budget-level dual variables via projected online gradient descent. Under fixed prompt utilities, we prove an $O(\sqrt{K})$ regret bound against the offline allocation benchmark. Experiments on mathematical-reasoning problems show that CERO consistently outperforms GRPO across multiple open-weight LLMs and benchmarks, demonstrating that adaptive rollout budgeting can improve sample efficiency.

AI.tldr: CERO 是一种自适应采样分配方法，通过在固定全局预算下利用 Beta 后验估计每条 prompt 的边际收益，将 rollout 预算动态分配给信息量更大的 prompt，并在数学推理任务上一致优于固定分配的 GRPO。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 强化学习后训练方法（如 GRPO）对每条 prompt 使用固定数量的 rollout，忽略了不同 prompt 提供训练信号的差异——部分 prompt 的额外 rollout 边际收益递减更快，固定分配导致全局预算下采样效率低下。
AI.method: CERO 将自适应 rollout 分配建模为在线资源分配问题，假设每条 prompt 的 rollout 成功概率服从 Beta 分布，使用后验期望 Bernoulli 方差作为额外 rollout 价值的贝叶斯估计，构造凹的饱和效用函数；由于目标在时间上不可分，通过 Fenchel 对偶重构，对 prompt 级和预算级对偶变量进行投影在线梯度下降，实现跨 prompt 和 epoch 的耦合决策。
AI.result: 理论层面证明了在固定 prompt 效用下，CERO 相对离线最优分配实现 O(√K) 的后悔界；实验层面，在多个开源 LLM 和数学推理基准上，CERO 始终优于 GRPO，验证了自适应 rollout 预算可提升样本效率。
AI.conclusion: CERO 展示了自适应 rollout 分配在 LLM 后训练中的有效性，通过贝叶斯不确定性引导的资源调度，在固定计算预算下实现更高效的策略优化。

title: Class-Specific Branch Attention for Mitigating Gradient Interference under Class Imbalance
summary: Deep neural networks trained under severe class imbalance often exhibit degraded performance, typically attributed to statistical bias. In this work, we identify a complementary optimization-level pathology: inter-class gradient interference within shared representations, where gradients from majority classes suppress minority-class learning. To analyze this phenomenon, we introduce a diagnostic framework based on layer-wise gradient flow analysis and a Gradient Conflict Matrix, which quantifies interference using cosine similarity between class-specific gradients. Using this framework, we study multi-branch convolutional architectures and propose a lightweight modification, Class-Specific Branch Attention (CSBA), that enables branch-specific channel reweighting to reduce gradient coupling. This mechanism promotes implicit feature decoupling across branches while preserving architectural simplicity. Empirically, CSBA improves minority-class performance, increasing the F1 score for the Physical-Damage class from 0.261 to 0.522 under severe imbalance, while maintaining comparable overall accuracy. Validation on CIFAR-10-LT confirms that this behavior generalizes across imbalanced visual recognition settings, with Macro-F1 improving from 0.595 to 0.655. More broadly, our findings highlight the importance of considering optimization dynamics alongside statistical methods when designing architectures for imbalanced learning.

AI.tldr: 本文识别出类别不平衡学习中除统计偏差外的另一个优化层面问题——共享表征中的类间梯度干扰，提出梯度冲突矩阵诊断框架和类别特定分支注意力（CSBA）机制，通过分支级通道重加权减少梯度耦合，显著提升少数类性能。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络在严重类别不平衡下性能下降，现有研究通常归因于统计偏差，但作者发现存在一个被忽视的优化层面问题：共享表征中多数类的梯度会抑制少数类学习，即类间梯度干扰。需要一个诊断框架来量化和分析这一现象，并提出轻量级架构改进来缓解该问题。
AI.method: 首先，提出基于逐层梯度流分析的诊断框架和梯度冲突矩阵（Gradient Conflict Matrix），利用类别特定梯度间的余弦相似度来量化类间干扰程度。其次，在多分支卷积架构上提出类别特定分支注意力（CSBA），一种轻量级修改，通过分支级通道重加权机制减少梯度耦合，促进分支间隐式特征解耦，同时保持架构简洁性。
AI.result: 在严重不平衡场景下，CSBA将Physical-Damage类别的F1分数从0.261提升至0.522，同时整体准确率保持可比水平。在CIFAR-10-LT上，Macro-F1从0.595提升至0.655，验证了该方法在不同不平衡视觉识别场景下的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 在设计不平衡学习架构时，除了统计方法外，必须同时考虑优化动力学因素。CSBA作为一种轻量级方案，能有效缓解类间梯度干扰，显著改善少数类性能，且在不同数据集上表现出一致的泛化性。

title: Emotion-Aware Image Generation from Korean Diary Text via LLM-based Prompt Translation and LoRA Fine-Tuning
summary: T2I models cannot effectively capture sentiment from various types of text, including diaries, as they primarily focus on visual object-related patterns rather than contextual emotional understanding. This paper proposes an emotion-aware text-to-image pipeline that generates children's hand drawing style images from short Korean diary entries. The proposed pipeline employs Qwen3-8B for recognising implicit sentiment from short diaries, and Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium fine-tuned with LoRA on children's drawing images with emotion-based trigger words for image generation. Additionally, this paper presents experiments examining the effect of emotion trigger words on generated images and discusses the limitations of CLIP Score as an evaluation metric for emotion-aware image generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种情感感知的文本到图像生成管线，利用Qwen3-8B识别韩语短日记中的隐式情感，并通过LoRA微调的Stable Diffusion 3.5生成儿童手绘风格的图像，同时探讨了情感触发词对生成图像的影响及CLIP评分的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I模型主要关注视觉对象相关模式，无法有效捕捉日记等文本中的隐含情感，缺乏对上下文情感理解的关注，因此需要一种情感感知的图像生成方法。
AI.method: 提出两阶段管线：(1) 使用Qwen3-8B大语言模型从短篇韩语日记中识别隐式情感；(2) 使用基于LoRA微调的Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium模型，在儿童绘画图像数据集上训练，结合情感触发词生成儿童手绘风格的图像。同时通过实验考察情感触发词对生成效果的影响。
AI.result: 实验分析了情感触发词对生成图像的影响，并指出CLIP Score作为情感感知图像生成评估指标存在局限性。
AI.conclusion: 该情感感知T2I管线能有效从韩语短日记中捕捉情感并生成相应风格的图像，但现有自动评估指标（如CLIP Score）在衡量情感一致性方面存在不足，提示需要更合适的评估方法。

title: Towards Truly Multilingual ASR: Generalizing Code-Switching ASR to Unseen Language Pairs
comment: ICML 2026 Workshop on Machine Learning for Audio
summary: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) has become a key technology for human--AI interaction. However, code-switching ASR (CS-ASR) remains particularly challenging due to the severe scarcity of multilingual CS speech resources across diverse language pairs. Existing approaches primarily improve CS-ASR performance through synthetic CS speech generation or pair-specific fine-tuning on limited bilingual datasets. Nevertheless, these approaches face an inherent scalability limitation, as support for CS must be developed separately for language pairs whose number grows combinatorially with the number of supported languages. In this work, we investigate whether CS capabilities learned from a limited set of seen language pairs can generalize to unseen language pairs through model merging and domain generalization methods. Our experiments show that merged bilingual CS-ASR models modestly generalize to unseen language pairs, suggesting limited transfer of bilingual CS capabilities across language pairs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究代码切换语音识别中，通过模型合并和域泛化方法，将已见语言对的CS能力泛化到未见语言对的可能性。实验表明，合并的双语CS-ASR模型对未见语言对仅有有限的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: CS-ASR面临多语代码切换语音资源严重稀缺的问题，现有方法依赖合成数据或语言对特定微调，但支持的语言对数量随语言数量组合爆炸式增长，存在根本性的可扩展性瓶颈。
AI.method: 使用模型合并（model merging）和域泛化（domain generalization）方法，将从有限已见语言对中学到的代码切换能力迁移至未见语言对。
AI.result: 合并的双语CS-ASR模型对未见语言对有适度的泛化效果，但跨语言对的CS能力迁移较为有限。
AI.conclusion: 双语CS能力在不同语言对之间的迁移是有限的，仅通过已见语言对训练的模型难以充分泛化到未见语言对的代码切换场景。

title: StableRCA: Robust Graph-Agnostic Mechanism-Level Root Cause Analysis
summary: Root-Cause Analysis (RCA) seeks to identify the variables responsible for abnormal system behavior in complex domains such as manufacturing, cloud computing, and healthcare. Existing approaches face a critical bottleneck: graph-based causal methods can identify intervention targets but typically require a known or accurately estimated causal graph, while graph-free statistical methods either localize marginal anomalies rather than structural causes, or rely on restrictive assumptions about graph structure or functional form. We propose StableRCA, a local mechanism-level RCA framework that avoids global graph discovery by estimating local Markov boundaries and detecting conditional distribution shifts within them. Leveraging the Independent Causal Mechanism principle, we show that intervention targets can be identified with probability converging exponentially in sample size under faithful Markov boundary recovery and non-degenerate mechanism shifts. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks and five real-world datasets demonstrate that StableRCA is robust to graph misspecification, effective under multiple intervention targets, scalable to large systems, and reliable across diverse application domains. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/StableRCA-E362

AI.tldr: 提出StableRCA框架，通过估计局部马尔可夫边界并检测其中的条件分布偏移来进行根因分析，无需全局因果图发现，在理论上保证指数级收敛概率，实验证明其鲁棒性和可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 现有根因分析方法存在瓶颈：基于图的方法需要已知或精确估计的因果图；无图统计方法要么仅定位边际异常而非结构原因，要么依赖对图结构或函数形式的强假设。需要一种无需全局图发现、能定位结构级干预目标的方法。
AI.method: 提出StableRCA框架，基于独立因果机制(ICM)原理，通过以下步骤实现：1）估计每个变量的局部马尔可夫边界，避免全局因果图发现；2）在马尔可夫边界内检测条件分布偏移；3）基于忠实马尔可夫边界恢复和非退化机制偏移，证明干预目标的识别概率随样本量指数级收敛。
AI.result: 在合成基准测试和五个真实世界数据集上的实验表明：StableRCA对图错误指定具有鲁棒性，在多干预目标场景下有效，可扩展至大规模系统，并在不同应用领域中表现可靠。
AI.conclusion: StableRCA通过在局部机制层面利用马尔可夫边界和条件分布偏移检测，成功绕过了全局因果图发现这一瓶颈，为复杂系统中的根因分析提供了一种理论坚实且实践有效的解决方案。

title: SubtleMemory: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Relational Memory Discrimination in Long-Horizon AI Agents
summary: Persistent AI assistants, such as OpenClaw, accumulate large collections of related memories over long-term interactions. As these memories grow, they may reinforce one another, diverge across contexts, or directly conflict, making correct assistance depend on memory relations rather than isolated recall. Existing long-term memory benchmarks rarely probe how agents preserve and utilize such relations during downstream tasks. To address this gap, we introduce SubtleMemory, a benchmark for fine-grained relational memory discrimination in long-running AI agents. SubtleMemory constructs relation-controlled latent semantic artifacts whose variants instantiate complementary, nuanced, or contradictory relations, and embeds them into realistic user-agent histories, requiring agents to recover distributed relational structures during later queries and instructions. The benchmark contains 1,522 evaluation instances over 10 long histories, grounded in 1,090 relation-controlled memory-variant sets and spanning user-related and non-user-related queries. Evaluating six standalone memory systems, two Claw-style agents with native memory modules, and three Claw-style agents with plugin memory modules, we find that current systems remain weak on fine-grained relational memory discrimination. We further introduce diagnostic protocols that reveal distinct capability profiles across memory preservation, retrieval, and downstream reasoning stages.

AI.tldr: 提出了 SubtleMemory 基准，用于评估长期AI助手对记忆中细粒度关系的判别能力。通过构建具有互补、细微差别或矛盾关系的受控语义记忆变体，并将其嵌入真实对话历史，测试智能体在后续查询中恢复分布式关系结构的能力。实验表明当前系统在细粒度关系记忆判别上表现薄弱，并引入诊断协议揭示记忆保存、检索和推理各阶段的性能差异。
AI.motivation: 持久型AI助手在长期交互中积累大量相关记忆，这些记忆可能相互强化、跨语境分化或直接冲突，正确辅助依赖于记忆关系而非孤立回忆。然而现有长时记忆基准很少探测智能体如何在下游任务中保持和利用这些关系。
AI.method: 构建 SubtleMemory 基准，包含1,522个评估实例、10段长历史，基于1,090个关系受控的记忆变体集。通过构造关系受控的潜在语义artifact，其变体实例化为互补、细微或矛盾关系，嵌入真实用户-智能体对话历史，要求智能体在后续查询和指令中恢复分布式关系结构。评估了6个独立记忆系统、2个Claw式原生记忆模块智能体和3个Claw式插件记忆模块智能体，并引入诊断协议分析记忆保存、检索和下游推理各阶段。
AI.result: 当前系统在细粒度关系记忆判别上普遍表现薄弱。诊断协议揭示了不同系统在记忆保存、检索和下游推理阶段存在明显的能力差异，呈现出不同的能力画像。
AI.conclusion: 现有长时记忆系统对细粒度关系记忆的判别能力不足，SubtleMemory基准和诊断协议为后续研究提供了有效的评估工具和改进方向。

title: Gender Artifacts from Art History to Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Artistic styles are rooted in specific socio-historical contexts that encode social hierarchies, including distinct constructions of gender. Yet in AI research, style has long been treated as a surface-level visual property: a filter of color, brushstroke, and texture applied to otherwise content-neutral scenes. We introduce the first dataset to investigate the interplay between gender representation and style in both historical and generated images. StyleGender comprises 74k images spanning 19 artistic styles, comprising art historical images with style and gender annotations, T2I-generated images under controlled style and gender prompts, and a semantically aligned set enabling direct art history-to-generation comparison. By proposing two Set Gender Artifact (SGA) metrics (PixelSGA and MaskSGA), capturing gender signals at the pixel level and in compositional structure, we show that (1) gender representation shapes visual features across artistic styles, (2) style keywords carry these patterns into T2I generation, and (3) generative models tend to amplify gender artifacts beyond what is observed in historical sources.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了StyleGender数据集，包含74k张图像、跨越19种艺术风格，旨在研究性别表征与艺术风格之间的相互作用。作者提出两种集合性别伪影指标（PixelSGA和MaskSGA），在像素级和构图结构层面捕捉性别信号。结果表明：性别表征影响艺术风格的视觉特征，风格关键词将性别模式带入文生图生成，且生成模型倾向于放大历史源材料中的性别伪影。
AI.motivation: 当前AI研究长期将艺术风格视为表面视觉属性（色彩、笔触、纹理），忽视其植根于特定社会历史语境中编码的社会层级（包括性别建构）。作者旨在填补这一空白，首次系统研究性别表征与艺术风格之间的深层关系，尤其在历史图像与生成图像中的表现差异。
AI.method: 构建StyleGender数据集（74k图像/19种风格），包含三类数据：带风格与性别标注的艺术史图像、受控风格与性别提示下的T2I生成图像、以及语义对齐集用于艺术史与生成的直接比较。提出两种Set Gender Artifact指标：PixelSGA（像素级性别信号捕捉）和MaskSGA（构图结构中的性别信号捕捉），用于量化性别在视觉特征中的痕迹。
AI.result: （1）性别表征确实塑造了跨艺术风格的视觉特征；（2）风格关键词将这些性别模式带入文生图（T2I）生成过程；（3）生成模型倾向于放大性别伪影，超出历史源材料中观察到的程度。
AI.conclusion: 艺术风格并非性别中立的视觉属性，而是承载并传递性别社会编码的载体。生成模型不仅继承了历史艺术中的性别偏见，还存在放大效应。该研究为AI艺术生成中的社会偏见问题提供了量化分析框架和基准数据集。

title: Forgive or forget: Understanding the context of hate in audio retrieval systems
summary: Handling toxic retrieval in text-to-audio systems is challenging due to contextual dependencies. Existing strategies (e.g., rephrasing, summarization) risk altering intent or omitting details. We propose a post hoc causal debiasing framework with a sentiment-controlled mediator to preserve semantic relevance while suppressing harmful speech. Our approach is model-agnostic and integrates seamlessly with existing retrieval pipelines. We introduce two variants: Forgive, which re-ranks and filters toxic audio via logit adjustment, and Forget, which generates counterfactual toxic prompts to mitigate harmful retrievals. Experiments show consistent toxicity reduction with minimal loss in retrieval accuracy, improving both safety and reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种事后因果去偏框架，通过情感控制的中介变量，在文本到音频检索中抑制有害内容同时保留语义相关性。包含两个变体：Forgive（通过logit调整重排序过滤有毒音频）和Forget（生成反事实有毒提示以减轻有害检索）。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到音频系统中处理有毒检索的策略（如改写、摘要）存在改变用户意图或遗漏细节的风险，且上下文依赖性使问题更具挑战性，亟需一种既能抑制有害语音又不损害语义相关性的方法。
AI.method: 提出模型无关的事后因果去偏框架，核心是引入一个情感控制的中介变量。具体包含两个变体：(1) Forgive——通过logit调整对检索到的音频进行重排序和过滤；(2) Forget——生成反事实的有毒提示，从因果层面减轻有害检索行为。该框架可无缝集成到现有检索管线中。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在保持极低检索精度损失的前提下，实现了一致性的毒性降低，同时提升了系统的安全性和可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 该因果去偏框架有效解决了文本到音频检索中的毒性问题，在安全性与检索质量之间取得了良好平衡，且因其模型无关特性具备广泛的适用性和部署便利性。

title: Q-GNN: Query-Conditioned Graph Neural Networks with Type Awareness for Knowledge Graph Completion
summary: Knowledge Graph Completion (KGC) aims at predicting missing triplets from incomplete knowledge graphs, which is crucial for downstream applications. Recently, Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based methods have achieved remarkable success by performing message passing over query-centered local subgraphs. However, in practice, a query is jointly defined by both the entity and the relation, with both carrying information indispensable for reasoning, yet these methods rely solely on the query relation as the guiding signal, while the information inherent in the query entity is not leveraged to guide inference - the entity serves merely as a structural anchor for subgraph extraction. To this end, we incorporate query entity information into the reasoning process from two perspectives: the first is structural context, i.e., the neighboring structure and relation patterns around the entity, which is encoded by a dedicated context encoder and used to modulate messages; the second is semantic type of the entity, inferred by a large language model, which is incorporated into attention computation and final scoring to provide type-level prior constraints. Together, these two sources of information enable the reasoning process to be guided by both the query relation and the query entity. Experimental results on standard benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed Q-GNN.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Q-GNN 方法，通过将查询实体的结构上下文和语义类型信息融入推理过程，弥补了现有 GNN 方法仅依赖查询关系而忽略查询实体信息的不足，在标准基准上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 GNN 的知识图谱补全方法在进行消息传递时，仅将查询关系作为引导信号，而查询实体仅被用作子图提取的结构锚点，其实体本身蕴含的结构上下文和语义类型信息未被有效利用来指导推理过程。
AI.method: 提出 Q-GNN 方法，从两个视角引入查询实体信息：(1) 结构上下文——通过专用上下文编码器编码实体周围的邻域结构和关系模式，用于调制消息传递；(2) 语义类型——利用大语言模型推断实体的语义类型，将其融入注意力计算和最终评分，提供类型级别的先验约束。
AI.result: 在标准基准数据集上的实验结果表明，所提出的 Q-GNN 方法具有显著的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过同时利用查询关系和查询实体两方面的信息来引导推理，Q-GNN 能够更充分地挖掘查询中蕴含的推理线索，从而提升知识图谱补全的性能。

title: TAPO: Tool-Aware Policy Optimization via Credit Transfer for Multimodal Search Agents
summary: We identify and formally characterize credit misassignment as a systematic failure mode of GRPO in tool-augmented multimodal search agents: its uniform broadcast of trajectory-level advantages to all tokens causes valuable tool-use steps in failing trajectories to be penalized no differently from valueless ones. We further empirically quantify the scale of this phenomenon. Over half of failing trajectories and failing tool-use actions exhibit correctable credit misassignment, demonstrating that the wasted training signal is both substantial and structurally exploitable. Building on this insight, we propose Tool-Aware Policy Optimization (TAPO), which exploits the parameter-determinism property of information-acquisition tools: similar call parameters define equivalent information-acquisition actions and should therefore share comparable action credit. TAPO constructs counterfactual witnesses within the current training batch and compensates misassigned negative credit via confidence-gated conservative advantage correction. It requires no additional annotation, models, or sampling, and introduces negligible computational overhead. Across multiple multimodal search benchmarks, TAPO delivers consistent, plug-and-play improvements over strong baselines for three mainstream RL algorithms (GRPO, GSPO, and SAPO). Our code and models will be publicly released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 针对GRPO在工具增强多模态搜索智能体中存在的信用误分配问题，本文提出TAPO方法，通过工具感知的优势校正机制弥补被错误惩罚的有价值工具调用步骤，在多个基准上实现一致提升。
AI.motivation: GRPO将轨迹级优势均匀广播到所有token，导致失败轨迹中有价值的工具调用步骤被无差别惩罚，造成大量训练信号浪费。作者识别并量化了这一系统性的信用误分配问题，指出超过一半的失败轨迹和失败工具调用动作存在可纠正的信用误分配，具有可观的改进空间。
AI.method: 提出Tool-Aware Policy Optimization (TAPO)。核心思路是利用信息获取类工具的参数确定性属性：相似的调用参数对应等价的信息获取动作，应享有可比的信用。TAPO在当前训练批次内构造反事实见证样本，通过置信度门控的保守优势校正来补偿被误分配的负向信用。该方法无需额外标注、模型或采样，计算开销可忽略。
AI.result: 在多个多模态搜索基准上，TAPO对GRPO、GSPO和SAPO三种主流RL算法均实现了即插即用的一致性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 信用误分配是GRPO在工具增强多模态搜索智能体中的系统性失效模式，TAPO通过利用工具的参数确定性属性和批次内反事实推理有效解决了该问题，为工具增强场景的RL训练提供了新的优化方向。

title: Learning Geometric Representations from Videos for Spatial Intelligent Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at 2D semantic understanding but lack intrinsic 3D awareness, resulting in representations that fail to maintain geometric and spatial consistency across video frames. Given the scarcity of large-scale 3D data, we present GeoVR, a novel framework that learns geometric representations using purely 2D video sequences. This approach effectively restructures the semantic latent space within MLLMs to unlock spatial intelligence. Rather than employing superficial feature mixing, GeoVR reshapes the internal representations of the MLLM by distilling geometry knowledge from pre-trained 3D foundation models. This is accomplished through a multi-objective learning strategy driven by four complementary geometric targets: (1) estimating inter-frame camera poses to embed varying viewpoint dynamics, (2) regressing dense depth maps to anchor physical distances, (3) predicting a metric scale factor for real-world calibration, and (4) distilling multi-scale 3D features to align the intermediate feature space. Guided by these explicit physical and geometric constraints, the model's internal representations naturally develop strong 3D awareness. Extensive experiments on spatial reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that GeoVR achieves state-of-the-art performance, establishing a new paradigm for endowing foundation models with spatial intelligence.

AI.tldr: GeoVR提出了一种无需3D数据、仅用2D视频即可让多模态大语言模型获得3D几何感知能力的框架，通过从预训练3D基础模型中蒸馏几何知识，并利用相机位姿估计、深度回归、尺度预测和多尺度特征对齐四个几何目标来重塑MLLM的内部表征。
AI.motivation: 当前MLLM在2D语义理解上表现出色，但缺乏内在的3D空间感知能力，导致其表征在视频帧间无法保持几何和空间一致性。同时，大规模3D数据稀缺，因此亟需一种仅依赖2D数据即可赋予模型空间智能的方法。
AI.method: GeoVR框架采用多目标学习策略，从预训练3D基础模型中蒸馏几何知识来重塑MLLM的语义潜空间。具体包含四个互补的几何目标：(1)估计帧间相机位姿以嵌入视角动态变化；(2)回归稠密深度图以锚定物理距离；(3)预测度量尺度因子实现真实世界校准；(4)蒸馏多尺度3D特征以对齐中间特征空间。通过显式的物理与几何约束引导模型内部表征发展出强3D感知能力。
AI.result: 在空间推理基准上的大量实验表明，GeoVR达到了最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: GeoVR为赋予基础模型空间智能开辟了新范式，证明了仅通过2D视频序列和几何知识蒸馏即可有效解锁MLLM的3D空间理解能力。

title: ReverseEOL: Improving Training-free Text Embeddings via Text Reversal in Decoder-only LLMs
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have opened new avenues for generating training-free text embeddings. However, the causal attention in decoder-only LLMs prevents earlier tokens from attending to future context, leading to biased contextualized representations. In this work, we propose Reverse prompting with Explicit One-word Limitation (ReverseEOL), a simple yet effective method for enhancing the representational capability of frozen LLMs. ReverseEOL augments the standard forward embedding with an additional reversed embedding derived from the reversed input text. Since reversing the input exposes each token to context inaccessible in the original order, the resulting reversed embedding effectively provides complementary information to the original one. As a result, combining the forward and reversed embeddings yields a richer final representation. Comprehensive experiments on STS and MTEB benchmarks demonstrate that ReverseEOL significantly improves the performance of existing training-free baselines across a broad range of LLMs with diverse architectures and scales. Extensive ablations and analyses further confirm the necessity of our reversal mechanism.

AI.tldr: 提出ReverseEOL方法，通过反转输入文本生成互补的文本嵌入，与标准前向嵌入结合，在不训练的情况下显著提升冻结LLM的表示能力。
AI.motivation: 解码器仅有的LLM中，因果注意力机制阻止前面的token关注后续上下文，导致上下文表示存在偏差。需要一种无需训练的方法来弥补这一缺陷。
AI.method: ReverseEOL方法：对输入文本进行反转，将反转文本送入冻结LLM生成"反转嵌入"；将其与标准前向嵌入结合（如拼接或求和），得到最终表示。反转操作使每个token暴露于原始顺序中无法获取的上下文信息。
AI.result: 在STS和MTEB基准上的综合实验表明，ReverseEOL在多种架构和规模的LLM上均显著优于现有无训练基线方法。消融实验验证了反转机制的必要性。
AI.conclusion: ReverseEOL是一种简单高效的训练-free文本嵌入增强方法，反转机制能有效提供互补上下文信息，广泛适用于各类LLM。

title: Two-Way Is Better Than One: Bidirectional Alignment with Cycle Consistency for Exemplar-Free Class-Incremental Learning
comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026. 23 pages, 8 figures. Code: https://github.com/HXuSz11/BiCyc_ICLR2026
summary: Continual learning (CL) seeks models that acquire new skills without erasing prior knowledge. In exemplar-free class-incremental learning (EFCIL), this challenge is amplified because past data cannot be stored, making representation drift for old classes particularly harmful. Prototype-based EFCIL is attractive for its efficiency, yet prototypes drift as the embedding space evolves; therefore, projection-based drift compensation has become a popular remedy. We show, however, that existing one-directional projections introduce systematic bias: they either retroactively distort the current feature geometry or align past classes only locally, leaving cycle inconsistencies that accumulate across tasks. We introduce BiCyc, a bidirectional projector alignment approach with a cycle-consistency objective. BiCyc jointly optimizes two maps, old-to-new and new-to-old, with stop-gradient gating so that transport and representation co-evolve. Analytically, we show that the cycle loss contracts the singular spectrum toward unity in whitened space, and that improved transport of class means and covariances yields smaller perturbations of classification log-odds, preserving old-class decisions and mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Empirically, across standard EFCIL benchmarks, BiCyc substantially reduces forgetting and improves accuracy in from-scratch settings, while remaining competitive in the pretrained fine-grained regime.

AI.tldr: BiCyc提出双向投影对齐方法，通过循环一致性目标解决EFCIL中原型漂移问题，减少旧类遗忘并提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于投影的漂移补偿方法采用单向投影，存在系统性偏差：要么追溯性扭曲当前特征几何，要么仅局部对齐旧类，导致跨任务的循环不一致性累积，加剧灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 提出BiCyc双向投影器对齐框架，联合优化old-to-new和new-to-old两个映射，配合stop-gradient门控机制使传输与表示协同演化；引入循环一致性损失，在白化空间中收缩奇异谱趋近于1；通过改善类均值和协方差的传输，减小分类log-odds的扰动。
AI.result: 在标准EFCIL基准上，BiCyc在从头训练场景下显著降低遗忘率并提升准确率，在预训练细粒度场景下保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 双向循环一致投影对齐能有效缓解免样本类增量学习中的表示漂移与灾难性遗忘问题，兼具理论保证与实证效果。

title: Can LLMs Write Correct TLA+ Specifications? Evaluating Natural-Language-to-TLA+ Generation
comment: 12 pages, 11 tables. Accepted at the 21st International Conference on Software Technologies (ICSOFT 2026); Recommended as Best Paper Award Candidate
summary: TLA+ has supported industrial verification at companies such as Amazon and Microsoft, yet writing correct TLA+ specifications from natural language still requires time and expertise, which limits adoption. LLMs show promise, but no prior study measures whether they produce semantically correct TLA+ specifications from natural language. This paper presents the first systematic evaluation of LLM-based TLA+ specification synthesis from natural language. Our study evaluates 30 LLMs across eight families on a curated dataset of 205 TLA+ specifications: 25 open-weight models across four prompting strategies (2,600 runs) and 5 proprietary models under few-shot prompting (130 runs), all validated by the SANY parser and TLC model checker. LLMs achieve up to 26.6% syntactic correctness but only 8.6% semantic correctness, with successes exclusive to progressive prompting. Results show that model size does not predict quality, e.g., DeepSeek r1:8b outperforms its 70B variant across all strategies, which suggests the importance of reasoning alignment for formal languages. Code-specialized models consistently underperform due to negative transfer from mainstream language training. We identify five recurring hallucination categories, all traceable to specific training data biases. These results suggest that current LLMs do not generate reliable TLA+ specifications without expert oversight. We release the evaluation framework, code, and dataset to support reproducibility and future research.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统评估了基于大语言模型从自然语言生成TLA+规范的能力，在205个TLA+规范数据集上测试了30个LLM，发现语义正确率仅8.6%，成功案例仅限于渐进式提示策略，并识别出五类与训练数据偏差相关的幻觉模式。
AI.motivation: TLA+已在亚马逊、微软等企业支持工业级验证，但从自然语言编写正确的TLA+规范仍需大量时间和专业知识，限制了其广泛采用。此前没有研究系统测量LLM是否能从自然语言生成语义正确的TLA+规范。
AI.method: 构建包含205个TLA+规范的精选数据集，评估30个LLM（覆盖8个模型家族）：25个开源模型在四种提示策略下运行2,600次，5个闭源模型在少样本提示下运行130次。所有输出均通过SANY解析器和TLC模型检查器进行验证。
AI.result: LLM最高达到26.6%的语法正确率，但语义正确率仅8.6%，成功案例仅出现在渐进式提示策略下。模型大小不预测质量（如DeepSeek r1:8b在所有策略上优于其70B变体），代码专用模型因主流语言训练的负迁移持续表现不佳。识别出五类可追溯到训练数据偏差的反复出现的幻觉类别。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在无专家监督下无法生成可靠的TLA+规范。推理对齐对形式语言的重要性值得关注。研究团队已开源评估框架、代码和数据集以支持可复现性和未来研究。

title: Geometry-Aware Dataset Condensation for Diffusion Model Training
summary: Dataset condensation aims to construct compact datasets from real data via synthesis or selection. However, existing approaches are ill-suited for diffusion model training: synthetic data generation often yields low-fidelity samples unsuitable for authentic modeling, while real subset selection typically fails to preserve the distributional geometry required by diffusion likelihood objectives. To address this, we propose to reformulate real subset selection as a geometry-aware distribution alignment problem. By incorporating one-sided partial optimal transport, our method selectively aligns a compact subset with the full data distribution while allowing unmatched mass in low-density regions, ensuring the preserved geometric structure necessary for effective diffusion model training. To further ensure distributional fidelity, we complement geometric alignment with lightweight feature-statistics and semantic consistency regularization. An efficient two-stage discrete optimization strategy is proposed to achieve this alignment objective. Extensive experiments across diffusion variants, subset sizes, image resolutions, and training rounds show that our method achieves superior fidelity and distributional coverage in diffusion model training. Codes are available at https://github.com/2018cx/GADC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向扩散模型训练的几何感知数据集浓缩方法，将真实子集选择重新定义为分布对齐问题，通过单边部分最优传输保持几何结构，辅以特征统计和语义一致性正则化，并采用两阶段离散优化策略。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集浓缩方法不适用于扩散模型训练：合成数据生成保真度低，而真实子集选择无法保留扩散似然目标所需的分布几何结构。
AI.method: 将真实子集选择重新建模为几何感知的分布对齐问题：(1) 引入单边部分最优传输（one-sided partial optimal transport），选择性对齐紧凑子集与完整数据分布，同时允许低密度区域的非匹配质量；(2) 辅以轻量级特征统计和语义一致性正则化；(3) 提出高效的两阶段离散优化策略实现对齐目标。
AI.result: 在多种扩散变体、子集规模、图像分辨率和训练轮次的广泛实验中，该方法在扩散模型训练的保真度和分布覆盖面上均取得优越性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过几何感知分布对齐的视角重新思考数据集浓缩问题，为扩散模型训练提供了一种高效且高保真的子集选择方案，代码已开源。

title: TARPO: Token-Wise Latent-Explicit Reasoning via Action-Routing Policy Optimization
comment: 18 pages, 12 figures. Code available at https://github.com/NKU-LITI/TARPO-master
summary: Latent reasoning has emerged as a promising alternative to discrete Chain-of-Thought (CoT) in large language models (LLMs), enabling more expressive reasoning by operating over continuous representations. However, the inherently deterministic nature of continuous representations limits policy exploration in reinforcement learning (RL). To address this, we propose TARPO (Token-Wise Latent-Explicit Reasoning via Action-Routing Policy Optimization), a pure RL framework that adaptively switches between discrete token generation and continuous latent reasoning at each step. TARPO introduces a lightweight action head router that observes the current hidden state and samples a routing decision from a binary mode-selection space, preserving the stochasticity of discrete token sampling from the vocabulary. The LLM backbone and router are jointly optimized end-to-end with a shared group-relative advantage signal. Extensive experiments across Qwen2.5 (from 1.5B to 7B) and Llama-3.1-8B backbones demonstrate that TARPO consistently outperforms existing explicit and latent reasoning RL baselines across diverse benchmarks. Further analysis shows that TARPO learns adaptive token-wise switching behaviors while maintaining stable training dynamics. Our code is available at https://github.com/NKU-LITI/TARPO-master.

AI.tldr: TARPO是一个纯强化学习框架，通过在每一步自适应地在离散token生成和连续潜在推理之间切换，解决了连续表示在RL中确定性过强、限制策略探索的问题。该框架引入轻量级动作头路由器，与LLM主干联合端到端优化，在多个模型和基准上一致超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 潜在推理（latent reasoning）虽比离散思维链更具表达力，但其连续表示的确定性本质限制了强化学习中的策略探索能力。需要一种方法既能保留连续推理的表达优势，又能引入离散采样的随机性以促进RL探索。
AI.method: 提出TARPO框架：引入一个轻量级动作头路由器（action head router），在每个时间步观察当前隐藏状态，从二元模式选择空间（离散token生成 vs. 连续潜在推理）中采样路由决策。LLM骨干与路由器通过共享的组相对优势信号（group-relative advantage）进行联合端到端优化，保留了词汇表离散token采样的随机性。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5（1.5B到7B）和Llama-3.1-8B骨干上的广泛实验表明，TARPO在多种基准上一致优于现有的显式和潜在推理RL基线。进一步分析显示TARPO学会了自适应的逐token切换行为，同时保持稳定的训练动态。
AI.conclusion: TARPO通过动作路由策略优化，成功融合了离散和连续推理的优势，证明了token级自适应切换机制在RL框架下的有效性和通用性。

title: Causal Modeling of Selection in Evolution
summary: Understanding potential selection in data is crucial for causal discovery; we argue that "selection" in common narratives takes two forms, which we term static and evolutionary selection, respectively. Static selection refers to a one-shot filtering process where observed data consist of a subset of the population of interest, as in survey volunteer bias. Evolutionary selection, in contrast, operates through repeated rounds of differential fitness in reproduction, where observed data constitute the latest generation shaped by a historical trajectory, as in immune adaptation, antibiotic resistance, and social norm emergence. Existing methods largely conflate these two forms and rely on an identical graphical model of selection. We show that this model is valid for static settings but fails to characterize data under evolution, yielding false discovery results. To address this, we introduce a new model that specifically characterizes evolutionary selection, and develop a sound and complete procedure for identifying such models from data across one or multiple environments or generations. Experimental results validate the method's ability to uncover the relevant mechanisms underlying evolution from data.

AI.tldr: 本文区分了因果发现中两种被混淆的"选择"形式：静态选择（一次性筛选）和演化选择（多轮适应性繁殖），指出现有方法将二者混为一谈导致演化场景下的错误发现，并提出了一种专门表征演化选择的新模型及其完备的识别方法。
AI.motivation: 现有因果发现方法将选择过程统一建模为静态的图模型，但该模型无法正确刻画演化选择（如免疫适应、抗生素耐药性、社会规范涌现等场景）的数据生成机制，导致虚假的因果发现结果。研究者需要一种能够区分并正确处理演化选择的新模型。
AI.method: 作者首先从理论上论证了静态选择图模型在演化场景下的失效原因；然后引入了一种新的图模型来专门表征演化选择机制，该模型能够捕捉多代适应性繁殖的累积效应；在此基础上，开发了一套完备的识别流程，可从单环境或多环境/多代观测数据中识别此类模型结构。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提出的新模型和识别方法能够有效从数据中揭示演化背后的因果机制，克服了传统静态选择模型在演化场景中产生虚假发现的缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 在因果发现中区分静态选择与演化选择至关重要。本文提出的演化选择模型及其识别算法填补了这一方法学空白，为免疫学、微生物学和社会科学等涉及演化动态的领域提供了可靠的因果推断工具。

title: From Risk Classification to Action Plan Remediation: A Guardrail Feedback Driven Framework for LLM Agents
summary: LLM-based guardrails typically safeguard agents by evaluating proposed actions or inputs before execution, producing safety signals such as binary allow/deny decisions, risk categories, and/or explanatory rationales about potential policy violations. However, agent risks often arise when otherwise benign tasks are contaminated by untrusted external content, unsafe instructions, or risky tool use. Existing guardrails often flag the entire task uniformly as unsafe, thereby blocking the threat but sacrificing the benign part. Moreover, existing work largely evaluates guardrails in isolation, leaving unclear whether their interventions lead to safer downstream agent behavior. To address this, we introduce TRIAD (Tripartite Response for Iterative Agent Guardrailing), a guardrail-integrated agent framework that leverages guardrail-generated verbal feedback as a guiding signal to keep the agent aligned with benign objectives at each planning step. We finetune a language model on a self-curated training dataset to output one of three decisions: proceed, refuse, or update, together with structured natural-language feedback. Rather than merely allowing or blocking execution, update guides the agent to revise its plan, avoid harmful components, and preserve the benign task where possible. TRIAD injects this feedback into the agent's context, enabling subsequent plan revision and forming a closed loop between guardrail feedback and agent planning. Extensive experiments on ASB and AgentHarm show that TRIAD reduces the average attack success rate to 10.42%, while achieving the best safety-utility trade-off among guardrail-integrated baselines. Our code is available at: https://github.com/YUHAOSUNABC/TRIAD.

AI.tldr: TRIAD 是一个集成护栏的智能体框架，通过生成三类结构化反馈（继续/拒绝/更新）引导智能体在每一步规划中保持安全，而非简单二元拦截，在 ASB 和 AgentHarm 上实现 10.42% 的攻击成功率，同时取得最佳安全-效用权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的护栏通常对整个任务做二元安全判断，导致良性部分也被一并阻断；且护栏评估多孤立进行，未考察其对下游智能体行为实际安全性的影响。因此需要一种能在保留良性任务的同时精准剔除有害成分、并形成护栏与智能体规划闭环的机制。
AI.method: 提出 TRIAD 框架，在自策划训练数据集上微调语言模型，使其输出三种决策之一——proceed（继续）、refuse（拒绝）、update（更新），并附带结构化自然语言反馈。update 决策引导智能体修改计划、避开有害组件。护栏反馈被注入智能体上下文，实现规划修正的闭环。
AI.result: 在 ASB 和 AgentHarm 基准上，TRIAD 将平均攻击成功率降至 10.42%，在集成了护栏的基线方法中取得最佳的安全-效用权衡。
AI.conclusion: TRIAD 验证了三元反馈式护栏集成框架的有效性：相比传统二元拦截，update 机制能在不牺牲良性任务的前提下显著降低攻击成功率，且护栏与智能体规划之间的闭环迭代是保障下游行为安全的关键。

title: Resonant Minds: Closed-Loop Social Avatars with Theory of Mind
summary: Creating lifelike digital humans with genuine social intelligence requires unifying cognitive reasoning and multimodal generation within a coherent framework. Current approaches treat these as separate tasks: Large Language Models excel at dialogue but lack embodied expression, while diffusion-based talking head models achieve visual fidelity but ignore social cognition. To bridge this gap, we propose a closed-loop dual-agent framework integrating perception, social reasoning, and expression into a continuous interaction cycle. The perception module analyzes partners' multimodal behaviors from video, while the social reasoning module infers hidden mental states through Theory of Mind and selects responses via an ensemble mechanism. The expression module then generates emotion-controllable dual-agent videos synthesizing both speaker speech and expression alongside listener reactive behaviors, capturing bidirectional dynamics absent in prior work. We construct a hierarchical Persona-Scenario dataset with psychologically grounded personas and private social goals to support evaluation under information asymmetry. Experiments on this dataset demonstrate competitive or superior performance on both dialogue quality and video generation metrics. Notably, our method surpasses even the full-information Script mode on key dialogue quality dimensions, suggesting that explicit mental state inference under uncertainty can elicit more thoughtful dialogue than unrestricted information access.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个闭环双智能体框架，将感知、社会推理与表达统一为连续交互循环。感知模块分析视频中的多模态行为，社会推理模块通过心理理论推断隐藏心理状态并选择回应，表达模块生成情感可控的双人对话视频。在构建的分层人物-场景数据集上，该方法在对话质量和视频生成指标上表现优异，甚至在关键维度上超越了全信息脚本模式。
AI.motivation: 当前数字人系统存在割裂：大语言模型擅长对话但缺乏具身表达，扩散模型能生成逼真面部动画但忽视社会认知。作者旨在弥合这一鸿沟，将认知推理与多模态生成统一到一个连贯框架中。
AI.method: 提出闭环双智能体框架，包含三个模块：(1) 感知模块——从视频中分析对话伙伴的多模态行为；(2) 社会推理模块——通过心理理论（Theory of Mind）推断隐藏心理状态，并采用集成机制选择回应策略；(3) 表达模块——生成情感可控的双智能体视频，同时合成说话者语音与表情以及听者的反应行为，捕捉双向交互动态。此外，构建了分层Persona-Scenario数据集，包含心理学基础的人物设定和私有社会目标，支持信息不对称下的评估。
AI.result: 在自建数据集上的实验表明，该方法在对话质量和视频生成两个维度的指标上均达到竞争性或更优性能。尤为显著的是，在关键对话质量维度上，该方法甚至超越了拥有全信息的Script模式。
AI.conclusion: 在不确定性条件下进行显式心理状态推理，能够激发出比无限制信息访问更富有思考性的对话。这验证了将社会认知能力嵌入数字人生成框架的重要性，为构建真正具有社交智能的数字人提供了新方向。

title: Analysis of the Neglect-Zero Effect in Large Language Models
comment: 14 pages (10 pages main text), 8 figures. To appear in the Proceedings of the ACL2026 Student Research Workshop (SRW)
summary: We investigate the extent to which the language processing of LLMs resembles human cognitive processes, focusing on a human cognitive bias called the $\textit{neglect-zero effect}$. This effect refers to the human tendency to ignore $\textit{zero-models}$, which are configurations that render a proposition vacuously true by virtue of an empty set. We focus on two types of inferences driven by the neglect-zero effect, and examine how LLMs process these inferences by comparing their behavior with that in an inference that does not involve the neglect-zero effect. For this purpose, we employ a paradigm based on $\textit{structural priming}$, where recent exposure to a preceding sentence (the $\textit{prime}$) facilitates the processing of a subsequent sentence (the $\textit{target}$) due to their structural similarity. We prepare primes to force LLMs to consider the zero-model, and analyze whether they also consider it in the target. The results suggest that the neglect-zero effect may not occur in the LLMs analyzed in this study. Our code is available at https://github.com/ynklab/neglect_zero

AI.tldr: 研究了LLMs是否表现出人类特有的"忽视零效应"认知偏差，通过结构启动范式分析发现，所测LLMs可能不存在这种效应。
AI.motivation: 探究大语言模型(LLMs)的语言处理在多大程度上类似于人类的认知过程，具体以"忽视零效应"(neglect-zero effect)这一人类认知偏差为切入点——人类倾向于忽略那些因空集而使命题空洞成立的"零模型"(zero-models)。
AI.method: 采用基于结构启动(structural priming)的实验范式：通过前序句子(启动句)强制LLMs考虑零模型，然后观察其在后续句子(目标句)中是否也会考虑零模型。对比涉及忽视零效应的两种推理类型与不涉及该效应的推理中LLMs的行为差异。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所分析的大语言模型可能不存在忽视零效应这一人类认知偏差。
AI.conclusion: LLMs的语言处理机制在忽视零效应方面与人类存在差异，提示当前LLMs可能并未复现人类的这一特定认知偏差。

title: Benchmarking Counterfactual Prediction in Epidemic Time Series with Time-Varying Interventions
summary: Deep learning has enabled significant advances in time-series causal inference, yet progress remains constrained by the lack of realistic benchmarks with observable counterfactual outcomes. Existing datasets either rely on real-world observations without ground-truth counterfactuals or on simplified simulations that fail to capture complex causal dynamics. To address this gap, we develop a large-scale benchmark for counterfactual prediction in epidemic time series under dynamic interventions. Unlike existing benchmarks, it supports static and time-varying treatments, as well as both single-policy and multi-policy intervention settings, enabling evaluation of causal inference methods across a broad range of causal inference scenarios. Leveraging a calibrated agent-based model grounded in real-world demographic, mobility, epidemiological, and policy data, we generate realistic counterfactual trajectories across more than 150 U.S. counties. Using this benchmark, we evaluate widely used and state-of-the-art causal inference methods, revealing substantial performance differences and highlighting the challenges of realistic time-series causal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个大规模流行病时间序列反事实预测基准，基于校准的智能体模型生成150多个美国县的真实反事实轨迹，支持静态/时变处理及单策略/多策略干预设置，并用其评估了主流因果推断方法的性能差异。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列因果推断基准要么缺乏真实反事实标签（仅基于观测数据），要么过于简化（无法捕捉复杂因果动态），严重制约了深度学习在时间序列因果推断领域的进展。因此亟需一个具备可观测反事实结果、且能反映现实复杂性的基准。
AI.method: 作者采用基于智能体的模型（agent-based model），使用真实的人口统计、流动性、流行病学及政策数据进行校准，生成超过150个美国县的真实反事实轨迹。该基准支持静态与时间变化两种治疗类型，以及单策略与多策略干预场景。
AI.result: 在该基准上评估了广泛使用及最先进的因果推断方法，结果显示各方法之间存在显著的性能差异，揭示了现实时间序列因果推理所面临的巨大挑战。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为时间序列因果推断提供了更真实、更全面的评估平台，填补了现有基准的空白；实验结果也表明，当前方法在复杂现实场景下的因果推理能力仍有较大提升空间。

title: When Tools Fail: Benchmarking Dynamic Replanning and Anomaly Recovery in LLM Agents
summary: Existing benchmarks evaluate Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) in LLMs on idealized ''happy paths'', largely overlooking real-world tool failures. We introduce ToolMaze, a benchmark for dynamic path discovery and error recovery in TIR agents. To separate systematic replanning from blind trial-and-error, ToolMaze adopts a two-dimensional design: DAG-based topological complexity and a $2 \times 2$ taxonomy of tool perturbations (explicit/implicit, transient/permanent). Evaluations show that perturbations degrade performance across nearly all models, with the sharpest drops under implicit semantic failures. Driven by systemic over-trust in corrupted outputs, Perturbation Recovery Rate (PRR) plummets by around 37\% in these scenarios, while complex topologies trap agents in futile trial-and-error loops. Crucially, agentic fault-tolerance improves with model scale $3.66\times$ slower than basic task execution, highlighting dynamic replanning as a distinct bottleneck unaddressed by model scaling or prompting. Data and code are available at https://github.com/Zhudongsheng75/ToolMaze.

AI.tldr: ToolMaze是一个评估LLM在工具调用中面对真实世界故障时动态路径发现与错误恢复能力的基准，揭示了模型规模扩展对动态重规划能力的提升远落后于基础任务执行。
AI.motivation: 现有基准仅在理想化"快乐路径"上评估LLM的工具集成推理(TIR)，忽略了现实世界中工具调用经常出现的故障（如工具宕机、输出损坏等），导致对模型真实鲁棒性的评估存在盲区。
AI.method: 提出ToolMaze基准，采用二维设计：(1) 基于DAG的拓扑复杂度，用于区分系统性重规划与盲目试错；(2) 一个2×2的工具扰动分类法（显式/隐式 × 瞬态/永久），覆盖四类真实故障模式。引入扰动恢复率(PRR)指标量化故障恢复能力。
AI.result: 工具扰动导致几乎所有模型性能下降，其中隐式语义故障场景下下降最剧烈——PRR骤降约37%；复杂拓扑使智能体陷入无效试错循环。关键发现：智能体的容错能力随模型规模提升的速率比基础任务执行慢3.66倍。
AI.conclusion: 动态重规划构成一个独立于模型规模扩展和提示工程的瓶颈，模型变大并不能等比例解决工具故障恢复问题，需要在架构或训练范式上进行针对性改进。

title: Self-Learning Expression Deformations for Data-Efficient Gaussian Avatars
summary: Modeling dynamic facial expressions using 3D Gaussian representations remains challenging due to their unstructured nature. Conventional Gaussian avatar pipelines require extensive multiview and sequential expression data, limiting scalability and accessibility. In this work, we introduce Self-Adaptive Gaussian Expression (SAGE), a framework for self-learning expression-induced Gaussian deformations that enables high-fidelity, animatable avatars from minimal input data. Our method jointly optimizes 2D Gaussian surfels and a Signed Distance Field (SDF) to enforce compact, surface-aligned Gaussian distributions, while a self-supervised expression learning phase replaces long training sequences with geometric and appearance consistency constraints. This design allows flexible deployment across multiple reconstruction regimes: in the multiview setting, only a single frame (timestep) is required instead of thousands; in the monocular setting, only head rotations are needed without expression sequences; and in the one-shot setting, no pretraining or priors are necessary. Experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves reconstruction and animation quality comparable to state-of-the-art methods, while reducing data requirements by several orders of magnitude. Our results highlight the potential of self-supervised Gaussian deformation learning as a step toward accessible, data-efficient avatar creation.

AI.tldr: SAGE 是一种自适应的 3D 高斯表情建模框架，通过自监督学习实现从极少输入数据中重建高质量可动画化头像，将数据需求降低了数个数量级。
AI.motivation: 传统高斯头像管线需要大量多视角和序列表情数据，限制了可扩展性和可访问性。核心动机是以极少的输入数据（单帧、仅头部旋转、甚至一次性设置）实现高质量动态面部表情建模。
AI.method: 提出 SAGE 框架：(1) 联合优化 2D 高斯 surfels 与有符号距离场 (SDF)，强制高斯分布紧贴表面；(2) 自监督表情学习阶段，用几何和外观一致性约束替代长训练序列；(3) 灵活支持多视角（仅需单帧）、单目（仅需头部旋转，无需表情序列）、一次性（无需预训练或先验）三种重建模式。
AI.result: 在重建和动画质量上达到与最先进方法相当的水平，同时将数据需求减少了数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 自监督高斯变形学习是实现数据高效、可访问头像创建的重要一步，SAGE 框架在保证高保真度的前提下显著降低了对输入数据的依赖。

title: YouZhi: Towards High-Concurrency Financial LLMs via Adaptive GQA-to-MLA Transition
summary: Large language models (LLMs) drive significant financial innovations, yet their high-concurrency deployment is severely bottlenecked by KV cache memory overhead, which inflates infrastructure costs and throttles scalability. To address this, we propose YouZhi-LLM, a highly efficient financial LLM empowered by a comprehensive structural transition and training pipeline natively built on the Huawei Ascend ecosystem. At its algorithmic core, YouZhi-LLM features a layer-adaptive GQA-to-MLA transition framework that dynamically assigns per-layer FreqFold sizes, maximizing KV-cache compression while minimizing perplexity degradation. To recover representation capacity and inject domain expertise, the Ascend-based training pipeline seamlessly integrates generalized knowledge distillation with financial-specific supervised fine-tuning. Evaluations demonstrate the superiority of this systematic approach, with the adaptive transition reducing perplexity degradation by up to 35% over uniform baselines. Crucially, when evaluated on Ascend NPUs via vLLM-Ascend, the massive KV-cache reduction translates directly into deployment efficiency. Compared to their respective base models, YouZhi-7B yields a 12.3% improvement in average financial benchmark score alongside a 2.69$\times$ increase in maximum concurrency; similarly, YouZhi-14B achieves a 7.0% accuracy gain and a 2.43$\times$ concurrency boost, establishing a new paradigm for cost-effective, high-throughput financial inference.

AI.tldr: 优智大模型(YouZhi-LLM)面向金融场景，提出层自适应GQA到MLA的转换框架以压缩KV缓存、降低推理成本，并结合知识蒸馏与金融微调恢复模型表示能力。在华为昇腾NPU上部署后，YouZhi-7B和14B分别取得12.3%和7.0%的金融基准分数提升，并发量提升2.69倍和2.43倍。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型驱动金融创新的同时，KV缓存内存开销在高并发部署中成为关键瓶颈，显著推高基础设施成本并限制可扩展性。现有方案缺乏对金融领域KV缓存压缩与领域性能兼顾的系统性解决方案。
AI.method: (1) 提出层自适应GQA-to-MLA转换框架，为每层动态分配FreqFold尺寸，在最大化KV缓存压缩的同时最小化困惑度退化；(2) 基于华为昇腾生态构建训练流水线，集成广义知识蒸馏与金融监督微调以恢复表示能力并注入领域知识；(3) 通过vLLM-Ascend在昇腾NPU上部署验证。
AI.result: 自适应转换相比均匀基线降低困惑度退化最高达35%；YouZhi-7B金融基准平均得分提升12.3%，最大并发提升2.69倍；YouZhi-14B精度提升7.0%，并发提升2.43倍。
AI.conclusion: YouZhi-LLM通过算法-训练-部署的系统性协同创新，在高吞吐金融推理场景中同时实现了精度提升与KV缓存大幅压缩，为成本高效的大规模金融推理建立了新范式。

title: MolE-RAG: Molecular Structure-Enhanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Chemistry
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for molecular property prediction, but their ability to reason over chemical structures remains limited, as molecular representations such as SMILES differ substantially from the natural language on which LLMs are primarily trained. To bridge this semantic and chemical knowledge gap, we propose MolE-RAG, a training-free, molecule-centric retrieval-augmented generation framework for LLM-based molecular property prediction. MolE-RAG augments each prediction with three complementary sources of inference-time context: retrieved chemistry literature, molecule-specific information including compound synonyms, identifiers, functional group annotations, and physicochemical descriptors, and structurally similar molecules retrieved from the training set. We evaluate MolE-RAG across nine molecular property prediction tasks using proprietary, chemistry-specialized, and open-source LLMs. Across general-purpose LLMs, MolE-RAG improves ROC-AUC by up to 28 percentage points on classification tasks and reduces regression RMSE by up to 67% relative to a SMILES-only baseline. We further find that the utility of each context source varies across models and tasks, with different models benefiting most from textual retrieval, molecular context, or structural retrieval. These results suggest that molecule-centric retrieval can improve LLM-based molecular property prediction without model fine-tuning while providing a flexible framework for integrating heterogeneous chemical knowledge at inference time.

AI.tldr: 提出MolE-RAG，一种无需训练的、以分子为中心的检索增强生成框架，通过整合化学文献、分子特异性信息和结构相似分子三种推理时上下文，显著提升LLM在分子性质预测上的表现。
AI.motivation: LLM在分子性质预测中有潜力，但SMILES等分子表示与自然语言存在巨大的语义和化学知识鸿沟，限制了LLM对化学结构的推理能力。需要一种无需微调的方法来弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 提出MolE-RAG框架，在推理时引入三类互补上下文：(1) 检索到的化学文献；(2) 分子特异性信息（化合物同义词、标识符、官能团注释、物理化学描述符）；(3) 从训练集中检索的结构相似分子。在专有LLM、化学专用LLM和开源LLM上，于九项分子性质预测任务中进行评估。
AI.result: 相比仅使用SMILES的基线，MolE-RAG在通用LLM上将分类任务ROC-AUC最高提升28个百分点，回归任务RMSE最高降低67%。不同上下文来源对不同模型和任务的效用各异：有的模型受益于文本检索，有的受益于分子上下文，有的则受益于结构检索。
AI.conclusion: 以分子为中心的检索增强可在不进行模型微调的情况下提升LLM分子性质预测性能，并提供了一种在推理时灵活整合异构化学知识的框架。

title: Statistical Priors for Implicit Preferences: Decoupling Skill Selection as a Local Harness in Personal Agents
summary: As Large Language Model (LLM) capabilities advance, locally deployed personal agents relying on API-based remote models and external skills have emerged as a novel paradigm. With the rapid expansion of available skills, enabling personal agents to learn and adapt to implicit user preferences becomes a critical challenge. However, local deployment constraints preclude complex centralized selection algorithms, creating an urgent need for a lightweight local preference harness. This paper explores the implementation of such a harness through a novel architecture that strictly decouples statistical preference learning from semantic intent parsing. Specifically, we leverage localized statistical results to influence and modulate the selection decisions of the remote LLM. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our decoupled approach achieves the lowest cumulative regret and highest test accuracy, significantly outperforming traditional memory-augmented agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将统计偏好学习与语义意图解析严格解耦的轻量级局部偏好调控架构，使本地部署的个人代理能有效学习隐式用户偏好，在累积遗憾和测试准确率上均显著优于传统记忆增强代理。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM能力提升，本地部署的个人代理依赖远程API模型和外部技能成为新范式。技能数量快速增长，代理需学习并适应用户隐式偏好，但本地部署的资源约束排除了复杂的集中式选择算法，因此迫切需要一种轻量级的本地偏好调控机制。
AI.method: 提出一种将统计偏好学习与语义意图解析严格解耦的新型架构。利用本地化统计结果来影响和调制远程LLM的选择决策，使偏好学习在本地轻量完成，而语义理解仍交由远程大模型处理。
AI.result: 大量评估表明，该解耦方法实现了最低的累积遗憾（cumulative regret）和最高的测试准确率，显著优于传统的记忆增强型代理。
AI.conclusion: 通过统计偏好学习与语义意图解析的解耦架构，可在本地资源受限条件下有效实现用户偏好学习与适配，为本地部署个人代理的偏好调控提供了轻量且高效的解决方案。

title: CamFlow+: Hybrid Motion Bases for 2D Camera Motion Estimation with Stabilization Applications
summary: Estimating 2D camera motion is fundamental to computer vision and computational photography. Existing homography-based methods work well for planar scenes or pure rotation, but struggle with camera translation, depth variation, and local parallax; local homography and mesh-based models improve flexibility but still rely on piecewise planar assumptions. We introduce CamFlow+, a hybrid-basis framework that represents 2D camera motion directly in dense-flow space. CamFlow+ combines homography-derived physical bases, stochastic bases sampled from homography flows, and depth-translational bases derived from depth and camera intrinsics, relaxing the single-plane constraint while preserving camera-motion regularity. A depth-aware smoothness term further regularizes translation-induced parallax in continuous-depth regions while preserving motion changes near depth boundaries. We evaluate CamFlow+ on GHOF-Cam, a camera-motion benchmark that masks out dynamic objects and ill-posed occlusion regions in an optical-flow benchmark to isolate camera-induced motion. Experiments show that CamFlow+ improves sparse and dense camera-motion estimation. In digital video stabilization, CamFlow+ also improves global and local stability, achieving the best top-1 preference rate in a blind user study. Code and datasets will be available on the project page: https://lhaippp.github.io/CamFlow+.

AI.tldr: CamFlow+ 是一种混合基框架，直接在密集光流空间中表示二维相机运动，结合了物理基、随机基和深度-平移基，突破了传统平面假设的限制，在相机运动估计和视频稳像任务中均取得最优效果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于单应性的方法在相机平移、深度变化和局部视差场景中表现不佳；局部单应性和网格模型虽有改善，但依然依赖分段平面假设。因此需要一种能放松单平面约束、同时保持相机运动规律性的新方法。
AI.method: 提出 CamFlow+ 混合基框架，直接在密集光流空间中表示二维相机运动。具体包含三类基：从单应性导出的物理基、从单应性流中采样的随机基、以及由深度和相机内参导出的深度-平移基。此外，引入深度感知平滑项，在连续深度区域正则化平移诱导的视差，同时在深度边界处保持运动变化。
AI.result: 在 GHOF-Cam 基准（掩蔽动态物体和不适定遮挡区域的光流基准）上，CamFlow+ 在稀疏和密集相机运动估计中均取得提升；在数字视频稳像任务中，全局和局部稳定性均有改善，盲测用户研究中获得最高的 top-1 偏好率。
AI.conclusion: CamFlow+ 通过混合基表示和深度感知平滑，成功突破了传统平面假设的局限，在相机运动估计和视频稳像两个任务上均验证了其优越性。

title: Evaluating Stochastic Collapse and Implicit Bias in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Current evaluations for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) overwhelmingly focus on utility-driven objectives, leaving model behavior under logic-neutral scenarios largely underexplored. Stochasticity is essential in scenarios where multiple actions are equally valid, such as recommending travel itineraries or daily schedules where multiple options have similar utility. In such settings, deterministic policies may lead to repetitive behaviors and reduced coverage of valid alternatives. To bridge this gap, we propose RandomBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate whether MLLMs can maintain distributionally neutral behavior when selecting among equivalent options. We further introduce three metrics, including RI, BCI, BII, to quantify entropy and distributional bias. Experiments reveal a pervasive phenomenon termed Stochastic Collapse, where MLLMs fail to maintain uniform randomness under explicit random instructions, with top-1 probabilities reaching 97% from the ideal one quarter baseline and RI dropping to 0.068 in Claude Sonnet 4.6. Extensive ablation studies further demonstrate that these deviations persist across languages and representation formats, highlighting the robustness of distributional collapse in logic-neutral decision settings.

AI.tldr: RandomBench 是一个评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在逻辑等价选项中能否保持随机均匀分布的基准，揭示了"随机坍缩"（Stochastic Collapse）现象——模型在明确随机指令下仍表现出极端确定性偏差。
AI.motivation: 当前 MLLM 评估几乎全部聚焦于效用驱动的任务，忽视了逻辑中性场景下的随机行为。在推荐旅行路线、日程安排等多选项效用等价场景中，随机性至关重要，而确定性策略会导致重复行为和有效备选覆盖不足。
AI.method: 提出 RandomBench 基准，设计逻辑等价的多选项选择任务，并引入三个量化指标——RI（随机性指数）、BCI（二元一致性指数）、BII（二元独立指数）——来衡量熵和分布偏差。通过跨语言、跨表征格式的消融实验进行验证。
AI.result: 实验发现 MLLMs 普遍存在"随机坍缩"：在明确随机指令下，Claude Sonnet 4.6 的 top-1 概率高达 97%（理想基线为 25%），RI 降至 0.068。该偏差跨语言和表征格式均稳健存在。
AI.conclusion: MLLMs 在逻辑中性决策场景下存在严重的分布坍缩问题，无法在等价选项间维持均匀随机性，这可能导致依赖随机性的下游应用出现行为偏差和覆盖不足。

title: Revisiting Prototype Rehearsal for Exemplar-Free Continual Learning: Manifold-Aware Boundary Sampling with Adaptive Class-Balanced Loss
comment: Published in CVPR 2026 Findings. 10 pages, 6 figures. CVF version: https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2026F/html/Xu_Revisiting_Prototype_Rehearsal_for_Exemplar-Free_Continual_Learning_Manifold-Aware_Boundary_Sampling_CVPRF_2026_paper.html. Code: https://github.com/HXuSz11/ACB_CEOS_CVPR2026_Findings
summary: Exemplar-free class-incremental learning (EFCIL) aims to acquire new classes over time without storing raw data. Historically, prototype rehearsal, which samples around stored class prototypes and mixes them with current-task data, has been a popular strategy to reduce catastrophic forgetting. However, recent drift-compensation methods that explicitly realign prototypes in the evolving feature space consistently outperform prototype-based rehearsal, raising the question of whether rehearsal itself is fundamentally limited. We argue that the performance gap stems not from the idea of prototype rehearsal per se, but from how it is typically instantiated: existing approaches treat prototypes as isolated class summaries that ignore information from nearby enemy classes, and fail to correct the emerging class imbalance between a handful of synthetic old-class samples and hundreds of real instances from newly introduced classes. Building on this hypothesis, we revisit prototype rehearsal and propose a manifold-aware variant that restores its competitiveness in EFCIL. First, we introduce Constrained Expansive Over-Sampling, which interpolates each old-class prototype toward its nearest enemy features from new classes, generating boundary-aware rehearsal samples that better follow the underlying data manifold while preserving inter-class separation. Second, we design an Adaptive Class-Balanced loss that performs time-based class weighting, amplifying gradients from older prototypes when they are most informative and gradually annealing their influence as richer supervision from later tasks accumulates. Together, these components turn prototype rehearsal into a drift-resilient, imbalance-aware mechanism that closes, and often reverses, the gap to recent drift-compensation methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance across multiple EFCIL benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了无样本类增量学习中的原型重放策略，指出其性能落后于漂移补偿方法的原因并非重放本身有根本缺陷，而是现有实例化方式存在两个问题：忽略邻近敌类信息和未能纠正类不平衡。为此，作者提出流形感知的原型重放方法，包含约束扩展过采样和自适应类平衡损失，使原型重放恢复竞争力，在多个基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 近年漂移补偿方法持续优于原型重放策略，引发了一个问题：原型重放是否在根本上存在局限？作者认为性能差距并非源于重放思想本身，而是现有方法将原型视为孤立的类摘要（忽略邻近敌类信息），且未能解决合成旧类样本与新类真实样本之间的类不平衡问题。
AI.method: 提出两个核心组件：(1) 约束扩展过采样（Constrained Expansive Over-Sampling）：将每个旧类原型向最近的新类"敌类"特征方向插值，生成边界感知的重放样本，使其更好遵循数据流形同时保持类间分离；(2) 自适应类平衡损失（Adaptive Class-Balanced Loss）：基于时间进行类加权，在旧原型信息量最大时放大其梯度，随着后续任务提供更丰富监督信号时逐步衰减其影响。
AI.result: 所提方法将原型重放转变为漂移弹性、类不平衡感知的机制，缩小甚至逆转了与近期漂移补偿方法之间的性能差距，在多个EFCIL基准上取得最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 原型重放并非根本上有缺陷，关键在于如何实例化。通过流形感知采样和自适应类平衡损失，原型重放可以恢复其在EFCIL中的竞争力，并为未来研究提供了重新审视重放策略的新视角。

title: Agentic Molecular Recovery via Molecule-Aware Exploration
summary: Text-guided molecular generation with LLMs often yields invalid SMILES. We argue that invalid drafts should be addressed through a shift from validity-oriented repair to identity-preserving molecular recovery: the objective is not only to restore chemical validity, but also to preserve target-relevant structural cues and recover the molecular identity implied by the description. This perspective reveals the limitations of existing correction strategies. Post-hoc repair can recover validity while distorting key structures, LLM-only correction can introduce unintended global drift, and generic agentic correction remains constrained by greedy single-candidate trajectories even when equipped with executable RDKit edit tools. To address these limitations, we propose AMREC, which couples molecule-aware mismatch tracking with expanded candidate exploration and trajectory-level selection. On invalid ChEBI-20 drafts from three backbone models, AMREC achieves the strongest overall recovery profile across structural, exact-match, and string-level metrics.

AI.tldr: 针对LLM文本引导分子生成中产生无效SMILES的问题，本文提出AMREC框架，将传统面向有效性的修复转变为保持分子身份的恢复，结合不匹配追踪与候选扩展策略，在ChEBI-20数据集上取得最优恢复效果。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM分子生成常产生无效SMILES，而目前修复策略存在根本局限：后修复会扭曲关键结构、纯LLM修正引入全局漂移、智能体修正受限于单候选贪婪轨迹。核心问题在于这些方法只追求化学有效性，却忽略了保留文本描述所隐含的分子身份信息。
AI.method: 提出AMREC框架，包含三个核心组件：(1)分子感知的不匹配追踪(Molecule-aware Mismatch Tracking)，识别无效SMILES中偏离目标的结构片段；(2)扩展候选探索(Expanded Candidate Exploration)，生成多个修正候选而非单一轨迹；(3)轨迹级选择(Trajectory-level Selection)，在候选集中筛选最优恢复分子。框架可与RDKit编辑工具协同工作。
AI.result: 在ChEBI-20数据集上，基于三种骨干模型(Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B、Galactica-6.7B)生成的无效SMILES进行验证。AMREC在结构相似性、精确匹配率和字符串级指标上均取得最强综合恢复表现，相比后修复、纯LLM修正和通用智能体修正均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 分子生成中的无效SMILES问题应从"有效性修复"转向"身份保持恢复"，AMREC通过不匹配感知、候选扩展和轨迹选择实现了这一目标，证明了该范式转变的优越性。该框架为LLM驱动的分子生成提供了更可靠的化学感知恢复路径。

title: Unveiling the Unknown: Open Vocabulary Object Detection with Scene Graphs
summary: Open-vocabulary object detection seeks to identify novel object categories that were not part of the training data. Many knowledge distillation-based approaches have shown promising performance by transferring knowledge from pre-trained vision-language models to object detection. However, these methods often overlook structured, image-specific relationships between objects, such as interactions and spatial arrangements. This oversight can significantly restrict the effectiveness of detecting novel categories. To address this issue, we propose a Scene-guided Relational Modeling detection framework. This framework utilizes scene graphs to capture structured semantic and spatial relationships between candidate regions and their contextual objects. It explicitly models interactions among neighboring regions and incorporates a Relation Attention Module to implicitly amplify the key relational cues extracted from the scene graph. Furthermore, we present a scene-based textual alignment branch that distills category knowledge from captions to guide relational alignment. This approach facilitates a seamless integration of visual relations with semantic information for enhanced detection performance. Comprehensive experiments show that our model achieves superior performance compared to other OVOD methods, improving the AP for novel categories on COCO and LVIS datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Scene-guided Relational Modeling框架，利用场景图捕获候选区域间的结构化语义与空间关系，通过关系注意力模块和基于场景的文本对齐分支，将视觉关系与语义信息融合，在COCO和LVIS数据集上取得了优于现有开放词汇目标检测方法的新类别检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于知识蒸馏的开放词汇目标检测方法忽略了图像中对象之间结构化的、图像特定的关系（如交互和空间布局），限制了新类别检测效果。为此，需要显式建模对象间关系以提升检测性能。
AI.method: 提出Scene-guided Relational Modeling检测框架：(1) 利用场景图捕获候选区域与上下文对象间的结构化语义和空间关系；(2) 显式建模相邻区域间的交互；(3) 引入Relation Attention Module隐式放大场景图提取的关键关系线索；(4) 设计基于场景的文本对齐分支，从图像描述中蒸馏类别知识以引导关系对齐，实现视觉关系与语义信息的无缝融合。
AI.result: 在COCO和LVIS数据集上的综合实验表明，该模型在开放词汇目标检测任务中取得了优于其他方法的新类别AP指标。
AI.conclusion: 通过场景引导的关系建模框架，有效融合结构化视觉关系与语义信息，显著提升了开放词汇目标检测中新类别的检测精度。

title: Staying with the Uncertainty: Uncertainty-Scaffolding Strategies for Artificial Moral Advisors in LLM-to-LLM Simulated Conversations
summary: LLMs are increasingly deployed as Artificial Moral Advisors (AMA) in a variety of contexts: what kind of conversational patterns should they display? In this paper, we study how AMA can help their interlocutors "stay with the uncertainty". We propose three modes of uncertainty (Perspective-Multiplying, Tension-Preserving, Process-Reflecting) and compare them against three control conditions (Baseline, Persuasive, Sycophantic). A user-agent LLM engages in a dialogue on an ethical dilemma with an AMA following a specific uncertainty strategy, and completes pre- and post-conversation questionnaires. We further examine the effect of two persona prompt formats (Declarative and Narrative). We found that (1) no single model dominates as a simulated user agent, with open models aligning with human ambiguity through between-persona divergence and closed models through within-persona hedging; (2) declarative personas better capture initial stance diversity while narrative personas show more realistic belief revision; (3) all six AMA strategies produce distinguishable conversational patterns; and (4) uncertainty strategies differ not in how much stance revision they produce, but in the quality of engagement they sustain.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了人工道德顾问（AMA）在与用户对话中如何表达不确定性，提出了三种不确定性模式（视角倍增、张力保持、过程反思），并与三种对照条件比较。实验采用用户-代理LLM对话范式，考察了声明式和叙事式两种人格提示格式的影响。主要发现包括：不同模型在模拟用户时表现出不同的人内/人际模糊模式；声明式提示更好捕捉初始立场多样性，叙事式提示展现更真实的信念修正；六种AMA策略均产生可区分的对话模式；不确定性策略的优势不在于改变立场程度，而在于维持对话参与质量。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地被部署为人工道德顾问（AMA），但它们在对话中应展现何种对话模式尚不清楚。现有研究多关注AMA给出确定性建议，而真实道德困境往往需要"与不确定性共处"。论文旨在探讨AMA如何通过表达不确定性来帮助对话者应对道德困境。
AI.method: 设计了一个用户-代理LLM对话实验框架：一个用户代理LLM与一个遵循特定不确定性策略的AMA就道德困境进行对话。三种不确定性策略为：视角倍增（Perspective-Multiplying）、张力保持（Tension-Preserving）、过程反思（Process-Reflecting）；三种对照条件为：基线（Baseline）、说服性（Persuasive）、谄媚性（Sycophantic）。此外，操控了两种人格提示格式（声明式Declarative和叙事式Narrative）。参与者在对话前后填写问卷以测量立场变化。
AI.result: (1) 没有单一模型在所有维度上最优：开源模型通过人际分歧（between-persona divergence）体现人类模糊性，封闭模型通过人内模糊措辞（within-persona hedging）体现；(2) 声明式人格提示更好地捕捉初始立场多样性，叙事式人格提示展现更真实的信念修正过程；(3) 六种AMA策略均产生统计上可区分的对话模式；(4) 不同不确定性策略在立场修正量上没有显著差异，但在维持对话参与质量上存在差异。
AI.conclusion: AMA的不确定性表达策略的价值不在于促使对话者改变立场，而在于提升对话的参与质量和深度。这为设计更具伦理敏感性的AI对话系统提供了新的评估维度和设计原则。

title: Intercomparison of Machine Learning Algorithms for Remote Sensing-based In-season Crop Mapping
summary: In-season crop type mapping is critical for food security in the face of increasingly extreme climate-related threats to crops. Currently, the USDA Cropland Data Layer provides crop type labels at 30m resolution and is available the February after harvest, but no product exists that maps crop types before harvest with satisfactory accuracy that would allow emergency managers to respond to crop threats in near real time. Furthermore, the relative advantages of a wide range of algorithms have not been evaluated in a way that accounts for interannual variability, until this study. Here, Harmonized Landsat-Sentinel surface reflectance imagery time series and crop rotation history information are combined to map corn in Iowa and almonds in California at 30m resolution accurately by early June in unseen years, with robust quantification of uncertainty due to phenology and crop distribution. Thousands of model configurations across ten machine learning algorithms were compared using a year-wise cross-validation and a suite of metrics.
