Hyperparameter search revealed Support Vector Machines to be the most successful algorithm overall, with a mean F1 score of 0.74 (0.59) across five unseen validation years for almonds by early June in California (corn by early June in Iowa). Interannual variation was a large source of uncertainty, but patterns showed the potential to further improve performance with ensemble approaches or ancillary data. Future work may extend these methods to include multiclass maps of all crop types, CONUS-wide maps, and in-season crop yield forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了十种机器学习算法，结合Harmonized Landsat-Sentinel时序影像和作物轮作历史，在收获前（6月初）以30m分辨率准确制图玉米和杏仁，其中支持向量机表现最优。
AI.motivation: 当前USDA Cropland Data Layer虽提供30m分辨率作物类型标签，但需等到收获后的次年2月才发布。缺乏一种在收获前即可实现高精度作物类型制图的产品，以满足应急管理者对作物威胁的近实时响应需求。此外，已有算法在考虑年际变异下的相对优势尚未得到系统评估。
AI.method: 利用Harmonized Landsat-Sentinel地表反射率时序影像，结合作物轮作历史信息，在十种机器学习算法上进行数千种模型配置。采用逐年交叉验证（year-wise cross-validation）和一套多指标评估体系进行对比，并对物候和作物分布带来的不确定性进行量化。
AI.result: 支持向量机（SVM）综合表现最佳：加州杏仁在6月初的五年未见验证年上平均F1得分为0.74，爱荷华州玉米为0.59。年际变异是不确定性的主要来源，但模式显示集成方法或辅助数据有进一步提升性能的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 在收获前实现高精度作物类型制图是可行的，SVM是当前最稳健的算法。未来可扩展至多类作物全类型制图、美国本土全覆盖制图以及当季作物产量预测。

title: Entropy-Based Evaluation of AI Agents: A Lightweight Framework for Measuring Behavioral Patterns
summary: AI agents are commonly evaluated using task success, reward, latency, and cost. These metrics are useful, but they often miss important aspects of agent behavior: whether an agent explores too much, repeats itself too rigidly, uses tools effectively, reduces uncertainty over time, or remains robust across repeated runs. This paper proposes Entropy-Based Evaluation of AI Agents (EEA), a lightweight framework for measuring agent behavior through entropy. Rather than treating intelligence as only final task completion, EEA studies the structure of the agents decision process. The framework introduces action entropy, trajectory entropy, tool entropy, information gain, exploration efficiency, and robustness entropy. These metrics are intended to complement, not replace, traditional evaluation methods. We also present a practical Python implementation designed to integrate with agent frameworks such as LangChain, Google ADK, custom agent loops, and stored observability traces.

AI.tldr: 提出基于熵的AI Agent评估框架EEA，通过动作熵、轨迹熵、工具熵、信息增益、探索效率和鲁棒性熵六项指标，从决策过程结构角度补充传统仅关注任务完成的评估方式。
AI.motivation: 传统AI Agent评估指标（任务成功率、奖励、延迟、成本）忽略了智能体行为的关键方面：是否过度探索、是否僵化重复、工具使用效率、不确定性随时间的变化、以及多次运行的鲁棒性。需要一种轻量级框架来捕捉这些决策过程的深层结构。
AI.method: 提出EEA（Entropy-Based Evaluation）框架，定义六种基于信息论的熵指标：动作熵（action entropy）衡量动作选择的多样性，轨迹熵（trajectory entropy）衡量行为路径的分布，工具熵（tool entropy）衡量工具使用的合理性，信息增益（information gain）衡量不确定性随时间的消减，探索效率（exploration efficiency）衡量探索行为的有效性，鲁棒性熵（robustness entropy）衡量多次运行的稳定性。提供Python实现，可集成LangChain、Google ADK、自定义Agent循环及存储的可观测性追踪。
AI.result: 该框架为Agent行为分析提供了可量化的熵指标，能够揭示传统评估方法遗漏的行为模式，并以轻量级Python实现支持主流Agent框架的集成。
AI.conclusion: EEA框架通过信息论视角补充了AI Agent评估体系，强调评估应关注决策过程结构而非仅最终结果，为Agent行为诊断和优化提供了新工具。

title: MemoryCard: Topic-Aware Multi-Modal Clue Compression for Long-Video Question Answering
summary: Long-video question answering remains challenging for Vision-Language Models (VLMs), as answer-relevant evidence is often sparse, transient, and temporally dispersed across lengthy video contexts. Existing frame-centric approaches improve efficiency through uniform sampling, query-aware frame selection, visual-token compression, and adaptive resolution strategies. However, they still rely on isolated and fragmented frames as the fundamental evidence units, limiting VLMs' ability to effectively capture coherent event-level semantics. To address this limitation, we propose MemoryCard, a video-memory-based augmentation framework that organizes long videos into self-contained Memory Cards. Specifically, MemoryCard first performs a self-reading process over videos and aligned utterances to segment the video into semantically coherent units, each corresponding to a distinct topic or event. For each unit, it generates an event-level video gist and selects representative visual moments, which are then rendered into unified Memory Cards for retrieval and question answering. Experimental results demonstrate that MemoryCard consistently improves long-video QA performance under comparable visual-token budgets, achieving up to a 21.8% relative improvement in accuracy. All code is available at https://github.com/NEUIR/MemoryCard.

AI.tldr: MemoryCard 提出一种基于视频记忆的增强框架，通过将长视频组织成语义连贯的"记忆卡"单元来替代传统孤立帧作为证据单元，从而提升 VLM 在长视频问答中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有帧中心方法（均匀采样、查询感知帧选择、视觉 token 压缩、自适应分辨率）仍以孤立、碎片化的帧作为基本证据单元，导致 VLM 难以有效捕获连贯的事件级语义。长视频中答案相关证据往往稀疏、短暂且时间上分散，亟需更高层级的语义组织方式。
AI.method: MemoryCard 框架包含两个阶段：(1) 自阅读过程（self-reading）：对视频及其对齐的语音文本进行分析，将视频分割成语义连贯的单元，每个单元对应一个主题或事件；(2) 记忆卡生成：为每个单元生成事件级视频概要（video gist），并选取代表性视觉时刻，统一渲染为 Memory Card，用于后续检索和问答。
AI.result: 在可比视觉 token 预算下，MemoryCard 持续提升长视频 QA 性能，准确率相对提升最高达 21.8%。
AI.conclusion: MemoryCard 通过事件级语义组织有效克服了帧中心方法的碎片化局限，证明了以语义连贯单元作为证据基础的策略在长视频理解任务中的显著优势。

title: EMBER: Efficient Memory via Budgeted Evidence Retention for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Long-horizon agents can archive large histories, but future answers still incur retrieval, rereading, and context costs. When retained memory misses answer-relevant evidence, the system must return to larger portions of the raw history. We study budgeted evidence survival: before the query is known, which source evidence should be retained so that it remains recoverable and usable under a fixed retained source-evidence token budget? We instantiate this setting as Budgeted Pre-Query Retention, where memory is written during ingestion and later read without access to the full raw stream. We introduce EMBER, a learned retention policy that constructs a compact, source-backed evidence state. EMBER stores evidence capsules: verbatim source excerpts paired with retrieval keys and update metadata, preserving both grounding and read-time access. Post-query outcome feedback trains the writer to preserve evidence across the ingestion-retrieval-answer chain. On LongMemEval-RR, our LongMemEval-derived retained-evidence protocol, EMBER-14B reaches 0.3017 F1 at the 8192-token retained-evidence comparison point, compared with 0.1765 for the strongest non-EMBER budgeted baseline. Across retained source-evidence budgets, EMBER improves F1, Retain-Recall, and Read-Recall, indicating that long-horizon memory depends on retaining evidence within the budget rather than rereading larger histories.

AI.tldr: 提出EMBER，一种在查询未知前按固定token预算选择性地保留源证据的学习型保留策略，以证据胶囊形式存储原文摘录及其检索键，在LongMemEval-RR上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 长程智能体面临检索、重读和上下文成本问题；当保留的记忆缺失关键证据时，系统必须回溯大量原始历史。核心问题：在未知查询条件下，如何在固定源证据token预算内选择保留哪些证据以最大化其可恢复性与可用性。
AI.method: 提出Budgeted Pre-Query Retention设定，并设计EMBER框架：(1)系统在摄入阶段写入记忆，读取时不再访问完整原始流；(2)存储"证据胶囊"——逐字源摘录、检索键和更新元数据的组合，兼顾证据根基与读取时访问效率；(3)利用查询后结果反馈端到端训练写入策略，优化摄入-检索-答案全链路中的证据保留。
AI.result: 在LongMemEval-RR的8192 token保留证据对比点上，EMBER-14B达到0.3017 F1，而最强非EMBER预算基线仅0.1765 F1。在不同保留证据预算下，EMBER在F1、Retain-Recall和Read-Recall上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 长程记忆的有效性取决于在预算内保留关键证据的能力，而非简单地重读更大规模的历史。EMBER通过预算约束下的证据保留策略实现了更优的记忆利用。

title: QCFuse: Query-Aware Cache Fusion via Compressed View for Efficient RAG Serving
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves large language model (LLM) answer quality by grounding generation in external evidence, but processing retrieved contexts makes the prefill stage a dominant serving cost. RAG cache fusion reduces this cost by reusing precomputed key-value (KV) caches for retrieved chunks and selectively recomputing tokens under the current prompt. Existing selectors, however, face a dilemma between quality and efficiency: fast query-agnostic or final-layer query-to-context selectors can miss request-relevant evidence, whereas full-view query-aware selectors require broad context and layer visibility before recomputation and therefore stall the layer-wise cache-fusion pipeline. We present QCFuse, a compressed-view query-aware selector for RAG cache fusion. QCFuse uses chunk-anchor query probing to condition user-query states on compact per-chunk anchors and critical-layer profiling to identify recomputation tokens without all-layer inspection. We implement QCFuse in SGLang and evaluate it on four open-weight LLMs across six datasets. QCFuse reaches full-prefill-level quality. At matched quality, QCFuse achieves an average prefill-time speedup of 1.7x over full prefill and 1.5x over ProphetKV, the strongest quality-preserving baseline.

AI.tldr: QCFuse 提出了一种压缩视角的查询感知选择器，通过块锚查询探测和关键层分析，在 RAG 缓存融合中实现高质量与高效率的平衡，相比完整预填充和 ProphetKV 分别取得 1.7 倍和 1.5 倍加速。
AI.motivation: 现有 RAG 缓存融合的选择器面临质量与效率的两难：查询无关或仅用最终层的选择器可能遗漏相关证据，而全视角查询感知选择器需要检查所有层和上下文，阻塞了逐层缓存融合流水线。
AI.method: QCFuse 包含两个核心机制：(1) 块锚查询探测（chunk-anchor query probing），将用户查询状态压缩到每个块的锚点上进行条件化；(2) 关键层分析（critical-layer profiling），无需检查所有层即可识别需要重计算的 token。
AI.result: 在四个开源 LLM 和六个数据集上评估，QCFuse 达到完整预填充级别的质量。在同等质量下，预填充时间平均加速：比完整预填充快 1.7 倍，比 ProphetKV（最强保质量基线）快 1.5 倍。
AI.conclusion: QCFuse 成功解决了 RAG 缓存融合中选择器的质量-效率困境，通过压缩视角设计实现了既保持回答质量又显著降低预填充延迟的目标。

title: Faithful, Enriched, and Precise: Benchmarking Natural-Science Illustration Generation by T2I models
summary: Scientific illustrations are essential tools for communicating research findings, especially in natural science, where they visualize complex concepts and processes. As Text-to-Image (T2I) models become increasingly capable, researchers have started to use them for scientific illustration generation. However, existing benchmarks often assess outputs at a holistic level, overlooking fine-grained elements, while scientific reasoning ability and output conciseness remain under-quantified. We introduce FEPBench, a benchmark built from carefully selected high-quality scientific illustrations across multiple disciplines and layout types. With the assistance of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and human experts, we provide fine-grained atom set annotations and systematically evaluate T2I models along three dimensions: instruction faithfulness, reasoning enrichment, and semantic precision. Our evaluation further decomposes model performance across visual, textual, relation, and layout elements. Results show that even state-of-the-art (SOTA) closed-source models, such as GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana Pro, still suffer from text-rendering bottlenecks, limited reasoning enrichment, and difficulty balancing generation richness with precision. These findings provide practical guidance for improving and deploying T2I models in scientific illustration generation. Benchmark data, atom set annotations, and evaluation code will be released by us.

AI.tldr: FEPBench是一个针对科学插图生成的细粒度评估基准，从指令忠实度、推理丰富度和语义精度三个维度系统评估T2I模型，发现即使SOTA模型仍存在文本渲染、推理能力和丰富度-精度平衡等问题。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I评估基准多采用整体性评估，忽略细粒度元素分析，且对科学推理能力和输出简洁性的量化不足；科学插图需要精确呈现视觉、文本、关系和布局等多类元素，急需一个精细化、多维度的评估框架。
AI.method: 构建FEPBench基准：从多学科、多布局类型中精选高质量科学插图；借助多模态大语言模型（MLLM）与人类专家协作，提供细粒度原子集（atom set）标注；从指令忠实度（instruction faithfulness）、推理丰富度（reasoning enrichment）和语义精度（semantic precision）三个维度，分解为视觉、文本、关系和布局四类元素进行评估。
AI.result: 即使GPT Image 2和Nano Banana Pro等SOTA闭源模型，仍面临文本渲染瓶颈、推理丰富度有限、难以平衡生成丰富性与精度等问题。
AI.conclusion: 当前T2I模型在科学插图生成任务中仍有显著不足，FEPBench为模型改进和实际部署提供了细粒度的诊断工具和实用指导。

title: Representing Research Attention as Contextually Structured Flows
comment: Accepted at STi 2026 - International Conference on Science and Technology Indicators
summary: Research attention is widely used as an indicator of visibility, influence, and societal uptake, yet it is typically represented as aggregated counts that do not preserve how attention develops across contexts over time. This creates a mismatch between how attention is interpreted and how it is represented. We propose attention flows as contextually structured representations that encode the organisation of attention and its evolution over time. We evaluate whether these representations capture transferable structure by constructing a benchmark based on analogy-style reasoning across research outputs. Comparing signal, sequence, and flow-based representations, we find that flow representations more effectively support structural comparison, particularly in settings where attention is shaped by temporal progression or context distributions. We further show that learned flow representations improve robustness under partial observation and structural perturbation. Overall, these results support modelling attention as a contextually structured phenomenon and provide a basis for more informative approaches to research evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"注意力流"（attention flows）作为学术关注度的上下文结构化表征，能编码注意力在时间和情境中的组织与演化。通过类比推理基准测试，发现流表征比信号和序列表征更擅长结构比较，且对部分观测和结构扰动更鲁棒，为科研评价提供了新方法。
AI.motivation: 当前学术关注度（如引用、提及等）多以聚合计数形式呈现，丢失了注意力如何跨情境、随时间发展的结构信息。这种表征方式与对注意力的解释之间存在不匹配，需要一种能保留注意力上下文结构与演化过程的表征方法。
AI.method: 提出"注意力流"（attention flows）——一种上下文结构化的表征方式，编码注意力的组织及其时间演化。构建基于类比推理的基准测试，系统比较信号（signal）、序列（sequence）和流（flow）三种表征在跨研究成果结构比较中的表现，并评估流表征在部分观测和结构扰动下的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 流表征在结构性比较任务中显著优于信号和序列表征，尤其在注意力受时间进程或上下文分布影响时优势明显。此外，学习得到的流表征在部分观测和结构扰动条件下表现出更好的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 注意力应被建模为一种上下文结构化现象，注意力流表征为科研评价提供了更具信息量的方法基础，有助于推动从简单计数向结构感知的评估范式转变。

title: Beyond Soft Masks: Hard-Perturbation Mixup Explainer for Robust GNN Explainability
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have demonstrated remarkable performance across a range of applications involving graph-structured data, particularly in high-stakes domains. However, the opaque nature of their decision-making processes limits their trustworthiness and broader adoption. Existing post-hoc explanation methods aim to improve explainability by identifying subgraphs that influence GNN predictions and adopt mixup strategies to alleviate the out-of-distribution (OOD) issue caused by using subgraphs for prediction. Yet, these approaches typically rely on soft masks, which are inherently unable to fully eliminate label-irrelevant information, allowing redundant structures to leak into the mixup process and hindering the resolution of the OOD problem, thereby degrading explanation fidelity. In this work, we propose HPME, a Hard-Perturbation Mixup Explanation framework grounded in a generalized Graph Information Bottleneck, which leverages graph pooling to extract discrete explanatory subgraphs and to yield an information-capacity bound to thoroughly compress label-irrelevant components. Furthermore, we introduce a novel mixup strategy built upon structure-level replacement, generating in-distribution explanations to effectively mitigate the distribution shift. Extensive experiments on diverse tasks demonstrate that HPME achieves state-of-the-art performance in generating robust and interpretable explanations across both synthetic and real-world datasets.

AI.tldr: HPME 是一种基于硬扰动混合增强的解释框架，利用图池化提取离散解释子图，并通过结构级替换的混合策略生成分布内解释，有效压缩标签无关信息并缓解分布偏移，在合成和真实数据集上均达到最优解释性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 GNN 事后解释方法采用软掩码和混合策略来缓解分布外（OOD）问题，但软掩码无法完全消除标签无关信息，导致冗余结构泄漏到混合过程中，阻碍 OOD 问题的解决，从而降低解释保真度。
AI.method: 提出 HPME（Hard-Perturbation Mixup Explanation）框架：(1) 基于广义图信息瓶颈，利用图池化提取离散解释子图，并获得信息容量界以彻底压缩标签无关成分；(2) 引入基于结构级替换的新型混合策略，生成分布内解释以有效缓解分布偏移。
AI.result: 在多种任务上的大量实验表明，HPME 在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上均达到了最先进的解释性能，生成了鲁棒且可解释的解释结果。
AI.conclusion: HPME 通过离散硬掩码和结构级混合策略，有效解决了软掩码方法中标签无关信息残留和 OOD 问题，显著提升了 GNN 解释的保真度和鲁棒性，为高可靠性领域的 GNN 应用提供了更可信的解释方案。

title: Retry Policy Gradients in Continuous Action Spaces
summary: Retry-based objectives such as pass@K and max@K optimize the best return obtained from multiple sampled trajectories, and recent work has shown that they can promote exploration without explicit exploration bonuses. In discrete action spaces, ReMax was shown to do so by adapting to return uncertainty. In this work, we introduce pathwise derivative estimators for retry objectives and use them to extend ReMax to continuous action spaces. We study the resulting learning dynamics and show that, even with deterministic rewards, ReMax can encourage stochastic exploration by reshaping the policy-gradient landscape. In particular, it alters gradients both in direction, biasing updates toward higher policy entropy, and in magnitude, damping gradients and slowing convergence. We further show that Adam's adaptive normalization can mitigate this damping, depending on its numerical stabilization parameter. Empirically, we instantiate this objective as ReMax Actor-Critic (ReMAC), an off-policy actor--critic algorithm that optimizes the ReMax objective using a pathwise derivative estimator. Our experiments show that ReMAC can promote higher policy entropy without entropy regularization and achieves performance comparable to SAC.

AI.tldr: 本文引入针对retry目标（pass@K/max@K）的路径导数估计器，将ReMax算法从离散动作空间扩展到连续动作空间，提出ReMAC算法。研究表明，即使在确定性奖励下，ReMax也能通过重塑策略梯度景观来鼓励随机探索，且无需熵正则化即可达到与SAC相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 基于重试的目标（如pass@K和max@K）在离散动作空间中已被证明能通过适应回报不确定性来促进探索（如ReMax算法），但如何将其扩展到连续动作空间仍是一个未解决的问题。此外，需要深入理解这类目标在连续控制场景下的学习动力学特性。
AI.method: 作者首先为retry目标引入了路径导数估计器（pathwise derivative estimators），将ReMax扩展到连续动作空间。然后分析了由此产生的学习动力学，揭示了ReMax如何改变策略梯度景观：在方向上偏向更高策略熵，在幅度上阻尼梯度并减缓收敛。此外，还分析了Adam优化器的自适应归一化如何通过其数值稳定化参数缓解这种阻尼效应。最终，作者将这一目标实例化为ReMAC（ReMax Actor-Critic），一种基于路径导数估计器的离策略actor-critic算法。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，ReMax通过同时改变梯度方向和幅度来鼓励随机探索。实证结果表明，ReMAC能够在无熵正则化的情况下促进更高的策略熵，并在连续控制任务上取得与SAC相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: ReMax目标可以通过路径导数估计器成功扩展至连续动作空间，ReMAC算法在无需显式熵正则化的情况下天然具备探索能力，为连续控制中的探索问题提供了新的思路。

title: T-FunS3D: Task-Driven Hierarchical Open-Vocabulary 3D Functionality Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D functionality segmentation enables robots to localize functional object components in 3D scenes. It is a challenging task that requires spatial understanding and task interpretation. Current open-vocabulary 3D segmentation methods primarily focus on object-level recognition, while scene-wide part segmentation methods attempt to segment the entire scene exhaustively, making them highly resource-intensive and time consuming. Balancing segmentation performance in terms of granularity, accuracy, and speed remains a challenge. As one step towards alleviating this, we introduce T-FunS3D, a task-driven hierarchical open-vocabulary 3D functionality segmentation method that provides actionable perception for robotic applications. Our method takes as input the 3D point cloud and posed RGB-D images of an indoor scene. We construct an open-vocabulary scene graph by extracting instances and their visual embeddings in the environment. Given a task description, T-FunS3D identifies the most relevant instances in the scene graph and locates their functional components leveraging a vision-language model. Experiments on the SceneFun3D dataset demonstrate that T-FunS3D is comparable to state-of-the-art in open-vocabulary 3D functionality segmentation, while achieving faster runtime and reduced memory usage.

AI.tldr: T-FunS3D 是一种任务驱动的分层开放词汇3D功能分割方法，通过场景图与视觉语言模型实现高效、精准的功能性部件定位，在SceneFun3D数据集上达到与SOTA相当的性能，同时运行更快、内存更低。
AI.motivation: 当前开放词汇3D分割方法要么停留在物体级识别，要么进行全场景穷举式部件分割，后者资源消耗大、耗时长。如何在分割粒度、精度和速度之间取得平衡，是亟待解决的问题。
AI.method: T-FunS3D以室内场景的3D点云和带位姿的RGB-D图像为输入，首先提取实例及其视觉嵌入构建开放词汇场景图；然后根据任务描述，在场景图中识别最相关的实例，并借助视觉语言模型定位其功能部件。
AI.result: 在SceneFun3D数据集上的实验表明，T-FunS3D在开放词汇3D功能分割上达到与当前最先进方法可比的性能，同时实现了更快的运行速度和更低的内存占用。
AI.conclusion: T-FunS3D通过任务驱动的分层策略，有效缓解了分割粒度、精度与速度之间的权衡难题，为机器人应用提供了可操作的感知能力。

title: Reducing Hallucinations in Complex Question Answering using Simple Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (long version)
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) have fundamentally transformed the landscape of Natural Language Processing. Despite these advances, LLMs and LLM-based systems remain prone to a variety of failure modes. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems have emerged as a common deployment scenario seeking to both avoid the well known risk of the LLM "hallucinating" information, and to enable reasoning and question answering over proprietary information that the LLM did not have access to during training without resorting to expensive model fine-tuning.
  In this work, we explore the idea of using a lightweight graph structure with a relatively simple graph schema, to support the RAG subsystem via a dedicated toolset. We design an agentic system with a variety of vector search and graph query tools operating over a structured dataset based on a curated subset of English Wikipedia articles, and evaluate its performance on questions from MoNaCo, a challenging Wikipedia QA benchmark of complex query answering tasks.
  Our results show that the introduction of graph-based tools can significantly increase the precision and recall of factual correctness, can halve the number of hallucinated answers, and achieves the highest fine-grained truthfulness score among the three evaluated scenarios. All this with a modest increase in token usage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在RAG系统中引入轻量级图结构与专用工具集（向量搜索+图查询），通过agentic系统在Wikipedia QA基准MoNaCo上进行评估。结果表明，基于图的工具显著提升了事实正确性的精确率和召回率，将幻觉回答数量减半，并在细粒度真实性评分上达到最优，且仅带来适度的token开销。
AI.motivation: LLM及其系统仍存在多种失效模式，RAG虽能缓解幻觉问题并支持对专有信息的推理问答，但仍有改进空间。本文旨在探索利用轻量级图结构增强RAG子系统，以进一步提升回答的事实正确性和真实性。
AI.method: 设计了一个agentic系统，配备多种向量搜索和图查询工具，运行在基于英文维基百科精选子集构建的结构化数据集上。图结构采用相对简单的图模式（graph schema），工具集同时支持向量检索和图结构遍历查询。在MoNaCo（一个具有挑战性的Wikipedia复杂问答基准）上进行评估，对比三种场景下的表现。
AI.result: 图工具的引入显著提升了精确率和召回率，幻觉回答数量减半，在细粒度真实性评分上取得最优结果，且token使用量仅适度增加。
AI.conclusion: 将轻量级图结构及其专用工具集成到RAG系统中，是一种低成本、高收益的策略，能有效提升回答的事实准确性并抑制幻觉，为RAG系统的进一步优化提供了有前景的方向。

title: Domain-Adapted Small Language Models with Hybrid Post-Processing: Achieving Cost-Efficient, Low-Latency Multi-Label Structured Prediction via LoRA Fine-Tuning on Scarce Data
summary:
Deploying frontier large language models (LLMs) for domain-specific structured evaluation tasks often incurs substantial latency, cost, and data privacy overhead. We present a hybrid framework that combines a fine-tuned small language model (LLaMA 3.1 8B, with only 2.05% trainable parameters via LoRA) and a deterministic rule-based post-processing layer. Trained on just 219 curated examples, the system is applied to multi-label compliance evaluation of conversational transcripts spanning 18 heterogeneous output fields. In blind evaluation on 53 previously unseen production transcripts, it achieves 100% JSON structural validity, 83.0% human-validated overall accuracy, and 100% accuracy on the most critical classification field. The proposed approach formalizes a hybrid neural-symbolic decomposition and introduces targeted hard-negative augmentation to improve performance on critical decision boundaries. Running on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU, inference completes in approximately 2 seconds, which is 2-5x faster than frontier-model APIs. The system costs only $0.013 per evaluation compared with $0.025-$0.055 for proprietary alternatives, resulting in 46-76% cost savings. These results demonstrate that domain-adapted small language models, when combined with deterministic post-processing, can match frontier-model accuracy for structured compliance evaluation while substantially reducing operational cost, latency, and privacy risk.
  Keywords: small language models, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, LoRA, domain adaptation, hybrid inference, compliance evaluation, structured output.

AI.tldr: 一种混合框架将经过LoRA微调的小语言模型（LLaMA 3.1 8B，仅2.05%可训练参数）与确定性规则后处理层结合，仅用219条训练样本即可实现对话合规性评估，在53条未见样本上达到83%总体准确率和100%关键字段准确率，推理速度比前沿模型API快2-5倍，成本降低46-76%。
AI.motivation: 在特定领域的结构化评估任务中，部署前沿大语言模型存在显著延迟、成本和数据隐私开销。需要一种在保持高准确率的同时，大幅降低运营成本、推理延迟和隐私风险的方法。
AI.method: 提出神经-符号混合框架：(1) 使用LoRA对LLaMA 3.1 8B进行参数高效微调，仅训练2.05%参数；(2) 仅使用219条精心筛选的样本训练；(3) 引入针对性困难负样本增强策略，改善关键决策边界性能；(4) 后接确定性规则后处理层，确保结构化输出的有效性和一致性。任务为对话转录文本的18个异构输出字段的多标签合规性评估。
AI.result: 在53条未见的真实对话转录盲测中：(1) JSON结构有效性达100%；(2) 人工验证总体准确率83.0%；(3) 最关键分类字段准确率100%；(4) 单张A100 GPU推理约2秒完成，比前沿模型API快2-5倍；(5) 每次评估成本仅$0.013，相比商业方案$0.025-$0.055节省46-76%。
AI.conclusion: 领域适配的小语言模型结合确定性后处理，可在结构化合规评估任务上匹敌前沿大模型准确率，同时大幅降低运营成本、延迟和隐私风险。神经-符号分解策略和困难负样本增强设计是关键使能因素。

title: Retrospective Harness Optimization: Improving LLM Agents via Self-Preference over Trajectory Rollouts
summary: AI agents rely on a harness of skills, tools, and workflows to solve complex problems. Continually improving this harness is essential for adapting to new tasks. However, existing optimization methods typically require ground-truth validation sets, yet such labeled data is difficult to acquire in practical deployment settings. To address this problem, we introduce Retrospective Harness Optimization (RHO), a self-supervised method that optimizes the agent harness using only past trajectories. Specifically, RHO selects a diverse coreset of challenging tasks from past trajectories and re-solves them in parallel. The agent analyzes these rollouts using self-validation and self-consistency, then generates candidate harness updates and selects the most effective one by its own pairwise self-preference. We evaluate RHO across three diverse domains, spanning software engineering, technical work, and knowledge work. Notably, a single optimization round improves the pass rate on SWE-Bench Pro from 59% to 78% without any external grading. Furthermore, our analysis demonstrates that RHO effectively targets prior failure modes. As a result, the optimized harness alters the agent's behavior patterns and sustains higher accuracy during long-horizon sessions.

AI.tldr: RHO 是一种自监督方法，仅利用历史轨迹即可优化 AI 智能体的技能/工具/工作流组合，无需人工标注的验证集。在 SWE-Bench Pro 上，单轮优化将通过率从 59% 提升至 78%。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体 harness（技能、工具、工作流的集合）的优化方法依赖于真实标注的验证集，但在实际部署中获取此类标注数据非常困难，需要一个无需外部监督的优化方案。
AI.method: RHO 包含三个核心步骤：(1) 从历史轨迹中筛选多样化且具挑战性的任务构成核心集，并行重新求解；(2) 利用自验证（self-validation）和自一致性（self-consistency）分析新 rollout；(3) 生成候选 harness 更新方案，并通过智能体自身的成对自偏好（pairwise self-preference）选出最优更新。
AI.result: 在软件工程、技术工作和知识工作三个领域验证了有效性。SWE-Bench Pro 上单轮优化将通过率从 59% 提升至 78%，全程无需外部评分。分析表明 RHO 能有效针对先前的失败模式，改变智能体行为模式，并在长会话中维持更高准确率。
AI.conclusion: RHO 证明了仅利用历史轨迹即可实现有效的 harness 自监督优化，为 AI 智能体在实际部署中的持续自我改进提供了可行路径。

title: Video-Rate Streaming Stylization on a Vision-Aware MLLM-Conditioned Edit Diffusion: Asymmetric Batched Inference on a Distilled UNet + MLLM Text Encoder
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Under review at IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology. Code, evaluation harness, and the released v3 Temporal LLLite adapter weights are at https://github.com/otanl/dreamlite-stream (also mirrored to Hugging Face and Zenodo)
summary: Aggressive distillation of the diffusion U-Net inverts the per-frame bottleneck of real-time text-to-image pipelines: once the denoiser is a 4-step or 1-step distilled student, the text encoder becomes the critical path. This inversion is most acute in vision-aware edit diffusion, where the encoder is a multimodal large language model (MLLM). We study the case of a 0.39B distilled edit U-Net paired with a 2.13B MLLM text encoder (Qwen3-VL) and present a streaming pipeline targeted at this regime built around three engineering mechanisms: asymmetric side-stream / main-stream CUDA pipelining with batched text-encoder amortisation (and optional static-prompt caching), a compile-friendly ControlNet-LLLite reformulation that folds the entire U-Net + adapter stack into a single fused graph, and a periodic conditioning-refresh schedule with a hook subset that amortises the per-frame conditioning cost. On a single consumer RTX 3090 Ti at 512x512 the pipeline sustains 27.4 fps over a 480-frame run at batch size B=8 and 29.6 fps at B=16, with end-to-end p50 latency of approximately 0.5 and 1.0 seconds respectively; the same operating point measures 54.9 fps on RTX 4090 and 74.1 fps on RTX 5090. We report video-rate streaming throughput rather than interactive low latency, and locate our numbers against same-stack StreamDiffusion re-runs as systems context, not as a benchmark superiority claim. For the trained oil-painting style, the released temporal adapter generalises within in-clip noise to 19 unused DAVIS-2017 sequences and 15 non-DAVIS clips from seven sources; prompt-level generalisation to unseen style families is bounded and reported separately.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向实时文本到图像流式生成的工程优化管线，核心在于解决当扩散U-Net被蒸馏至极低步数（1步或4步）后，文本编码器（尤其是多模态大语言模型MLLM）成为瓶颈的问题。通过非对称CUDA流水线、编译友好的ControlNet-LLLite重构以及周期性条件刷新调度三大机制，在消费级GPU上实现了视频级流式吞吐。
AI.motivation: 在实时文本到图像合成中，扩散U-Net经过激进蒸馏（如4步或1步）后，去噪推理不再是瓶颈，取而代之的是文本编码器成为关键路径。这在视觉感知编辑扩散中尤为突出，因为编码器是计算量大的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）。本文旨在解决该场景下MLLM文本编码器（如2.13B的Qwen3-VL）与轻量蒸馏U-Net（0.39B）配对时的流式推理瓶颈问题。
AI.method: 提出三大工程机制：(1) 非对称侧流/主流CUDA流水线，结合批量文本编码器摊销和可选静态提示缓存；(2) 编译友好的ControlNet-LLLite重构，将整个U-Net与适配器栈折叠为单一融合计算图；(3) 周期性条件刷新调度，通过hook子集摊销每帧条件计算开销。系统面向0.39B蒸馏编辑U-Net + 2.13B Qwen3-VL MLLM编码器的组合进行优化。
AI.result: 在单张RTX 3090 Ti上，512×512分辨率下：batch size B=8时持续480帧达27.4 fps（端到端p50延迟约0.5秒），B=16时达29.6 fps（延迟约1.0秒）。RTX 4090上同配置达54.9 fps，RTX 5090上达74.1 fps。训练所得油画风格的时间适配器在域内噪声下泛化至19个未使用DAVIS-2017序列和15个非DAVIS片段，但对未见风格族的提示级泛化能力有限。
AI.conclusion: 当扩散U-Net被蒸馏至极低步数后，文本编码器成为实时流式生成的瓶颈，尤其在使用MLLM的视觉感知编辑场景中。本文的流式管线通过CUDA流水线、图融合和条件刷新调度有效解决了这一问题，在消费级GPU上实现了视频速率吞吐，为实时AI视频编辑提供了工程参考。时间适配器的风格泛化主要体现在域内噪声鲁棒性，跨风格族泛化仍受限。

title: ACE-SQL: Adaptive Co-Optimization via Empirical Credit Assignment for Text-to-SQL
summary: Text-to-SQL maps natural language questions to executable SQL queries. Modern databases often contain large and complex schemas, making schema linking a critical step for accurate SQL generation. Existing methods either rely on full-schema generation, which leaves schema linking implicit within a large search space, or use a separate retriever trained with static gold-column supervision, whose targets may be suboptimal for the current generator policy. To address this issue, we propose Adaptive Co-optimization via Empirical Credit Assignment for Text-to-SQL (ACE-SQL), a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that jointly optimizes schema retrieval and SQL generation under execution feedback. ACE-SQL constructs an online column-set pool from generator rollouts and derives adaptive on-policy retrieval targets from the column set most frequently associated with execution-correct rollouts. This induces bidirectional adaptation, where the retriever adapts toward column sets that the generator can execute correctly, while the generator adapts to the retriever's evolving schema selections under execution feedback. With approximately 3k synthetic Text-to-SQL question-database pairs for RL training, ACE-SQL achieves 65.3% greedy execution accuracy on BIRD Dev while using 0.93k output tokens per query. The repository is available at https://github.com/xbchen1/ACE-SQL.

AI.tldr: ACE-SQL 是一个强化学习框架，通过执行反馈联合优化 Text-to-SQL 中的 schema 检索和 SQL 生成，利用在线 rollout 构建自适应检索目标，在 BIRD Dev 上达到 65.3% 的执行准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么依赖全 schema 生成（隐式 schema linking，搜索空间过大），要么使用静态金标列监督训练独立检索器（目标可能与当前生成器策略不匹配）。因此需要一种能够使检索器和生成器在执行反馈下双向适应的联合优化方法。
AI.method: 提出 ACE-SQL 框架：1）从生成器 rollout 中构建在线列集池；2）基于执行正确的 rollout 中最频繁出现的列集，推导出自适应的 on-policy 检索目标；3）在 RL 框架下，检索器向生成器能正确执行的列集方向适应，生成器则适应检索器不断演化的 schema 选择，实现双向协同优化。使用约 3k 合成数据训练。
AI.result: 在 BIRD Dev 上达到 65.3% 的 greedy 执行准确率，每个查询平均输出 0.93k tokens。训练仅需约 3000 条合成 Text-to-SQL 问答数据库对。
AI.conclusion: ACE-SQL 证明通过执行反馈驱动的经验信用分配实现检索器与生成器的双向协同优化是有效的，在保持较低输出 token 量的同时取得了有竞争力的执行准确率。

title: Towards World Models in Biomedical Research
summary: A central goal of biomedicine is to understand, predict and ultimately control the dynamic mechanisms by which biological systems respond to perturbations, disease progression and therapeutic intervention. Although foundation models and large language models have accelerated biomedical data interpretation, most current systems remain focused on static pattern recognition rather than prospective simulation of biological futures. Here we propose biomedical world models as a paradigm for AI-driven discovery. These models learn latent representations of molecular, cellular, tissue and clinical states, together with intervention-conditioned dynamics that allow future trajectories to be simulated before actions are taken. We discuss how biomedical world models could function as data engines, environment simulators and scientific planning substrates across applications including virtual cells, organoids, virtual patients and surgical simulation. We outline the data infrastructure, evaluation benchmarks, safety constraints and governance frameworks required. Biomedical world models may provide a foundation for simulation-guided, closed-loop and experimentally actionable biomedical discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出生物医学世界模型（biomedical world models）作为AI驱动发现的新范式，通过学习分子、细胞、组织和临床状态的潜在表征及其干预条件下的动态演化，实现对生物系统未来轨迹的前瞻性模拟，以推动虚拟细胞、类器官、虚拟患者和手术模拟等应用。
AI.motivation: 当前生物医学领域的基础模型和大语言模型主要聚焦于静态模式识别，缺乏对生物系统在扰动、疾病进展和治疗干预下动态演化过程的前瞻性模拟能力。亟需一种能够预测生物系统未来状态的AI范式，以实现从被动分析到主动模拟的跨越。
AI.method: 提出生物医学世界模型框架：学习分子、细胞、组织、临床多层次状态的潜在表征，同时建模干预条件下的动力学，使得在实际干预前即可模拟未来轨迹。这些模型可充当数据引擎、环境模拟器和科学规划基座，服务于虚拟细胞、类器官、虚拟患者和手术模拟等场景。
AI.result: 该范式有望实现模拟引导的、闭环的、可实验验证的生物医学发现。论文同时规划了所需的数据基础设施、评估基准、安全约束和治理框架。
AI.conclusion: 生物医学世界模型有潜力成为模拟引导、闭环驱动且可直接对接实验的生物医学发现基础平台，标志着生物医学AI从静态识别向动态前瞻模拟的关键转型。

title: Multimodal Sexism Identification and Characterization using Large Language Models and Gradient Boosting
summary: We present the AILS-NTUA submission to the EXIST 2026 Lab at CLEF, addressing multimodal sexism identification and characterization in memes (Task 2) and short-form videos (Task 3). Our system follows a feature-engineered late-fusion pipeline built around gradient-boosted regression models and hierarchical post-processing. For memes, we combine visual, textual, demographic, biometric, and LLM-derived semantic indicators designed to capture high-level cues such as stereotyping, objectification, irony, and misogyny. For videos, we investigate the effect of feature selection, frame-based visual representations, OCR-based textual features, acoustic descriptors, and sensor-derived metadata. Development results show that focused LLM-derived semantic cues improve meme sexism identification, while video performance is highly sensitive to feature dimensionality and cross-modal noise. For videos, development results favor compact feature selection, but official test results show that this conclusion does not fully transfer to unseen data, where the unfiltered representation generalizes better. Overall, our findings highlight the usefulness of targeted semantic feature engineering for static memes and the need for more robust temporal modeling in noisy short-form video settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了AILS-NTUA团队在CLEF 2026 EXIST Lab中的参赛系统，针对多模态性别歧视识别任务（静态meme与短视频），采用基于梯度提升回归模型的特征工程晚期融合管线，结合层次化后处理。研究发现：针对性LLM语义特征对meme识别有益；视频任务对特征维度和跨模态噪声高度敏感，开发集上的特征选择优势未能完全泛化到测试集。
AI.motivation: 多模态性别歧视内容（包括meme和短视频）的自动识别与表征仍面临挑战。现有方法对高层语义线索（如刻板印象、物化、讽刺、厌女）的捕捉不足，且短视频场景下存在跨模态噪声和时序建模困难。该工作旨在探索特征工程驱动的晚期融合方案在这两类任务中的有效性。
AI.method: 系统采用基于特征工程的晚期融合管线，核心为梯度提升回归模型与层次化后处理。针对meme，融合视觉、文本、人口统计、生物识别及LLM衍生语义特征，以捕捉刻板印象、物化、讽刺和厌女等高层线索。针对短视频，研究特征选择、帧级视觉表示、OCR文本特征、声学描述符和传感器元数据的影响，并对比紧凑特征选择与未过滤全量特征的泛化能力。
AI.result: 开发集结果表明：聚焦的LLM语义线索能提升meme性别歧视识别性能；视频任务中，紧凑特征选择在开发集上表现更优，但官方测试集上未过滤的全量特征表达反而泛化更好，说明开发集结论未完全迁移到未见数据。
AI.conclusion: 针对静态meme，目标导向的语义特征工程具有显著价值；而在噪声较大的短视频场景中，需要更鲁棒的时序建模方法。特征选择策略的跨数据集泛化性仍是开放问题。

title: Better Literary Translation: A Multi-Aspect Data Generation and LLM Training Approach
summary: Literary translation poses unique challenges due to the scarcity of high-quality annotated data and the need to balance expression fluency with literary effect. We present a multi-aspect iterative refinement framework that generates high-quality translation references and preference data through specialized LLM translators, each targeting a distinct quality dimension. We leverage the generated data for supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Experiments show that our generated references outperform the original ground truth for SFT by 8.65 CEA100 points. For reinforcement learning, we find that DPO leads to performance degradation in this setting, while leveraging an explicit reward model for GRPO yields an additional 1.51 point improvement. We attribute this to the stability of two-stage training and GRPO's online exploration capability. Our resulting models, LitMT-8B and LitMT-14B, achieve 67.25 and 69.07 CEA100 respectively on the MetaphorTrans English-to-Chinese literary translation benchmark, competitive with Claude Sonnet 4.5 at 68.43, and demonstrate strong generalization to out-of-domain literary work (i.e., O. Henry).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多维度迭代精炼框架，通过专用LLM翻译器生成高质量翻译参考与偏好数据，用于监督微调和强化学习，在文学翻译基准上取得与Claude Sonnet 4.5相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 文学翻译面临两大核心挑战：一是高质量标注数据稀缺，二是需要在表达流畅性与文学效果之间取得平衡。现有方法难以同时满足这两方面需求，因此需要一种能够生成高质量训练数据并有效优化翻译模型的新框架。
AI.method: 提出多维度迭代精炼框架：(1) 部署多个专用LLM翻译器，每个翻译器针对一个特定的质量维度（如流畅性、文学性等），迭代生成高质量的翻译参考和偏好数据；(2) 利用生成的数据进行监督微调(SFT)；(3) 在SFT基础上进行强化学习优化，对比了DPO和基于显式奖励模型的GRPO两种方法，最终采用两阶段训练策略（SFT + GRPO）。
AI.result: 在MetaphorTrans英译中文学翻译基准上：(1) 生成的参考数据用于SFT，比原始ground truth高出8.65个CEA100点；(2) DPO导致性能下降，而GRPO带来额外1.51点提升；(3) 最终模型LitMT-8B和LitMT-14B分别达到67.25和69.07 CEA100，与Claude Sonnet 4.5（68.43）具有竞争力；(4) 在O. Henry等域外文学作品上展现出强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 多维度迭代精炼框架有效解决了文学翻译中标注数据稀缺的问题；两阶段训练（SFT+GRPO）的稳定性以及GRPO的在线探索能力是性能提升的关键；DPO在该场景下的退化现象值得关注；最终模型在域内和域外文学翻译上均表现优异。

title: CaliDist: Calibrating Large Language Models via Behavioral Robustness to Distraction
summary: Existing calibration methods for Large Language Models (LLMs) often overlook a critical dimension of trustworthiness: a model's {\em behavioral robustness} to irrelevant or misleading information. In this paper, we argue that a model's true confidence should reflect its stability under cognitive pressure. We introduce \textsc{CaliDist}, a novel post-hoc calibration approach that directly measures and penalizes a model's susceptibility to distraction. \textsc{CaliDist} quantifies how an LLM's predictions and uncertainty change when its input prompt is perturbed with semantic \textit{distractors}. This stability (or lack thereof) signal is then used to adaptively scale the model's initial confidence score. Our extensive experiments on seven Natural Language Understanding classification benchmarks using six distinct LLMs show that \textsc{CaliDist} consistently achieves lower Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and Brier Score compared with strong baselines. Remarkably, our method reduces the ECE from 23\% to 7\% on average--a relative improvement of 70\%--demonstrating that behavioral stability is a powerful signal for calibration. We make our code and datasets available at github.com/m-anas-j/CaliDist.

AI.tldr: CaliDist是一种新颖的事后校准方法，通过测量LLM在输入提示被语义干扰词扰动时的预测稳定性，并利用该稳定性信号自适应地缩放模型的置信度分数，从而在七个NLU分类基准上将平均ECE从23%降至7%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM校准方法忽略了一个关键的信任维度：模型对无关或误导性信息的行为稳健性。作者认为，模型的真实置信度应反映其在认知压力下的稳定性。
AI.method: 提出CaliDist方法：(1) 用语义干扰词（distractors）扰动输入提示；(2) 量化LLM预测和不确定性在扰动前后的变化，作为稳定性信号；(3) 利用该信号自适应缩放模型的初始置信度分数，实现事后校准。
AI.result: 在7个NLU分类基准和6种不同LLM上，CaliDist在期望校准误差（ECE）和Brier Score上均优于强基线方法。ECE从平均23%降至7%，相对改进70%。
AI.conclusion: 行为稳定性是模型校准的强大信号。CaliDist通过测量模型对语义干扰的鲁棒性来改进置信度估计，在多个基准上实现了显著且一致的校准性能提升。

title: A Pre-Registered Causal Partition of Self-Consistency Elicitation and Reward Design in RLVR
summary: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves reasoning even when the reward signal is spurious -- assigning credit to the group-plurality answer rather than a ground-truth verifier. Practitioners commonly interpret naive = acc(TRUE) - acc(RANDOM) as the reward-design effect. We prove this estimand is systematically biased: it conflates self-consistency elicitation (sharpening the policy toward its modal answer via majority pseudo-reward) with genuine reward-design signal. Using a controlled tabular-GRPO simulator we derive an exact telescoping decomposition total = null + elicit + rd and measure each term across five prior-strength levels. The reward-design fraction of the naive estimator ranges from 0.139 at weak prior (ps=0.20) to 0.05 at strong prior (ps=0.80), with the elicitation term flipping sign at the self-consistency crossover. A pre-registered 2x2x2 factorial confirms non-additivity (interaction ratio 0.385; AxC effect -0.089). A points-vs-bounds pilot gate shows strong-prior regimes are point-identified while near-crossover regimes are only bounded. Re-audits of two named published results yield ELICITATION DOMINATED (elicitation share 0.98) and REWARD DESIGN DOMINATED (rd share 1.18) verdicts respectively, demonstrating the diagnostic value of the partition. We pre-commit to submit regardless of flip outcome; a non-flip is a finding of equal standing. We release a reusable one-command harness for any alignment paper to run the same audit.

AI.tldr: 本文证明RLVR中常用的朴素估计量 naive = acc(TRUE) - acc(RANDOM) 存在系统性偏误，它混淆了自洽性引导效应与真正的奖励设计信号。作者通过表格化GRPO模拟器推导出精确的 telescoping 分解 total = null + elicit + rd，并提供了可复用的审计工具。
AI.motivation: 在强化学习可验证奖励（RLVR）范式中，即便使用虚假奖励信号（如群体多数答案而非真实标签），推理能力仍能提升。实践者普遍将 acc(TRUE) - acc(RANDOM) 解释为奖励设计效应，但该估计量的偏差性质和成分分解尚未被严格检验。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个受控的表格化 GRPO 模拟器，推导出精确的 telescoping 分解：total = null + elicit + rd。在五个先验强度水平上测量各项，并进行了预注册的 2×2×2 因子实验检验非可加性。通过 points-vs-bounds 方法分析不同先验区域的可识别性，最后对两篇已发表结果进行再审计以展示分解的诊断价值。
AI.result: 奖励设计项在朴素估计量中的占比从弱先验（ps=0.20）时的 0.139 到强先验（ps=0.80）时的 0.05，且 elicitation 项在自洽性交叉点附近翻转符号。因子实验确认非可加性（交互比 0.385；AxC 效应 -0.089）。强先验区域是点识别的，而近交叉点区域仅能被界定。两篇已发表结果的再审计分别给出"引导主导"（elicitation share 0.98）和"奖励设计主导"（rd share 1.18）的裁决。
AI.conclusion: 朴素估计量 naive = acc(TRUE) - acc(RANDOM) 不可靠，必须分解为自洽性引导效应和奖励设计效应才能正确归因。该分解框架为 RLVR 研究提供了关键的诊断工具，可避免将策略锐化误判为奖励设计的功劳。

title: Deep Learning-based 3D Oral Cavity Reconstruction Using 2D Intraoral Images
comment: 4 pages, 5 figures. English version of a paper presented at the Korea Multimedia Society Conference, November 2025
summary: Oral 3D modelling is one of the most essential stages in dentistry, and many different approaches, such as impression taking and intraoral scanning, are commonly used for this phase, each with notable limitations. Impression taking, which involves placing alginate or silicone material in a tray and inserting it into the patient's oral cavity to form a negative mold, suffers from significant patient discomfort, material deformation errors, and difficulties in storage and transportation. Intraoral scanners, which directly scan oral structures in real time using structured light or laser technology, produce state-of-the-art results but are associated with substantially high equipment costs. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a software-based approach that reconstructs a 3D oral model using only ten 2D intraoral images captured from different angles, requiring no dedicated hardware devices. The proposed method reduces cost, eliminates the need for physical scanning equipment, minimises patient discomfort, and enables automated 3D reconstruction. The model is trained on the publicly available Dental3DS dataset, comprising 950 upper jaw samples, and employs MobileNetV2 as the image encoder combined with Multi-head Attention for multi-view feature fusion. The proposed model achieves an accuracy of 77.49%, measured by nearest-neighbor matching with a distance threshold of 0.035. However, predicted vertices tend to concentrate in high-density regions of the ground truth, resulting in uneven point distribution across the reconstructed model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种仅需十张不同角度的2D口内照片、无需专用硬件的软件化3D口腔模型重建方法，采用MobileNetV2编码器结合多头注意力多视图融合，在Dental3DS数据集上达到77.49%的重建精度，但存在预测顶点向高密度区域集中的问题。
AI.motivation: 传统取模法存在患者不适、材料形变误差及储存运输困难等问题；口内扫描仪虽效果先进但设备成本高昂。因此需要一种低成本、低不适感且无需专用硬件的3D口腔建模替代方案。
AI.method: 使用仅十张不同角度的2D口内图像作为输入，无需专用硬件；以MobileNetV2作为图像编码器提取多视图特征，采用多头注意力（Multi-head Attention）机制进行多视图特征融合，实现从2D图像到3D口腔模型的端到端重建；在包含950个上颌样本的公开数据集Dental3DS上进行训练与评估；采用最近邻匹配（距离阈值0.035）作为精度度量。
AI.result: 在Dental3DS数据集上，该方法达到77.49%的重建精度（最近邻匹配，距离阈值0.035）。但预测顶点存在向真值高密度区域聚集的倾向，导致重建模型点分布不均匀。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法有效降低了口腔3D建模的成本与患者不适，消除了对物理扫描设备的需求，实现了自动化重建。但点分布不均的问题仍待解决，未来需改进以提升重建均匀性与整体精度。

title: To Be Multimodal or Not to Be: Query-Adaptive Audio-Visual Person Retrieval via Active Modality Detection
summary: When retrieving a person from a video archive by voice and face, should the system be multimodal or not? In real-world broadcast archives, unlike curated benchmarks, a target may be heard but unseen, seen but unheard, or both. Fusing scores from an absent modality injects noise, degrading precision below the best unimodal system. We propose a query-adaptive framework that detects active modalities via cross-modal score consistency: when both modalities are active, files retrieved by one also score highly on the other; this agreement breaks down when a modality is absent. Classifiers driven by these cross-modal features achieve 89% detection accuracy. On the BBC Rewind corpus (with over 12,000 broadcast videos) the adaptive system attains 94.2% P@1, outperforming speaker-only (82.9%), face-only (93.4%), and fixed fusion (90.0%), recovering 64% of the gap to an oracle with ground-truth modality labels (96.6%).

AI.tldr: 提出一种查询自适应框架，通过跨模态分数一致性检测活跃模态，在BBC Rewind广播档案上实现94.2%的P@1，优于单模态和固定融合方法。
AI.motivation: 真实广播档案中，目标人物可能只出现声音或只出现面部，固定融合策略会在缺失模态上引入噪声，导致精度低于最佳单模态系统。需要一个能自适应判断模态可用性的检索框架。
AI.method: 基于跨模态分数一致性检测活跃模态：当两个模态均活跃时，一个模态检索到的文件在另一个模态上也会获得高分，模态缺失时这种一致性会崩溃。利用这些跨模态特征训练分类器（准确率89%），实现查询自适应的模态融合。
AI.result: 在BBC Rewind数据集（超12,000个广播视频）上，自适应系统P@1达到94.2%，显著优于仅语音（82.9%）、仅人脸（93.4%）和固定融合（90.0%），恢复至有真值模态标签的oracle系统（96.6%）差距的64%。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态分数一致性是检测模态活跃性的有效信号，查询自适应融合能有效弥合固定融合与理想oracle之间的性能鸿沟，对真实多模态检索系统部署具有重要实际意义。

title: SALT: When More Rollouts Don't Help in Group-Based Policy Optimization and How to Make Them Matter
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) often adopts GRPO-style group-relative updates, sampling multiple rollouts per prompt to construct normalized learning signals. However, merely increasing the number of rollouts does not reliably strengthen learning: under GRPO-style group normalization, per-rollout policy-gradient features can concentrate into a low-rank, signed geometry, causing substantial cancellation during aggregation and weakening the effective update. We address this failure mode with SALT, a Subspace-Adaptive geometry pLug-in componenT that uses sample-wise gradient geometry to reweight the coefficients of group-relative updates. SALT estimates a dominant shared subspace from the mini-batch Gram geometry, decomposes group-relative coefficients into shared and residual channels, and adaptively amplifies the residual channel when signed cancellation is severe. Across diverse reasoning-oriented RLVR benchmarks and model scales, SALT improves effective update geometry and performance without modifying the reward model or the rollout sampling procedure

AI.tldr: SALT通过分析小批量梯度几何结构估计主导共享子空间，将组相对系数分解为共享通道和残差通道，并在符号抵消严重时自适应放大残差通道，从而解决GRPO类组归一化中策略梯度低秩化导致的更新弱化问题。
AI.motivation: 在RLVR中，GRPO风格的组相对更新通过采样多条rollout构建归一化学习信号，但简单增加rollout数量并不一定增强学习效果。原因是组归一化下每条rollout的策略梯度特征会集中为低秩的符号化几何结构，导致聚合时发生严重的符号抵消，削弱有效更新。
AI.method: 提出SALT（Subspace-Adaptive geometry pLug-in componenT），利用样本级梯度几何重新加权组相对更新的系数。具体步骤：从mini-batch的Gram几何估计主导共享子空间，将组相对系数分解为共享通道和残差通道，在符号抵消严重时自适应放大残差通道。
AI.result: 在多种面向推理的RLVR基准测试和不同模型规模上，SALT在不修改奖励模型或rollout采样过程的前提下，改善了有效更新的几何结构并提升了性能。
AI.conclusion: SALT作为一种即插即用的子空间自适应组件，能够有效缓解GRPO组归一化中的符号抵消问题，增强策略梯度更新的有效性，为RLVR训练提供了更稳定、更高效的优化路径。

title: Edit-R2: Context-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Image Editing
summary: Text-guided image editing has advanced rapidly with diffusion models and unified multimodal foundation models. However, most existing methods remain confined to single-turn settings, overlooking the more realistic scenario of multi-turn in-context editing, where users iteratively refine an image through a sequence of instructions. In this setting, a model must follow each new instruction while preserving accumulated session-level constraints, challenged by two coupled failure modes: long-context dilution, where sparse textual constraints become difficult to recover from growing interleaved image-text histories, and state contamination, where earlier editing mistakes degrade subsequent generations. We introduce Edit-R2, a novel reinforcement learning post-training framework for unified multimodal models. Edit-R2 reconstructs the operative session intent, which effectively consolidates scattered historical constraints into an explicit reasoning trace before each editing turn. It further enables multi-turn RL over both reasoning and generation through a unified objective that jointly optimizes intent reconstruction generation in discrete text space and flow-matching image generation in continuous latent space, while a trajectory filtering mechanism suppresses corrupted rollouts to stabilize training under state contamination. To support systematic evaluation, we introduce MICE-Bench, a large-scale benchmark for multi-turn in-context editing with automated metrics for instruction following (IF), content consistency (CC), and global awareness (GA) over accumulated session constraints. Experiments show that Edit-R2 substantially improves multi-turn in-context editing and achieves competitive performance compared against strong baselines.

AI.tldr: Edit-R2 是一种针对统一多模态模型的强化学习后训练框架，通过重构会话意图（operative session intent）将分散的历史约束整合为显式推理轨迹，并结合轨迹过滤机制抑制状态污染，从而显著提升多轮上下文图像编辑性能。同时引入 MICE-Bench 基准进行系统评估。
AI.motivation: 现有文本引导图像编辑方法局限于单轮设置，忽略了多轮上下文编辑这一更现实的场景。多轮编辑面临两个耦合的失败模式：(1) 长上下文稀释——稀疏的文本约束在交织的图像-文本历史中难以恢复；(2) 状态污染——早期编辑错误会污染后续生成。需要一种能够有效整合历史约束并稳定训练的方法。
AI.method: 提出 Edit-R2 框架，核心包含三个组件：(1) 会话意图重构机制，在每轮编辑前将分散的历史约束整合为显式推理轨迹；(2) 统一多轮强化学习目标，同时在离散文本空间中优化意图重构生成，并在连续潜在空间中优化 flow-matching 图像生成；(3) 轨迹过滤机制，通过抑制被污染的 rollout 来稳定训练过程。同时构建 MICE-Bench 基准，从指令遵循（IF）、内容一致性（CC）和全局感知（GA）三个维度自动化评估多轮上下文编辑。
AI.result: 在 MICE-Bench 上的实验表明，Edit-R2 在多轮上下文编辑任务上取得显著提升，与强基线方法相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: Edit-R2 通过强化学习后训练，有效解决了多轮上下文编辑中的长上下文稀释和状态污染问题，为统一多模态模型在迭代式图像编辑场景中的应用提供了可行的技术路径。

title: ATT-CR: Adaptive Triangular Transformer for Cloud Removal
summary: Cloud removal aims to accurately reconstruct the ground objects obscured by clouds in remote sensing images. Existing Transformer-based methods utilizing self-attention have shown impressive results by effectively modeling long-range dependencies in cloudy images. However, they suffer from the following issues: 1) the high computational complexity of self-attention limits scalability; 2) treating both cloudy and clean pixels as valid within the attention computation brings disturbances in subsequent layers, leading to suboptimal performance. To address these challenges, we propose the Adaptive Triangular Transformer for Cloud Removal (ATT-CR), a model that effectively reduces computational costs and mitigates interference from cloudy pixels. Specifically, it consists of two core components: Triangular Attention (TAN) and Feature Selected Gating Module (FSGM). TAN employs lower and upper triangular matrices to approximate Softmax attention with O(N) computational complexity, significantly reducing the computational costs. The FSGM, on the other hand, integrates with TAN to adaptively distinguish between cloudy and clean features, which minimizes the introduction of invalid information into subsequent layers. Extensive experiments on cloud removal benchmarks demonstrate that ATT-CR delivers superior performance compared to existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应三角Transformer用于遥感图像去云（ATT-CR），通过三角注意力（TAN）实现O(N)线性复杂度，并结合特征选择门控模块（FSGM）自适应区分云像素与干净像素，在去云基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer去云方法存在两个核心问题：1）自注意力的高计算复杂度限制了模型的可扩展性；2）在注意力计算中同时将云像素和干净像素视为有效输入，会在后续层中引入干扰，导致次优性能。
AI.method: 提出ATT-CR模型，包含两个核心组件：三角注意力（TAN），利用下三角和上三角矩阵近似Softmax注意力，实现O(N)线性计算复杂度；特征选择门控模块（FSGM），与TAN集成，自适应区分云特征与干净特征，减少无效信息引入后续层。
AI.result: 在多个云去除基准数据集上进行大量实验，ATT-CR相比现有方法取得了更优越的性能。
AI.conclusion: ATT-CR通过线性复杂度的三角注意力和自适应门控机制，有效解决了Transformer去云方法的计算效率与云像素干扰问题，为遥感图像去云提供了一种高效且高性能的解决方案。

title: Epistemic Injustice in Language Models: An Audit of Pretraining Filters and Guardrails
summary: Modern language models rely on pretraining filters to remove undesirable content from training corpora and inference-time guardrails to suppress undesirable outputs during deployment. In this paper, we examine how these filtering and moderation decisions produce forms of epistemic erasure and reveal tensions both across automated systems and between these systems and human judgment. We audit four pretraining filters and three inference-time guardrails on Common Crawl sentences containing gender and regional-origin mentions, together with a manually annotated subset of 500 sentences. Our analysis shows that filtering and guardrail decisions are strongly associated with blocklist-based lexical cues, while frequently failing to flag content containing private information or explicit hate speech. At the same time, marginalized groups, particularly transgender people, women, and Central Americans, are significantly over-flagged across systems. Human annotators, by contrast, would retain 88.5\% of filter-flagged and 91.3\% of guardrail-flagged content, often recognizing representational harms arising from tensions of content removal that current systems fail to capture. Taken together, our findings document a form of epistemic erasure in which mentions of marginalized groups are disproportionately removed before pretraining and additionally suppressed again at inference time.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了预训练过滤器与推理时护栏对提及性别和地域的语料的处理方式，发现这些系统过度依赖屏蔽词表，对边缘群体（尤其是跨性别者、女性和中美洲人）存在显著过度标记，同时却常常遗漏包含隐私信息和明确仇恨言论的内容，构成了一种"认知抹除"。
AI.motivation: 现代语言模型依赖预训练过滤器和推理时护栏来移除不良内容，但这些过滤与审核决策如何系统性地造成认知抹除、以及自动化系统与人类判断之间的张力尚未得到充分审视。
AI.method: 对Common Crawl中包含性别和地域来源提及的句子，审计4种预训练过滤器和3种推理时护栏，并辅以500句人工标注子集进行分析。
AI.result: 过滤与护栏决策与基于屏蔽词表的词汇线索强相关，但频繁未能标记含隐私信息或明确仇恨言论的内容；边缘群体（跨性别者、女性、中美洲人）在各系统中被显著过度标记；人类标注者会保留88.5%被过滤器标记的内容和91.3%被护栏标记的内容，能识别当前系统未能捕捉的表征性伤害。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现揭示了一种认知抹除现象：边缘群体的提及在预训练前被不成比例地移除，并在推理时再次被抑制，暴露出当前内容审核系统在公平性与有效性之间的深层张力。

title: Robust and sparse support vector machine via hybrid truncated loss for supervised classification
summary: The support vector machine (SVM) is a widely used classifier, but choosing an appropriate loss function remains difficult. Convex losses such as the hinge loss and least-squares loss are sensitive to outliers, while bounded non-convex losses often lead to high computational cost. To address this, we propose a hybrid truncated loss function ($L_{\mathrm{ht}}$) that is both sparse and bounded, and build the $L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM model for single-view classification. We introduce the P-stationary point and use it to establish the first-order necessary and sufficient optimality conditions. Based on these conditions, we design an alternating direction method of multipliers with a working-set strategy that reduces computational cost and achieves global convergence. We further extend $L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM to multi-view learning by adding structural information and view weights, resulting in Mv$L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM, which follows both the consensus and complementarity principles. Experiments on synthetic, real-world, and image datasets show that $L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM achieves higher accuracy with fewer support vectors and better noise robustness than five single-view methods, while Mv$L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM outperforms six multi-view methods in accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合截断损失函数 $L_{\mathrm{ht}}$，兼具稀疏性和有界性，用于构建单视图 $L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM 模型；进而通过引入结构信息和视图权重，扩展为多视图 Mv$L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM。实验表明该方法在准确率、噪声鲁棒性和支持向量数量方面均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: SVM 中凸损失（如 hinge loss、最小二乘损失）对离群点敏感，而有界非凸损失虽鲁棒但计算代价高。现有方法难以兼顾鲁棒性与计算效率，亟需一种既稀疏有界又便于优化的损失函数。
AI.method: 提出混合截断损失 $L_{\mathrm{ht}}$（稀疏+有界），构建 $L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM 单视图模型；引入 P-平稳点概念，建立一阶必要且充分的最优性条件；设计带工作集策略的 ADMM 算法以降低计算成本并保证全局收敛；进一步加入结构信息和视图权重，扩展为多视图 Mv$L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM，遵循一致性与互补性原则。
AI.result: 在合成、真实世界和图像数据集上，$L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM 相比五种单视图方法，准确率更高、支持向量更少、噪声鲁棒性更强；Mv$L_{\mathrm{ht}}$-SVM 在准确率、精确率、召回率和 F1 分数上均优于六种多视图方法。
AI.conclusion: $L_{\mathrm{ht}}$ 损失函数有效解决了 SVM 对离群点敏感与非凸损失计算代价高之间的矛盾，P-平稳点和 ADMM 工作集策略为优化提供了理论保障，多视图扩展进一步提升了分类性能，在多个指标上全面超越对比方法。

title: Bidirectional Search for Longest Paths: Case for Front-to-Front Heuristics
summary: Bidirectional heuristic search can potentially reduce search effort for problems amenable to backward search. Therein, it is well-known that front-to-front heuristics can reduce the number of node expansions, but their overhead is so high that overall runtime almost always increases. We propose BiXDFBnB, a bidirectional depth-first branch-and-bound algorithm that adapts the Single-Frontier Bidirectional Search (SFBDS) framework - originally developed for shortest-path (MIN) problems - to the Generalized Longest Simple Path (GLSP) setting. Because SFBDS inherently operates on paired states, front-to-front (F2F) heuristic evaluation arises naturally and avoids the overhead typically associated with bidirectional frontier management. We show that this adaptation can be successfully applied to maximization (MAX) problems while efficiently handling overlapping constraints. BiXDFBnB is applied to several types of longest-path problems: Longest Simple Path (LSP), Snakes, and Coil-in-the-Box (CIB). Empirical evaluation shows that the new algorithm frequently reduces the number of node expansions and, in some cases, also improves overall runtime.

AI.tldr: BiXDFBnB 是一种双向深度优先分支定界算法，将单前沿双向搜索框架（SFBDS）从最短路径问题适配到广义最长简单路径（GLSP）最大化问题。该算法天然支持前向-前向（F2F）启发式评估，避免了传统双向搜索中前沿管理的开销，在最长简单路径、Snakes 和 Coil-in-the-Box 等问题上能减少节点扩展数，部分情况下也能改善总运行时间。
AI.motivation: 双向启发式搜索中，前向-前向（F2F）启发式虽然能减少节点扩展数，但其计算开销过高，导致整体运行时间几乎总是增加。作者希望利用 SFBDS 框架天然支持配对状态上 F2F 评估的特性，将其从最短路径（MIN）问题推广到最长路径（MAX）问题，以在最大化问题中同时获得搜索效率与运行时间的改善。
AI.method: 提出 BiXDFBnB 算法，将 SFBDS 框架从最短路径问题适配到广义最长简单路径（GLSP）最大化问题。该算法基于双向深度优先分支定界策略，利用 SFBDS 在配对状态上运作的内在特性，使 F2F 启发式评估自然融入搜索过程，同时高效处理重叠约束。应用于 LSP、Snakes、Coil-in-the-Box 三类最长路径问题。
AI.result: 在 LSP、Snakes 和 Coil-in-the-Box 等最长路径问题上的实证评估表明，BiXDFBnB 经常能减少节点扩展数量，并且在某些情况下也能改善整体运行时间。
AI.conclusion: SFBDS 框架可以成功地从最短路径（MIN）问题推广到最长路径（MAX）问题，BiXDFBnB 算法在减少节点扩展数和改善运行时间方面均展现出潜力，为双向启发式搜索在最大化问题上的应用提供了新思路。

title: Global-Local Monte Carlo Tree Search in Vision-Language Models for Text-to-3D Indoor Scene Generation
summary: Large Vision-Language Models have achieved significant reasoning performance in various tasks.However, there are few studies on text-to-3D indoor scene generation with LVLMs. The main challenge is that prevailing LVLM-based methods employ chain-of-thought sequential decision mechanisms that cannot revise earlier decisions, causing error propagation.In this paper, we consider the task as a planning problem constrained by spatial and layout commonsense.To solve this problem, we model it as a tree search problem with global and local trees, which differs from existing sequential decision-making approaches.In the global tree, we place each object iteratively and explore multiple attempts like humans furnishing a room, where the problem space is represented as a tree.To effectively search the tree, we propose a hierarchical scene representation and a PRM-guided MCTS method.The hierarchical representation abstracts a scene into room level, region level, floor object level, and supported object level.The PRM-guided MCTS method uses the PRM to prune unnecessary branches and the MCTS algorithm to balance exploration and exploitation to get an optimal solution with fewer attempts.In the local tree, it further decomposes the placement of each object into finer sub-steps, including the specific placement parameters.To make the whole appearance of the scene consistent, we leverage pre-trained diffusion image generative models to predict textures for all the objects in the scene.As existing benchmarks for text-to-3D indoor scene generation remain limited in scale and diversity, we collect a new large-scale diverse dataset that contains 65 scene types and 3,250 instructions with diverse sizes, layouts, and styles, named 3DTindo-bench, to better assess the capability of the state-of-the-art models. Our experiments show that our method generates more realistic 3D scenes than state-of-the-art approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将文本到3D室内场景生成建模为树搜索问题，通过全局树与局部树的分层搜索机制替代传统链式思维顺序决策，结合PRM引导的MCTS方法避免错误传播，并引入层次化场景表示和扩散模型纹理预测，同时构建了大规模多样化数据集3DTindo-bench。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LVLM的文本到3D室内场景生成方法采用链式思维顺序决策，无法修正早期错误，导致误差传播。此外，现有基准数据集规模和多样性有限，难以有效评估模型能力。
AI.method: 将场景生成建模为树搜索问题：全局树迭代放置物体并多尝试探索，采用层次化场景表示（房间级、区域级、地面物体级、支撑物体级）；使用PRM（过程奖励模型）引导的MCTS（蒙特卡洛树搜索）方法剪枝并平衡探索与利用；局部树将每个物体放置分解为更细粒度的子步骤；最后利用预训练扩散模型预测物体纹理以保证外观一致性。同时构建了包含65种场景类型、3250条指令的3DTindo-bench数据集。
AI.result: 实验表明，所提方法生成的3D场景比现有最先进方法更加真实。新构建的3DTindo-bench数据集能更好地评估模型在不同尺寸、布局和风格场景下的能力。
AI.conclusion: 将文本到3D室内场景生成转化为带空间与布局常识约束的树搜索规划问题，通过全局-局部树结构和PRM-guided MCTS有效缓解误差传播问题，层次化表示与扩散纹理预测进一步提升了场景真实感，新数据集为后续研究提供了更好的评估基准。

title: Large Language Models are Perplexed by some Political Parties
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used, including in political applications, but their political fairness has been little studied. We assess it using perplexity, posing that a fair model should give equal probability to all political groups. However, we find, across ten LLMs and three datasets covering 37 languages, that LLMs are more perplexed by the texts of far right and nationalist parties than of social-democratic parties. We find this to be consistent with previous work on translation fairness, to the point that perplexity correlates with downstream translation metrics. Our method is applicable to both base LLMs as well as their instruction-tuned counterpart, and we find that both are highly correlated, suggesting that the political fairness of LLMs stems from their pretraining, and is hardly affected by instruction-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大语言模型（LLM）的政治公平性，通过困惑度（perplexity）指标衡量，发现LLM对极右翼和民族主义政党的文本表现出更高的困惑度（即更低的概率），而对社民党政党的文本则更"熟悉"。该偏差源于预训练阶段，指令微调难以改变，且与下游翻译公平性指标相关。
AI.motivation: LLM在政治领域的应用日益增多，但其政治公平性尚未得到充分研究。作者提出：一个公平的语言模型应对所有政治团体的文本赋予相等的概率，因此通过困惑度来量化模型对不同政治派别文本的偏好偏差。
AI.method: 使用困惑度（perplexity）作为核心评估指标；覆盖10个LLM（包括基础模型和指令微调版本）、3个多语言数据集（涉及37种语言）；比较模型对极右翼/民族主义政党与社民党政党文本的困惑度差异；进一步将困惑度偏差与下游翻译任务中的公平性指标进行相关性分析。
AI.result: 所有测试的LLM对极右翼和民族主义政党文本的困惑度均显著高于社民党政党文本；该发现与先前翻译公平性研究一致，困惑度偏差与下游翻译质量指标存在相关性；基础模型与其对应的指令微调版本在政治偏差上高度相关，表明政治不公平性主要源于预训练阶段，指令微调的影响很小。
AI.conclusion: LLM存在系统性的政治偏向——对右翼政治文本"更困惑"（即建模更差），这种不公平性根植于预训练数据，难以通过后续的指令微调消除。困惑度可作为检测政治公平性的有效代理指标。

title: Consistency Training Along the Transformer Stack
summary: Consistency training encourages models to behave similarly across different contexts, and has shown promise for reducing misalignment. We broaden the scope of consistency training in two ways. First, we introduce two new internal consistency targets: MLP Consistency Training (MLPCT), which matches post-activation MLP states, and Attention Consistency Training (AttCT), which matches per-head attention distributions. Second, we apply consistency training to four additional safety threats: persona in-context learning attacks, adversarial frustration, prefill attacks, and conditional misalignment. Across several models and threat settings, we find that consistency training reduces misalignment well beyond the sycophancy and jailbreak settings studied in prior work. We also find cases of cross-threat generalization, where training against one failure mode improves robustness to another, and identify a shared residual-stream mechanism underlying ACT, MLPCT, and AttCT, while distinguishing BCT as mechanistically distinct. Our results suggest that consistency training is a flexible and extensible framework for alignment, capable of unifying defenses against a broader class of model pathologies.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了一致性训练的范围，提出了两种新的内部一致性目标（MLPCT和AttCT），并将其应用于四种额外的安全威胁，证明一致性训练能广泛减少模型失配，并具有跨威胁泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明一致性训练在减少谄媚（sycophancy）和越狱（jailbreak）方面有效，但研究者希望探索：一是能否设计新的内部一致性目标，二是该方法能否防御更广泛的安全威胁，从而验证一致性训练作为一种通用对齐框架的潜力。
AI.method: 提出两种新的内部一致性训练目标：MLP一致性训练（MLPCT），匹配MLP激活后的状态；注意力一致性训练（AttCT），匹配逐头注意力分布。将一致性训练应用于四种新威胁场景：角色上下文学习攻击、对抗性挫败、预填充攻击和条件性失配。在多个模型和威胁设置上进行实验评估，并进行了机制分析以区分不同一致性训练方法的底层机制。
AI.result: 一致性训练在四种新威胁场景中均显著降低了模型失配，效果远超先前仅针对谄媚和越狱的研究。发现跨威胁泛化现象，即针对一种失效模式训练可提升对另一种失效模式的鲁棒性。机制分析揭示ACT、MLPCT和AttCT共享一个残差流机制，而BCT在机制上与之不同。
AI.conclusion: 一致性训练是一个灵活且可扩展的对齐框架，能够统一防御更广泛的模型病理行为。不同一致性目标在机制上既有共享也有差异，为进一步改进对齐方法提供了方向。

title: The Self-Correction Illusion: LLMs Correct Others but Not Themselves
summary: Recent work shows that LLM agents struggle to correct errors in their own reasoning traces yet show markedly higher correction rates when identical claims appear under external sources. We ask whether this asymmetry reflects a capability deficit or a role-label artifact: does an agent's willingness to correct a wrong claim depend causally on the chat-template role that carries it, rather than on the claim's content? Our setup keeps the erroneous claim byte-identical across all conditions (SHA-256 verified) and varies only its wrapping role: the agent's own \role{<thought>}, a \role{user} message, a \role{tool} response, or a \role{system <memory>} block. Across 13 model-domain cells covering seven model families and three domains ($n{=}30$ paired tasks per cell), relabeling the claim from \role{<thought>} to an external role lifts the explicit-correction rate by 23 to 93 percentage points, with 10 of 13 cells reaching $p{<}0.001$. Further experiments confirm that the effect is asymmetric, mechanistically decomposable, and robust across domains. The failure to self-correct is not a cognitive deficit; it is a chat-template artifact. We exploit this artifact by designing a prompt-structure-only intervention that requires no training and no model modification, with its strongest role label being domain-dependent: \role{<memory>} dominates on math, while a plain \role{user} message dominates on logical deduction.

AI.tldr: LLM智能体难以自我纠错并非认知能力缺陷，而是聊天模板中角色标签的人为产物——将同一错误声明从"思考"角色重新标记为外部角色后，显式纠错率提升23至93个百分点。
AI.motivation: 此前研究发现LLM智能体纠正自己推理中的错误远低于纠正外部来源中的相同错误。本文旨在探究这种不对称现象的本质：究竟是模型真正的认知能力缺陷，还是仅仅由聊天模板中的角色标签造成的表面现象。
AI.method: 控制实验：保持错误声明字节完全相同（SHA-256验证），仅改变其在对话模板中的包装角色——agent自身的<thought>、user消息、tool响应、system <memory>块。覆盖7个模型家族、3个领域（数学、逻辑推理等），共13个模型-领域组合单元，每个单元30对任务。进一步验证效应的非对称性、机制可分解性及跨领域鲁棒性。
AI.result: 将声明从<thought>重新标记为外部角色后，显式纠错率提升23-93个百分点，13个单元中有10个达到p<0.001显著水平。效应具有非对称性和机制可分解性。此外，发现最优角色标签具有领域依赖性：<memory>在数学领域效果最佳，而普通user消息在逻辑推理领域占优。
AI.conclusion: LLM自我纠错的失败不是认知缺陷，而是聊天模板的角色标签人为产物。基于此发现，作者设计了一种仅需调整提示结构、无需训练或模型修改的干预方法。

title: ReSAGE-PAR: Representational Similarity Assessment for Generative Expansion in Pedestrian Attribute Recognition
comment: Under review at IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology (TCSVT)
summary: To address the limited diversity and data scarcity in Pedestrian Attribute Recognition (PAR), we explore image synthesis using diffusion models guided by attribute-based prompts. While this enables the controlled generation of pedestrian images, it faces two critical challenges: (i) the domain gap between high-quality pre-training data and low-resolution, non-standard surveillance crops, and (ii) the need for reliable attribute verification to prevent generative hallucinations. In this paper, we introduce a robust generate-score-autolabel pipeline called ReSAGE-PAR (REpresentational Similarity Assessment for Generative Expansion in PAR) that bridges this domain gap and enables scalable, high-fidelity dataset expansion. First, we adapt pre-trained diffusion models to native PAR resolutions using a tailored LoRA-based Image-to-Image approach. Second, we extract vision-language alignment scores between the generated images and their conditioning prompts, utilizing a comprehensive prompting strategy that includes label-consistent and inconsistent complements. Finally, we formulate a Bayesian classifier that converts these continuous scores into reliable binary pseudo-labels. Extensive evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of ReSAGE-PAR in preserving spatial priors and verifying attributes. When integrated into PAR training, ReSAGE-PAR consistently yields significant improvements-achieving gains of up to 8.7% on standard backbones and pushing state-of-the-art frameworks to new performance levels. This proves its value as an architecture-agnostic solution for scalable PAR enhancement. The complete codebase for ReSAGE-PAR is publicly available at http://www-vpu.eps.uam.es/publications/ReSAGE-PAR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReSAGE-PAR，一种基于扩散模型生成-评分-自动标注的管线，用于行人属性识别(PAR)的数据增强。通过 LoRA 微调弥合域差距，并利用视觉-语言对齐评分与贝叶斯分类器实现可靠的伪标签生成，最终在多个主干网络上实现高达 8.7% 的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 行人属性识别面临数据多样性和稀缺性不足的问题。虽然扩散模型可通过属性提示可控生成图像，但存在两个关键挑战：(1) 高质量预训练数据与低分辨率监控裁剪图像之间的域差距；(2) 需要可靠的属性验证机制以防止生成幻觉。
AI.method: 提出三阶段管线 ReSAGE-PAR：(1) 基于 LoRA 的 Image-to-Image 方法将预训练扩散模型适配到 PAR 原生分辨率；(2) 设计包含标签一致与不一致提示的综合提示策略，提取生成图像与条件提示之间的视觉-语言对齐分数；(3) 构建贝叶斯分类器，将连续对齐分数转换为可靠的二值伪标签。
AI.result: 广泛评估表明 ReSAGE-PAR 在保留空间先验和验证属性方面效果显著。集成到 PAR 训练中后，在标准主干网络上取得高达 8.7% 的提升，并将 SOTA 框架推向新的性能水平。
AI.conclusion: ReSAGE-PAR 作为一种架构无关的解决方案，能够有效实现可扩展的行人属性识别增强，通过弥合域差距和可靠的伪标签机制解决了生成式数据扩展中的核心难题。

title: Measuring the sensitivity of LLM-based structured extraction to prompt, model, and schema choices in clinical discharge summaries
comment: 69 pages, 5 main figures, supplementary material included
summary: Large language models are increasingly used for structured extraction from clinical free-text notes, but the sensitivity of their output to upstream configuration choices is less understood than their accuracy on fixed benchmarks. This work measures that sensitivity without human-annotated ground truth, by holding the extraction task fixed and varying one choice at a time. The fixed schema comprises 17 clinical documentation flags on a three-way yes/no/not_documented value set and a 47-tag vocabulary for the primary admission reason. Three prompt variants expressing this schema were each run at two model sizes on MIMIC-IV v3.1 discharge summaries. Cross-prompt agreement was measured by Cohen's kappa on ICD-stratified subsets. A paired same-note comparison isolated the effect of model choice, and a post-hoc collapse of the three-way flags to binary tested the schema's contribution to disagreement. On the three-way flags, the two models reach the same pooled cross-prompt agreement (median kappa 0.69 and 0.68); the larger model raises agreement on some fields and lowers it on others, a redistribution rather than the absence of an effect. Collapsing the schema to binary dissolves most of the cross-prompt disagreement, locating it on the absence-versus-silence distinction rather than on whether the finding is present. On the multi-class admission categorization, changing the model reassigns the dominant tag on close to half of all notes while changing the prompt phrasing reassigns it on roughly one in eight, and the larger model places far less mass on residual catch-all categories (44% to 26%). These patterns indicate a schema-imposed source of disagreement concentrated on the absence-versus-silence axis and a dominance of model over prompt phrasing on multi-class categorization, identified by a reusable methodology for auditing extraction reproducibility on a population-scale deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文通过固定抽取任务、逐一变更上游配置（模型大小、提示措辞、值集模式），在没有人工标注的情况下测量了大语言模型在临床自由文本结构化抽取中的输出敏感性。研究发现：三值标志上的跨提示不一致主要源于“缺失”与“未记录”的区分；多分类入院原因标注中，模型选择的影响远超提示措辞；更大模型减少了残差兜底类别的概率质量。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地用于临床自由文本的结构化信息抽取，但其输出对上游配置选择（如提示措辞、模型规模、值集模式）的敏感性尚未得到充分研究。现有评估多依赖固定基准数据集上的准确性，缺少在无人工标注条件下、面向大规模部署场景的可复现性审计方法。
AI.method: 本研究使用 MIMIC-IV v3.1 出院小结数据集，固定 17 项三值（yes/no/not_documented）临床文档标志和一个 47 标签的入院主因词汇表作为抽取模式。设置三种提示变体，在两种模型规模上分别运行。采用 Cohen's kappa 测量跨提示一致性，并按 ICD 分层子集分析；通过配对同笔记比较隔离模型选择效应；事后将三值标志折叠为二值，检验模式本身对不一致的贡献。
AI.result: 在三值标志上，两种模型的跨提示一致性中位 kappa 分别为 0.69 和 0.68，更大模型在某些字段上提高一致性、在另一些字段上降低一致性，表现为重新分配而非单纯增益。将模式折叠为二值后，大部分跨提示分歧消失，表明不一致主要集中在“缺失”与“未记录”的区分上。在多分类入院原因标注中，更换模型导致近半数笔记的主导标签被重新分配，而更换提示措辞仅影响约八分之一的笔记；更大的模型将残差兜底类别的概率质量从 44% 降至 26%。
AI.conclusion: 临床文本结构化抽取中的不一致性呈现出系统性模式：模式强加的“缺失 vs. 未记录”轴是分歧的主要来源；在多分类任务中，模型选择的主导性远大于提示措辞。本文提出的无标注审计方法可用于大规模部署场景下的抽取可复现性评估。

title: GenAutoML: An Agentic Framework for Dynamic Architecture Generation and Optimization in Time-Series Analysis
summary: Designing neural architectures for time-series forecasting and anomaly detection remains a resource-intensive task that often requires substantial domain expertise. Traditional Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) systems typically rely on static, predefined search spaces, limiting their ability to adapt to diverse data characteristics. We present GenAutoML, an agentic framework that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) as neural architects to bridge natural-language requirements and executable PyTorch implementations. The framework incorporates a Sandboxed Reflection Loop for autonomous code refinement and a Signature-Aware Runtime that enforces architectural consistency and execution safety. To improve robustness under non-stationary conditions, we further introduce a Dynamic Reversible Instance Normalization (Dyn-RevIN) wrapper. Experiments on the ETTh1, ETTm1, and Weather benchmarks demonstrate that GenAutoML can dynamically generate task-specific neural architectures tailored to dataset characteristics. Among the generated models, WaveInterferenceNet achieves inference latency below 0.01 ms per sample while maintaining competitive predictive performance. By emphasizing computational efficiency, architectural adaptability, and stable optimization behavior, GenAutoML enables the creation of ultra-lightweight neural networks suitable for resource-constrained and latency-sensitive Edge AI deployments.

AI.tldr: GenAutoML 是一个基于大语言模型的智能体框架，能够根据自然语言需求自动生成时间序列预测与异常检测的神经架构，并通过沙盒反射循环和签名感知运行时确保代码质量，同时引入 Dyn-RevIN 增强非平稳条件下的鲁棒性，在多个基准上验证了其生成超轻量网络的能力。
AI.motivation: 传统AutoML系统依赖静态、预定义的搜索空间，难以适配多样化的数据特征，而时间序列神经架构设计又高度依赖领域专家且资源消耗大。该工作旨在利用LLM的生成能力突破固定搜索空间的限制，实现任务自适应的神经架构自动生成。
AI.method: 提出 GenAutoML 框架：(1) 以LLM作为神经架构师，将自然语言需求转化为可执行的PyTorch代码；(2) 构建 Sandboxed Reflection Loop 实现代码的自主迭代优化；(3) 设计 Signature-Aware Runtime 保证架构一致性与执行安全；(4) 引入 Dynamic Reversible Instance Normalization (Dyn-RevIN) 包装层应对非平稳时间序列。
AI.result: 在 ETTh1、ETTm1 和 Weather 三个基准数据集上的实验表明，GenAutoML 能动态生成适配数据特性的任务专用架构。其中，生成的 WaveInterferenceNet 推理延迟低于每样本 0.01 ms，同时保持有竞争力的预测性能。
AI.conclusion: GenAutoML 通过对计算效率、架构自适应性和优化稳定性的综合关注，使得在资源受限、延迟敏感的 Edge AI 场景中部署超轻量神经网络成为可能，为自动化时间序列建模开辟了新路径。

title: Framing, Judging, Steering: An Assessable Competency Model for Teach-ing Students to Reason With Generative AI
summary: Generative AI makes answers easy and understanding hard, and uncritical use invites cognitive offloading. Schools still measure unaided performance, yet the real task is to produce good work with AI: framing an ill-defined task, judging the output, and steering the model toward a better result. This ability is rarely assessed in its own right; where measured, it collapses into one "prompting" score that cannot diagnose why AI use succeeds or fails. We propose CoRe-3 (Co-Reasoning), a competency model factoring productive AI use into three assessable skills we abbreviate FJS: Framing (specifying an ill-defined task before invoking AI), Judging (evaluating output for errors and unstated assumptions), and Steering (iteratively redirecting the model). Its distinguishing claim is the separation of pre-generation Framing from post-generation Steering, with Judging as the gate between. We ground the skills in theory, state five testable propositions, and instantiate them in CoReasoningLab, an open platform that presents flawed AI output and scores them independently. Over simulated learners (generated and graded by different models), the skills dissociate: each tracks its own manipulated competence while staying flat in the others, and grades become correlated when one competence is shared across all three (convergent and discriminant validity), across grader backends from two providers. Human-rater agreement and outcomes are next; we release the instrument, data, and protocol.

AI.tldr: 提出CoRe-3能力模型,将人与AI的协同推理分解为Framing(框架构建)、Judging(判断评估)和Steering(迭代引导)三个可独立评估的技能,并通过CoReasoningLab平台验证了这三个技能的心理测量学区分效度与收敛效度。
AI.motivation: 当前教育测评仍以无辅助的独立表现为标准,但现实中高效使用AI需要一套复合能力。现有研究将其笼统归为"提示词能力"的单一得分,无法诊断AI使用成败的具体原因。因此需要一种能够区分不同子技能的细粒度能力模型。
AI.method: (1)理论建构:将"AI协同推理"分解为FJS三个子技能——Framing(调用AI前对病构问题进行规约)、Judging(评估输出的错误与隐含假设)、Steering(迭代引导模型改进),强调Framing与Steering以Judging为关口的时序分离;(2)提出五条可检验命题;(3)开发CoReasoningLab开源平台,呈现有缺陷的AI输出并对三个技能独立评分;(4)通过模拟学习者(由不同模型生成并由不同评分后端评估)进行验证,检验区分效度与收敛效度。
AI.result: 模拟实验中,三个技能得分表现出解耦特征:操纵某一项能力时仅该技能分数变化而其他技能保持平稳;当三项技能共享同一能力基础时,三者得分呈正相关,验证了区分效度与收敛效度。结果在两家不同提供商的评分后端上均成立。
AI.conclusion: 将AI协同使用分解为FJS三个技能是可行的,CoRe-3模型和CoReasoningLab平台为诊断性评估AI使用能力提供了可操作框架。下一步将开展人类评分者一致性研究和真实情境中的结果验证。

title: Texture-preserving implicit neural representation for Cone beam CT truncated reconstruction
summary: Cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) frequently suffers from data truncation, which introduces severe artifacts and limits the effective field of view (FOV). Existing deep learning methods for truncated cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) reconstruction suffer from serious limitations, including a strict reliance on supervised ground truth and a failure to account for continuous 3D spatial truncation variations. To address these challenges, we introduce a self-supervised 3D reconstruction framework based on neural scene representations. By directly mapping spatial coordinates to radiodensity under projection supervision, our approach inherently bypasses traditional filtering and backprojection operations, thereby fundamentally eliminating truncation-induced ring artifacts while enabling robust continuous 3D data extrapolation. However, coordinate networks are susceptible to an inherent spectral bias, which leads to a severe loss of clinically vital high-frequency textures. To resolve this bottleneck, we further incorporate a physics-based iterative refinement module into the neural scene representation architecture. Leveraging the artifact-free, extrapolated volume from the coordinate network as an optimal initialization, this module progressively re-extracts and injects high-frequency structural information from the original projections back into the volume. Extensive experiments on both simulated and real-world datasets demonstrate that our method successfully unifies the exceptional artifact suppression and extrapolation capabilities of neural networks with the high-fidelity detail preservation of iterative algorithms.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于神经场景表示的自监督3D CBCT重建框架，结合物理迭代优化模块，在无监督条件下实现截断伪影消除、连续3D外推及高频纹理恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有CBCT截断重建的深度学习方法依赖监督真值，且无法处理连续3D空间截断变化；坐标网络虽能消除环状伪影，但因固有频谱偏置导致高频纹理严重丢失。
AI.method: 构建神经场景表示网络，将空间坐标直接映射为放射密度，通过投影监督实现自监督重建，从根本上绕过传统滤波反投影操作以消除截断环状伪影；在此基础上引入物理驱动的迭代优化模块，将坐标网络生成的伪影无关外推体积作为初始化，从原始投影中逐步重提取高频结构信息并注入体积。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法在伪影抑制、外推能力与细节保真度三方面均取得优异效果。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功融合了神经网络优异的伪影抑制与数据外推能力以及迭代算法的高保真细节重建优势。

title: Beyond Alignment: Value Diversity as a Collective Property in Multicultural Agent Systems
summary: Multicultural multi-agent systems are increasingly deployed in globally diverse settings, where different agents are grounded in different cultural backgrounds. Existing cultural evaluation focuses on value alignment: how closely a single agent matches a target culture. Yet alignment is a per-agent property and cannot reveal whether a system, taken as a whole, preserves the cultural plurality it is meant to represent. We propose value diversity as a system-level evaluation axis for multicultural agent systems, defined through the dissimilarity between culturally conditioned agents' responses on a shared value survey. Using the World Values Survey, we evaluate 19 cultures and 18 backbone models across a wide range of system configurations. We find that diversity is largely uncorrelated with alignment, indicating that the two capture complementary system properties, and that current multicultural agent systems fall substantially below human societies in value diversity. Mixed-backbone systems narrow this gap but do not close it, and the gap persists across culture compositions and agent scales. Social interaction further erodes diversity by driving agents toward consensus, and a participatory budgeting case study shows that this homogenization narrows the breadth of collective decision-making. Together, our results establish value diversity as a distinct evaluation axis for multicultural multi-agent systems and reveal a persistent homogenization tendency in current LLM-based societies. Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/iNLP-Lab/MultiAgent-Diversity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“价值多样性”作为多文化多智能体系统的系统级评估轴，发现当前LLM基的多智能体系统在价值多样性上显著低于人类社会，且社交互动会进一步侵蚀多样性，导致同质化。
